    @pure_lazy
    def _fuse_sqlite_schema_work_products(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> None:
        """Close one SQLite schema plan into one ordered terminal transport."""
        plan = self._schema_plan
        if plan is None:
            return
        work_product_types = {"BootstrapDdlWorkProductStep", "BootstrapDmlWorkProductStep"}
        if sum(type(step).__name__ in work_product_types for step in plan._steps) < 2:
            return
        if type(plan._steps[-1]).__name__ != "StaticValueAfterDepsStep":
            return
        conn = self._conn
        if conn.backend_type is not BackendType.SQLITE:
            return
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.bootstrap_application_terminal import (
            BootstrapApplicationTerminalStep,
            BootstrapTerminalLoweringContext,
            collapse_bootstrap_terminal_static_publications,
            lower_bootstrap_terminal_work_products,
        )

        tail_ref = ServerPlanRefId(plan._steps[-1].ref_id)
        flattened_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        for step in plan._steps:
            if type(step) is BootstrapApplicationTerminalStep:
                flattened_steps.extend(step.children)
            else:
                flattened_steps.append(step)
        profile = self.backend_profile
        terminal_children = lower_bootstrap_terminal_work_products(
            collapse_bootstrap_terminal_static_publications(
                tuple(flattened_steps),
                application_tail_ref=tail_ref,
            ),
            context=BootstrapTerminalLoweringContext(
                backend_type=conn.backend_type,
                dialect=conn.get_dialect(),
                supports_data_modifying_ctes=profile.traits.supports_data_modifying_ctes,
                backend_profile=profile,
                planning_catalog=self._planning_catalog,
            ),
        )
        plan._steps[:] = [BootstrapApplicationTerminalStep(tail_ref, terminal_children)]
        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(DiagnosticLabel("round_trip_boundary"), DiagnosticLabel("total"))
        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(DiagnosticLabel("round_trip_boundary"), DiagnosticLabel("bootstrap_application_terminal"))

    def _publish_isolated_catalog_evolution(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> None:
        """Publish explicit schema models for unsealed or isolated connections."""
        conn = self._conn
        if conn._authoritative_planning_catalog_sealed and not conn._authoritative_planning_catalog_evolution_allowed:
            return
        catalog_models = tuple(self._schema_operation_plan.catalog_models)
        if catalog_models:
            conn.bind_planning_models(*catalog_models)

    @external_io_boundary
    def _commit_schema_transaction(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> None:
        """Commit schema transaction on backend.

        Commits all schema changes made during this transaction. Individual schema
        methods (create_table_from_schema, etc.) do NOT commit - all commits happen
        here when the transaction exits normally.

        SQLite commits its explicitly owned transaction here. MariaDB DDL can
        commit implicitly; this call also finalizes remaining transactional writes.
        """
        if self._has_pending_schema_plan_work():
            self.freeze_schema_execution_plan()
            self.flush_schema_plan()
        if self._bootstrap_application_transaction_completed:
            self._publish_isolated_catalog_evolution()
            return
        generation_receipt: SchemaGenerationBumps | None = None
        if self._schema_changed and self._cache_generations_table_exists():
            atomic_connection = self._conn
            if supports_sync_atomic_generation(atomic_connection):
                tags = self._schema_generation_tags()
                generation_receipt = SchemaGenerationBumps.from_atomic_receipt(
                    tags,
                    SchemaGenerationRows(tuple(atomic_connection._bump_schema_generation_tags_atomic(tags, datetime.now(UTC)).items())),
                )
        self._conn._commit()
        self._precomputed_schema_generation_bumps = generation_receipt
        self._publish_isolated_catalog_evolution()

    @external_io_boundary
    async def _commit_schema_transaction_async(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> None:
        """Async variant of :meth:`_commit_schema_transaction`."""
        if self._has_pending_schema_plan_work():
            self.freeze_schema_execution_plan()
            with _graphql_bootstrap_profile_span(SchemaDdlPhase("commit_schema_transaction_async.flush_schema_plan")):
                await self.flush_schema_plan_async()
        if self._bootstrap_application_transaction_completed:
            self._publish_isolated_catalog_evolution()
            return
        generation_receipt: SchemaGenerationBumps | None = None
        if self._schema_changed and self._cache_generations_table_exists():
            atomic_connection = self._conn
            if supports_async_atomic_generation(atomic_connection):
                tags = self._schema_generation_tags()
                generation_receipt = SchemaGenerationBumps.from_atomic_receipt(
                    tags,
                    SchemaGenerationRows(
                        tuple((await atomic_connection._bump_schema_generation_tags_atomic_async(tags, datetime.now(UTC))).items())
                    ),
                )
        with _graphql_bootstrap_profile_span(SchemaDdlPhase("commit_schema_transaction_async.backend_commit")):
            await self._conn._commit_async()
        self._precomputed_schema_generation_bumps = generation_receipt
        self._publish_isolated_catalog_evolution()

    @external_io_boundary
    def _rollback_schema_transaction(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> None:
        """Rollback schema transaction on backend when an exception occurs.

        Attempts to reset the connection so subsequent operations do not see an
        aborted transaction. Backends that don't support rollback simply ignore
        the request.

        Also invalidates the table_exists cache since any tables created during
        the rolled-back transaction are no longer valid.
        """
        logger.debug("[LazySchemaTransaction] Starting rollback of schema transaction")

        try:
            logger.debug(
                "[LazySchemaTransaction] Calling _rollback(recreate_cursor=True) on %s",
                type(self._conn).__name__,
            )
            self._conn._rollback(recreate_cursor=True)
            logger.info("[LazySchemaTransaction] Rollback completed successfully")
        except Exception as e:
            # Log the error with full details for debugging
            # A failed rollback leaves the connection in an unusable state
            logger.error(
                "[LazySchemaTransaction] ROLLBACK FAILED - connection is now in bad state. "
                "Error type: %s, Error: %s. "
                "Subsequent operations on this connection will likely fail with "
                "InFailedSqlTransaction or similar errors.",
                type(e).__name__,
                e,
                exc_info=True,  # Include full traceback
            )
            msg = "Schema transaction rollback failed; connection is in a bad state"
            raise RuntimeError(msg) from e

        finally:
            # Invalidate cache since rolled-back DDL operations leave cache stale
            conn = self._conn
            from l2055_lazy_result.purity import bootstrap_lifecycle_effect_boundary_lazy, in_lazy_context

            if in_lazy_context():
                with bootstrap_lifecycle_effect_boundary_lazy():
                    conn.invalidate_table_exists_cache(None)
                    conn._column_cache.clear()
            else:
                conn.invalidate_table_exists_cache(None)
                conn._column_cache.clear()
            logger.debug("[LazySchemaTransaction] Invalidated table_exists cache")

    @external_io_boundary
    async def _rollback_schema_transaction_async(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> None:
        """Async variant of :meth:`_rollback_schema_transaction`.

        Uses ``_rollback_async`` to avoid blocking the event loop.
        """
        logger.debug("[LazySchemaTransaction] Starting rollback of schema transaction (async)")

        try:
            await self._conn._rollback_async()
            logger.info("[LazySchemaTransaction] Rollback completed successfully (async)")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(
                "[LazySchemaTransaction] ROLLBACK FAILED (async) - connection is now in bad state. "
                "Error type: %s, Error: %s. "
                "Subsequent operations on this connection will likely fail.",
                type(e).__name__,
                e,
                exc_info=True,
            )
            msg = "Async schema transaction rollback failed; connection is in a bad state"
            raise RuntimeError(msg) from e

        finally:
            conn = self._conn
            from l2055_lazy_result.purity import bootstrap_lifecycle_effect_boundary_lazy, in_lazy_context

            if in_lazy_context():
                with bootstrap_lifecycle_effect_boundary_lazy():
                    conn.invalidate_table_exists_cache(None)
                    conn._column_cache.clear()
            else:
                conn.invalidate_table_exists_cache(None)
                conn._column_cache.clear()
            logger.debug("[LazySchemaTransaction] Invalidated table_exists cache (async)")

    @external_io_boundary
    def drop_table(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        if_exists: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        """Drop a table from the database.

        Args:
            table_name: Name of table to drop
            if_exists: If True, don't raise error if table doesn't exist
        """
        existed_before_drop = True
        if if_exists:
            existed_before_drop = str(table_name) in {
                str(existing_table) for existing_table in self._conn._backend_schema_service.list_tables()
            }
            if not existed_before_drop:
                return
        already_collecting_schema_ddl = self._bulk_schema_mode_active()
        self._schema_backend._schema_drop_table(table_name, if_exists=if_exists)
        if not already_collecting_schema_ddl:
            self._execute_schema_plan_terminal()
        if existed_before_drop:
            self._record_table_dropped(SqlTableName(table_name))

    @pure_lazy
    def drop_index(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        index_name: SqlIndexName,
        table_name: SqlTableName | NoTableName = NoTableName(),
        if_exists: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        """Drop an index from the database.

        Args:
            index_name: Name of index to drop
            table_name: Table name (required for some backends like SQLite)
            if_exists: If True, don't raise error if index doesn't exist
        """
        match table_name:
            case NoTableName() | None:
                sql_table_name = None
            case str() as concrete_table_name:
                sql_table_name = SqlTableName(concrete_table_name)
        drop_lookup_table = NoTableName() if sql_table_name is None else sql_table_name
        existed_before_drop = self._index_exists_for_drop(index_name, drop_lookup_table) if if_exists else True
        if if_exists and not existed_before_drop:
            return
        self._schema_backend._schema_drop_index(
            index_name,
            table_name=sql_table_name,
            if_exists=if_exists,
        )
        if existed_before_drop:
            self._record_schema_change(drop_lookup_table)

        *,
        table_name: SqlTableName | NoTableName = NoTableName(),
    ) -> LazyResult[None]:
        """Publish a trigger-drop plan step and project transaction-local schema state."""
        normalized_drop_table_name: SqlTableName | NoTableName
        match table_name:
            case NoTableName() | None:
                normalized_drop_table_name = NoTableName()
            case str() as concrete_table_name:
                normalized_drop_table_name = SqlTableName(concrete_table_name)
        ref_id = self._queue_drop_trigger_step(
            DropTriggerSpec(
                trigger_name=SqlTriggerName(trigger_name),
                table_name=normalized_drop_table_name,
            ),
            if_exists=if_exists,
        )
        self._schema_changed = True
        normalized_table_name = nonempty_str(table_name)
        if normalized_table_name is not None:
            self._touched_tables.add(SqlTableName(normalized_table_name))
        return self.publish_schema_output_lazy(
            operation=LazyOperation(op="ddl_effect"),
            ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(ref_id),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def drop_triggers_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        triggers: Sequence[DropTriggerSpec],
        *,
        if_exists: bool = False,
    ) -> LazyResult[None]:
        """Publish trigger-drop plan steps and project transaction-local schema state."""
        triggers = tuple(triggers)
        specs = tuple(triggers)
        if not specs:
            return LazyResult.of(None)

        ref_id = self._queue_drop_triggers_step(specs, if_exists=if_exists)
        self._schema_changed = True
        for spec in specs:
            normalized = nonempty_str(spec.table_name)
            if normalized is not None:
                self._touched_tables.add(SqlTableName(normalized))
        return self.publish_schema_output_lazy(
            operation=LazyOperation(op="ddl_effect"),
            ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(ref_id),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _index_exists_for_drop(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        index_name: SqlIndexName,
        table_name: SqlTableName | NoTableName,
    ) -> bool:
        """Return whether an index exists before an ``if_exists`` drop."""
        match table_name:
            case SqlTableName():
                return str(index_name) in self.materialized_physical_indexes(table_name)
            case NoTableName():
                pass
        proven_tables = self._proven_existing_table_names_from_connection()
        if type(proven_tables) is NoTableSnapshot:
            snapshot = self._schema_reconciliation_snapshot
            if snapshot is None:
                raise LazyPurityError(
                    f"_index_exists_for_drop({index_name!r}) requires proven table facts or a SchemaStateSnapshot.",
                )
            proven_tables = frozenset(SqlTableName(str(fact.table_name)) for fact in snapshot.table_facts if fact.exists)
        return any(index_name in self.materialized_physical_indexes(candidate_table) for candidate_table in proven_tables)

    @pure_lazy
    def _trigger_exists_for_drop(self: LazySchemaTransaction, trigger_name: SqlTriggerName) -> bool:
        """Use projected facts and let ``IF EXISTS`` handle an unknown physical state."""
        projected = self.projected_trigger_exists(SqlTriggerName(trigger_name))
        return projected is not SchemaFactPresence.ABSENT

    def _view_exists_for_drop(self: LazySchemaTransaction, view_name: SqlViewName) -> bool:
        """Return whether a view exists before an ``if_exists`` drop."""
        return view_name in self._conn.list_views()

    @pure_lazy
    def _queue_drop_trigger_step(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        trigger: DropTriggerSpec,
        *,
        if_exists: bool,
    ) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        return self._queue_drop_triggers_step((trigger,), if_exists=if_exists)

    @pure_lazy
    def _queue_drop_triggers_step(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        triggers: tuple[DropTriggerSpec, ...],
        *,
        if_exists: bool,
    ) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        drop_trigger_module = _drop_trigger_module()

        plan = self.plan()
        ref_id = plan._next_ref()
        skip_empty_bootstrap_drops = self._skip_bootstrap_trigger_drops_for_empty_database
        if skip_empty_bootstrap_drops and if_exists:
            return ref_id
        targets: list[DropTriggerTarget] = []
        for trigger in triggers:
            match trigger.table_name:
                case NoTableName() | None:
                    target_table_name = None
                case str() as concrete_table_name:
                    target_table_name = SqlTableName(concrete_table_name)
            targets.append(
                drop_trigger_module.DropTriggerTarget(
                    SqlTriggerName(trigger.trigger_name),
                    target_table_name,
                ),
            )
        plan.add_step(
            drop_trigger_module.DropTriggersIntent(
                ref_id,
                config=drop_trigger_module.DropTriggersConfig(
                    targets=tuple(targets),
                    if_exists=if_exists,
                ),
            ),
        )
        return ref_id

    def create_fts_index_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        model_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    ) -> LazyResult[None]:
        """Publish an FTS schema-operation plan without sync/async execution thunks."""
        lazy_backend = self._schema_backend

        config_model = _get_fts_index_config_record_model()
        config_table_name = self._get_model_table_name(config_model)
        model_table_name = self._get_model_table_name(model_type)
        touched_tables: set[SqlTableName] = set()
        catalog_models: set[type[Any]] = {config_model}
        normalized_config_table_name = nonempty_str(config_table_name)

            touched_tables.add(SqlTableName(normalized_config_table_name))
        normalized_model_table_name = nonempty_str(model_table_name)
        if normalized_model_table_name is not None:
            touched_tables.add(SqlTableName(normalized_model_table_name))

        self._plan_create_table_from_schema_lazy(config_model, if_not_exists=True)
        self._project_versioned_audit_log_fts_schema_change_lazy(model_type)
        audit_table_name = self._versioned_audit_log_schema_change_table_name(model_type)
        normalized_audit_table_name = nonempty_str(audit_table_name)
        if normalized_audit_table_name is not None:
            touched_tables.add(SqlTableName(normalized_audit_table_name))
        existing_tables = set(touched_tables)

        self._schema_backend._schema_create_fts_index_lazy(self, model_type)
        self._schema_operation_plan.add_operation(
            SchemaOperation(
                kind=SchemaOperationKind.CREATE_FTS_INDEX,
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"fts:{model_type.__name__}"),
                effects=SchemaOperationEffects(
                    touched_tables=frozenset(touched_tables),
                    existing_tables=frozenset(existing_tables),
                    catalog_models=frozenset(catalog_models),
                ),
            ),
        )
        self._schema_changed = True
        self._touched_tables.update(touched_tables)
        return cast(
            "LazyResult[None]",
            LazyResult.of(_grammar_plan_types_module().PlanEffect(ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"schema-fts:{model_type.__name__}"))),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _bootstrap_pgvector_projection_statements(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        model_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        config: VectorIndexConfig,
        *,
        dimensions: int | UnknownVectorDimensions,
    ) -> tuple[tuple[SqlRenderable, ...], SqlTableName, tuple[SqlIndexName, ...]]:
        """Build pgvector projection DDL without mutating schema transaction state."""
        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import VectorMetric
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.pgvector.pgvector import (
            SqlCreateHnswIndex,
            SqlCreateVectorEmbeddingTable,
            SqlCreateVectorScopeIndex,
            SqlCreateVectorSourceIdIndex,
            SqlEnsurePgVectorEmbeddingHelpers,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.sql_table_hnsw.sql_table_hnsw import (
            SqlEnsureSqlTableHnswEmbeddingHelpers,
        )
        from l5200_vector_index.vector_config import resolve_vector_column_spec

        sql_column_name = SqlColumnName
        sql_index_name = SqlIndexName
        sql_table_name = SqlTableName
        grammar_vector_metric = VectorMetric
        sql_create_hnsw_index = SqlCreateHnswIndex
        sql_ensure_pgvector_embedding_helpers = SqlEnsurePgVectorEmbeddingHelpers
        sql_ensure_sql_table_hnsw_embedding_helpers = SqlEnsureSqlTableHnswEmbeddingHelpers
        sql_create_vector_embedding_table = SqlCreateVectorEmbeddingTable
        sql_create_vector_scope_index = SqlCreateVectorScopeIndex
        sql_create_vector_source_id_index = SqlCreateVectorSourceIdIndex

        table_name = get_table_name(model_type)
        embedding_table = f"{table_name}_{config.index_name}_embeddings"
        column_spec = resolve_vector_column_spec(model_type, config)
        match dimensions:
            case UnknownVectorDimensions():
                requested_dimensions = None
            case int() as requested_dimensions:
                pass
        resolved_dimensions = requested_dimensions if column_spec is None or column_spec.dimensions is None else column_spec.dimensions
        metric_to_ops_class = {
            "cosine": "vector_cosine_ops",
            "euclidean": "vector_l2_ops",
            "dot_product": "vector_ip_ops",
        }

        source_id_index = SqlIndexName(sql_index_name(f"idx_{embedding_table}_source_id"))
        scope_index = SqlIndexName(sql_index_name(f"idx_{embedding_table}_branch_revision"))
        index_names: list[SqlIndexName] = [source_id_index, scope_index]
        ddl_statements: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            sql_ensure_pgvector_embedding_helpers(),
            sql_ensure_sql_table_hnsw_embedding_helpers(),
            sql_create_vector_embedding_table(
                sql_table_name(embedding_table),
                dimensions=resolved_dimensions,
                binary_dimensions=config.native_binary_dimensions,
            ),
            sql_create_vector_source_id_index(
                index_name=source_id_index,
                table=sql_table_name(embedding_table),
            ),
            sql_create_vector_scope_index(
                index_name=scope_index,
                table=sql_table_name(embedding_table),
            ),
        ]

        if resolved_dimensions is None:
            return tuple(ddl_statements), SqlTableName(embedding_table), tuple(index_names)
        if not config.resolved_index_policy.approximate_index:
            return tuple(ddl_statements), SqlTableName(embedding_table), tuple(index_names)

        hnsw_index = SqlIndexName(sql_index_name(f"idx_{embedding_table}_embedding_hnsw"))
        index_names.append(hnsw_index)
        ddl_statements.append(
            sql_create_hnsw_index(
                index_name=hnsw_index,
                table=sql_table_name(embedding_table),
                column=sql_column_name("embedding"),
                ops_class=grammar_vector_metric(metric_to_ops_class[config.metric.value]),
                m=config.m,
                ef_construction=config.ef_construction,
            ),
        )
        if config.native_binary_dimensions is not None:
            binary_hnsw_index = SqlIndexName(sql_index_name(f"idx_{embedding_table}_embedding_binary_hamming_hnsw"))
            index_names.append(binary_hnsw_index)
            ddl_statements.append(
                sql_create_hnsw_index(
                    index_name=binary_hnsw_index,
                    table=sql_table_name(embedding_table),
                    column=sql_column_name("embedding_binary"),

    @pure_lazy
    def _build_ddl_effect_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        ddl_sql: SqlRenderable,
        *,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | Unset = UNSET,
    ) -> LazyResult[PlanEffect]:
        """Build one lazy DDL grammar effect and mark transaction-local schema state dirty."""
        plan = self.plan()
        ref_id = plan._next_ref() if ref_id is UNSET or ref_id is None else ref_id
        grammar_execute = _grammar_execute_module()
        ddl_work_product = ddl_sql
        if type(ddl_sql).__name__ != "SqlDdlBundle" and self._conn.backend_type.is_sql_backend:
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.base import render_to_sql

            _rendered_sql, rendered_params = render_to_sql(ddl_sql, self._conn.get_dialect())
            if not rendered_params:
                ddl_work_product = cast(
                    "SqlRenderable",
                    SqlDdlBundle(
                        (ddl_sql,),
                        logical_statement_count=1,
                        logical_source_refs=(ref_id,),
                        logical_phase=SchemaDdlPhase("ordered_bootstrap_ddl"),
                    ),
                )
        ddl_step_types = (
            grammar_execute.DdlEffectStep,
            grammar_execute.BootstrapDdlWorkProductStep,
        )
        last_schema_ddl_ref_id = next(
            (str(step.ref_id) for step in reversed(plan._steps) if type(step) in ddl_step_types),
            None,
        )
        after_refs = (ServerPlanRefId(last_schema_ddl_ref_id),) if last_schema_ddl_ref_id is not None else ()
        step_cls = (
            grammar_execute.BootstrapDdlWorkProductStep
            if type(ddl_work_product).__name__ == "SqlDdlBundle"
            else grammar_execute.DdlEffectStep
        )
        plan.add_step(step_cls(ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(str(ref_id)), stmt=ddl_work_product, after_refs=after_refs))
        if step_cls is grammar_execute.BootstrapDdlWorkProductStep:
            ref_id = self._coalesce_latest_bootstrap_ddl_work_product(ServerPlanRefId(str(ref_id)))
        try:
            transition_records = self._bootstrap_transition_ddl_records
        except AttributeError:
            transition_records = None
        if transition_records is not None:
            rendered_effects = render_cached_ddl_effects(
                ddl_sql,
                self._conn.get_dialect(),
                ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(ref_id),
            )
            if rendered_effects is not None:
                transition_records.extend(rendered_effects)
        effect: LazyResult[PlanEffect] = self.publish_schema_output_lazy(
            operation=LazyOperation(op="ddl_effect"),
            ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(str(ref_id)),
            expected_type=_grammar_plan_types_module().PlanEffect,
            dependency_refs=frozenset({ServerPlanRefId(ref_id)}),
        )
        return effect

    @pure_lazy
    def _coalesce_latest_bootstrap_ddl_work_product(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        work_product_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    ) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        """Combine sequential parameter-free DDL under one canonical producer ref."""

        plan = self.plan()
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.grammar_execute import BootstrapDdlWorkProductStep

        work_product_cls = BootstrapDdlWorkProductStep
        if not plan._steps or str(plan._steps[-1].ref_id) != str(work_product_ref):
            return work_product_ref
        current_step = plan._steps[-1]
        if type(current_step) is not work_product_cls:
            return work_product_ref
        for previous_index in range(len(plan._steps) - 2, -1, -1):
            previous_step = plan._steps[previous_index]
            if type(previous_step) is work_product_cls:
                if current_step.dependencies() != frozenset({str(previous_step.ref_id)}):
                    return work_product_ref
                previous_bundle = cast("SqlDdlBundle", object.__getattribute__(previous_step, "_stmt"))
                current_bundle = cast("SqlDdlBundle", object.__getattribute__(current_step, "_stmt"))
                previous_sources = previous_bundle.logical_source_refs or tuple(
                    previous_step.ref_id for _statement in previous_bundle.statements
                )
                current_sources = current_bundle.logical_source_refs or tuple(
                    current_step.ref_id for _statement in current_bundle.statements
                )
                previous_phase = previous_bundle.logical_phase
                match previous_phase:
                    case SchemaDdlPhase() if previous_phase == current_bundle.logical_phase:
                        shared_phase = previous_phase
                    case _:
                        shared_phase = SchemaDdlPhase("ordered_bootstrap_ddl")
                combined_bundle = SqlDdlBundle(
                    (*previous_bundle.statements, *current_bundle.statements),
                    logical_statement_count=len(previous_bundle.statements) + len(current_bundle.statements),
                    logical_source_refs=(*previous_sources, *current_sources),
                    logical_phase=shared_phase,
                )
                plan._steps[previous_index] = work_product_cls(
                    previous_step.ref_id,
                    cast("SqlRenderable", combined_bundle),
                    tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in previous_step.dependencies()),
                )
                plan._steps.pop()
                return ServerPlanRefId(str(previous_step.ref_id))
            if previous_step.execution_role().value == "sql":
                return work_product_ref
        return work_product_ref

    @pure_lazy
    def column_exists_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        column_name: SqlColumnName,
    ) -> LazyResult[bool]:
        """Check column existence through the schema transaction plan."""
        known = self.projected_or_cached_column_exists(SqlTableName(table_name), SqlColumnName(str(column_name)))
        if known is not SchemaFactPresence.UNKNOWN:
            return LazyResult.of(known is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT)
        columns_by_table = self._schema_backend._load_table_columns_many((SqlTableName(table_name),), self)
        columns = columns_by_table.get(table_name, frozenset())
        return LazyResult.of(column_name in columns)

    @pure_lazy
    def add_column_if_missing_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        column_name: SqlColumnName,
        field_info: FieldInfo,
        *,
        force_nullable: bool = False,
        generated_expression: SqlRenderable | NoGeneratedExpression = NoGeneratedExpression(),
        resolved_annotation: type | NoResolvedAnnotation = NoResolvedAnnotation(),
        snapshot: "SchemaStateSnapshot | NoSchemaStateSnapshot" = NoSchemaStateSnapshot(),
        known_missing: bool = False,
    ) -> LazyResult[None]:
        """Add a column through the explicit schema transaction plan."""
        match generated_expression:
            case NoGeneratedExpression() | None:
                concrete_generated_expression = None
            case concrete_generated_expression:
                pass
        match resolved_annotation:
            case NoResolvedAnnotation() | None:
                concrete_resolved_annotation = None
            case concrete_resolved_annotation:
                pass
        match snapshot:
            case NoSchemaStateSnapshot() | None:
                concrete_snapshot = None
            case concrete_snapshot:
                pass
        normalized_table_name = SqlTableName(table_name)
        normalized_column_name = SqlColumnName(column_name)
        physical_columns = self._bulk_column_snapshots.get(normalized_table_name)
        if physical_columns is None:
            physical_columns = self._schema_physical_column_snapshots.get(normalized_table_name)
        if physical_columns is None and concrete_snapshot is not None and concrete_snapshot.table_exists(normalized_table_name) is True:
            physical_columns = frozenset(SqlColumnName(str(name)) for name in concrete_snapshot.columns_for_table(normalized_table_name))
        projected_exists = self.projected_column_exists(normalized_table_name, normalized_column_name)
        if (
            not known_missing
            and projected_exists is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
            and physical_columns is not None
            and normalized_column_name in physical_columns
        ):
            return LazyResult.of(None)
        if (
            concrete_snapshot is not None
            and concrete_snapshot.table_exists(normalized_table_name) is not True
            and self.bulk_physical_table_exists(normalized_table_name) is not SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
        ):
            return LazyResult.of(None)
        return self._schema_backend._schema_add_column_if_missing_lazy(
            self,
            table_name,
            column_name,
            field_info,
            force_nullable=force_nullable,
            generated_expression=concrete_generated_expression,
            resolved_annotation=concrete_resolved_annotation,
            snapshot=concrete_snapshot,
            known_missing=known_missing,
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def ensure_bootstrap_vector_index_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        payload: BootstrapVectorIndexPrimitivePayload,
        *,
        produced_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        dependency_refs: Sequence[ServerPlanRefId] = (),
    ) -> LazyResult[BootstrapSchemaBatchPlan]:
        dependency_refs = tuple(dependency_refs)
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_schema_plan import (
            BootstrapSchemaColumnFact,
            BootstrapSchemaIndexFact,
            BootstrapSchemaTableFamilyFact,
        )

        from l5200_vector_index.index_resolution import resolve_bootstrap_vector_backend_kind
        from l5200_vector_index.vector_config import (
            get_vector_config,
            get_vector_indexes,
            resolve_vector_index_policy,
        )

        index_artifact_kind = IndexArtifactKind
        index_workload = IndexWorkload
        model_cls = cast("type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]", payload.model_cls)
        indexes = get_vector_indexes(model_cls)
        if not indexes:
            msg = f"{model_cls.__name__} does not have a vector index configured. Use @vector_indexed decorator."
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        config = get_vector_config(model_cls, str(payload.index_name))
        if config is None:
            msg = f"{model_cls.__name__} has no vector index '{payload.index_name}'"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        backend_kind_value = _vector_bootstrap_backend_kind_value(
            self._conn,
            config,
            VectorIndexTableName(str(get_table_name(model_cls))),
            resolve_bootstrap_vector_backend_kind,
        )
        vector_decision = resolve_vector_index_policy(
            config,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            workload=index_workload.SCHEMA_BOOTSTRAP,
            backend_type=self._conn.backend_type,
        )
        statements: list[SqlRenderable] = []
        artifact_table_facts: list[BootstrapSchemaTableFamilyFact] = []
        artifact_column_facts: list[BootstrapSchemaColumnFact] = []
        artifact_index_facts: list[BootstrapSchemaIndexFact] = []
        if backend_kind_value == "pgvector" and index_artifact_kind.EXACT_VECTOR_STORAGE in vector_decision.artifact_kinds:
            statements.append(_pgvector_extension_grammar())
            projection_statements, embedding_table, index_names = self._bootstrap_pgvector_projection_statements(
                model_cls,
                config,
                dimensions=(payload.dimensions if payload.dimensions is not None else UnknownVectorDimensions()),
            )
            statements.extend(projection_statements)
            artifact_table_facts.append(
                BootstrapSchemaTableFamilyFact(
                    primary_table=embedding_table,
                    family_tables=(embedding_table,),
                    schema_hash=SchemaFingerprintHash(
                        hashlib.sha256(
                            f"vector:{payload.table_name}:{payload.index_name}:{payload.config_fingerprint}".encode(),
                        ).hexdigest()[:32],
                    ),
                    source_ref=produced_ref,
                ),
            )
            artifact_index_facts.extend(
                BootstrapSchemaIndexFact(
                    table_name=embedding_table,
                    index_name=index_name,
                    source_ref=produced_ref,
                )
                for index_name in index_names
            )
        elif backend_kind_value == "usearch":
            if self._conn.backend_type is BackendType.SQLITE and not _usearch_requires_cumulative_storage(model_cls):
                source_table = SqlTableName(str(get_table_name(model_cls)))
                native_table = SqlTableName(f"sys_{source_table}_{config.index_name!s}_usearch")
                statements.append(
                    _sqlite_native_usearch_grammar(
                        source_table,
                        config,
                        payload.dimensions if payload.dimensions is not None else UnknownVectorDimensions(),
                    )
                )
                artifact_table_facts.append(
                    BootstrapSchemaTableFamilyFact(
                        primary_table=native_table,
                        family_tables=(native_table,),
                        schema_hash=SchemaFingerprintHash(payload.config_fingerprint[:32]),
                        source_ref=produced_ref,
                    )
                )
            else:
                from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_table_family_work_product import (
                    build_bootstrap_table_family_work_product,
                )
                from l5200_vector_index.hnsw_models import create_usearch_index_class

                usearch_product = build_bootstrap_table_family_work_product(
                    create_usearch_index_class(get_table_name(model_cls)),
                    dialect=self._conn.get_dialect(),
                    fts_nonce=None,
                    json_schema_check_available=None,
                    content_store_table_name=None,
                )
                statements.extend(usearch_product.statements)
                artifact_table_facts.append(
                    BootstrapSchemaTableFamilyFact(
                        primary_table=usearch_product.table_name,
                        family_tables=usearch_product.family_tables,
                        schema_hash=SchemaFingerprintHash(usearch_product.fingerprint[:32]),
                        source_ref=produced_ref,
                    )
                )
                artifact_column_facts.extend(
                    BootstrapSchemaColumnFact(table_name=name, column_name=column_name, source_ref=produced_ref)
                    for name, column_name in usearch_product.column_fact_keys
                )
                artifact_index_facts.extend(
                    BootstrapSchemaIndexFact(table_name=name, index_name=name_index, source_ref=produced_ref)
                    for name, name_index in usearch_product.index_fact_keys
                )
        elif backend_kind_value == "sql_table_hnsw":
            from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_table_family_work_product import build_bootstrap_table_family_work_product
            from l5200_vector_index.hnsw_models import (
                create_hnsw_edge_class,
                create_hnsw_metadata_class,
                create_hnsw_node_class,
            )

            if self._conn.backend_type is not BackendType.SQLITE:
                statements.append(_sql_table_hnsw_embedding_helpers_grammar())
            for hnsw_model in (
                create_hnsw_node_class(get_table_name(model_cls)),
                create_hnsw_edge_class(get_table_name(model_cls)),
                create_hnsw_metadata_class(get_table_name(model_cls)),
            ):
                hnsw_product = build_bootstrap_table_family_work_product(
                    hnsw_model,
                    dialect=self._conn.get_dialect(),
                    fts_nonce=None,
                    json_schema_check_available=None,
                    content_store_table_name=None,
                )
                statements.extend(hnsw_product.statements)
                artifact_table_facts.append(
                    BootstrapSchemaTableFamilyFact(
                        primary_table=hnsw_product.table_name,
                        family_tables=hnsw_product.family_tables,
                        schema_hash=SchemaFingerprintHash(hnsw_product.fingerprint[:32]),
                        source_ref=produced_ref,
                    )
                )
                artifact_column_facts.extend(
                    BootstrapSchemaColumnFact(
                        table_name=table_name,
                        column_name=column_name,
                        source_ref=produced_ref,
                    )
                    for table_name, column_name in hnsw_product.column_fact_keys
                )
                artifact_index_facts.extend(
                    BootstrapSchemaIndexFact(
                        table_name=table_name,
                        index_name=index_name,
                        source_ref=produced_ref,
                    )
                    for table_name, index_name in hnsw_product.index_fact_keys
                )
        elif index_artifact_kind.NATIVE_SEARCH in vector_decision.artifact_kinds:
            msg = f"ENSURE_VECTOR_INDEX has no pure builder for backend vector kind {backend_kind_value!r}"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        if not statements and backend_kind_value not in {"sql_table_hnsw", "usearch"}:
            msg = "ENSURE_VECTOR_INDEX produced no vector artifact DDL"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        work_product = BootstrapVectorIndexWorkProduct(
            name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"vector_index:{payload.table_name}:{payload.index_name}"),
            phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_projection"),
            statements=tuple(statements),
            table_facts=tuple(artifact_table_facts),
            column_facts=tuple(artifact_column_facts),
            index_facts=tuple(artifact_index_facts),
        )
        return self.bootstrap_ddl_work_products_batch_lazy(
            ((produced_ref, work_product, tuple(dependency_refs)),),
            batch_name=SchemaDdlOperationName("bootstrap_vector_indexes"),
        )

    ) -> LazyResult[BootstrapDataPrimitivePlan]:
        """Publish one bootstrap proof-scope marker as an explicit data primitive."""
        dependency_refs = tuple(dependency_refs)
        import json
        from datetime import UTC, datetime
        from hashlib import sha256

        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_state import BootstrapProofScope

        if not payload.manifest_key or not payload.plan_hash:
            msg = "ENSURE_BOOTSTRAP_SCOPE requires manifest_key and plan_hash"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        encoded = json.dumps(
            {
                "scope_key": payload.scope_key,
                "tables": list(payload.table_names),
                "primitive_hash": payload.primitive_hash,
            },
            sort_keys=True,
        ).encode()
        proof_hash = sha256(encoded).hexdigest()
        proof_payload = {
            "required_tables": list(payload.table_names),
            "facts_hash": proof_hash,
        }
        return self.upsert_bootstrap_rows_lazy(
            BootstrapProofScope,
            (
                BootstrapProofScope(
                    manifest_key=payload.manifest_key,
                    plan_hash=payload.plan_hash,
                    scope_key=payload.scope_key,
                    proof_hash=proof_hash,
                    payload_json=json.dumps(proof_payload, sort_keys=True),
                    updated_at=datetime.now(UTC),
                ),
            ),
            conflict_fields=(DynamicFieldName("manifest_key"), DynamicFieldName("scope_key")),
            exclude_fields=(DynamicFieldName("sys_id"),),
            dependency_refs=dependency_refs,
            produced_refs=(produced_ref,),
        )

        model_cls: type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]],
        *,
        enable_logging: bool = True,
        if_not_exists: bool = False,
    ) -> LazyResult[None]:
        """Create a versioned table through the lazy schema plan."""
        lazy_backend = self._schema_backend

        model_name = DiagnosticLabel(model_cls.__name__)
        with _graphql_bootstrap_profile_span(SchemaDdlPhase("create_versioned_table_lazy.conn_create"), scenario_name=model_name):
            schema_effect = lazy_backend._schema_create_versioned_table_lazy(
                self,
                model_cls,
                enable_logging=enable_logging,
                if_not_exists=if_not_exists,
            )
        with _graphql_bootstrap_profile_span(SchemaDdlPhase("create_versioned_table_lazy.project_effects"), scenario_name=model_name):
            self._project_versioned_table_effects(model_cls, enable_logging=enable_logging)
        self._plan_versioned_vector_indexes_lazy(model_cls)
        dependency_refs = list(_schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(schema_effect))
        if model_participates_in_static_naming_metadata(model_cls):
            self._plan_static_naming_metadata_rows_lazy((model_cls,), dependency_refs)
        if not dependency_refs:
            return LazyResult.of(None)
        return _schema_static_value_lazy(self, None, dependency_refs=tuple(dependency_refs))

        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        model_classes: Sequence[type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]]],
        *,
        enable_logging: bool = True,
        if_not_exists: bool = False,
    ) -> LazyResult[None]:
        """Create multiple versioned tables through the lazy schema plan."""
        model_classes = tuple(model_classes)
        models = tuple(model_classes)
        if not models:
            return LazyResult.of(None)
        with _graphql_bootstrap_profile_span(SchemaDdlPhase("create_versioned_tables_lazy.conn_create")):
            schema_effect = self._schema_backend._schema_create_versioned_tables_lazy(
                self,
                models,
                enable_logging=enable_logging,
                if_not_exists=if_not_exists,
            )
        with _graphql_bootstrap_profile_span(SchemaDdlPhase("create_versioned_tables_lazy.project_effects")):
            for model_cls in models:
                self._project_versioned_table_effects(model_cls, enable_logging=enable_logging)
                self._plan_versioned_vector_indexes_lazy(model_cls)
        dependency_refs = list(_schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(schema_effect))
        self._plan_static_naming_metadata_rows_lazy(
            tuple(model_cls for model_cls in models if model_participates_in_static_naming_metadata(model_cls)),
            dependency_refs,
        )
        if not dependency_refs:
            return LazyResult.of(None)
        return _schema_static_value_lazy(self, None, dependency_refs=tuple(dependency_refs))

    @pure_lazy
    def _bootstrap_vector_index_schema_artifacts_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        model_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        *,
        index_name: VectorIndexName | Unset = UNSET,
        dimensions: int | UnknownVectorDimensions = UnknownVectorDimensions(),
    ) -> LazyResult[None]:
        """Lower vector schema artifacts without config persistence side effects."""
        from l5200_vector_index.index_resolution import resolve_bootstrap_vector_backend_kind
        from l5200_vector_index.vector_config import (
            get_vector_config,
            get_vector_indexes,
            resolve_vector_index_policy,
        )

        index_artifact_kind = IndexArtifactKind
        index_workload = IndexWorkload

        indexes = get_vector_indexes(model_type)
        if not indexes:
            msg = f"{model_type.__name__} does not have a vector index configured. Use @vector_indexed decorator."
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if index_name is UNSET:
            if len(indexes) == 1:
                index_name = VectorIndexName(next(iter(indexes.keys())))
            else:
                index_names = ", ".join(sorted(indexes.keys()))
                msg = f"{model_type.__name__} has multiple vector indexes ({index_names}). Specify which one with index_name='name'."
                raise ValueError(msg)

        config = get_vector_config(model_type, index_name)
        if config is None:
            msg = f"{model_type.__name__} has no vector index '{index_name}'"
            raise ValueError(msg)

        self._ensure_shared_vector_embedding_schema()
        backend_kind_value = _vector_bootstrap_backend_kind_value(
            self._conn,
            config,
            VectorIndexTableName(str(get_table_name(model_type))),
            resolve_bootstrap_vector_backend_kind,
        )
        if backend_kind_value == "pgvector" and self._conn.backend_type is BackendType.POSTGRES:
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.pgvector.pgvector import (
                SqlEnsurePgVectorEmbeddingHelpers,
            )

            self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                (
                    _pgvector_extension_grammar(),
                    SqlEnsurePgVectorEmbeddingHelpers(),
                ),
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName("vector_backend:pgvector_extension"),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_backend"),
            )
            _clear_capabilities_cache(self._conn)
        vector_decision = resolve_vector_index_policy(
            config,
            model_cls=model_type,
            workload=index_workload.SCHEMA_BOOTSTRAP,
            backend_type=self._conn.backend_type,
        )
        if backend_kind_value == "pgvector" and index_artifact_kind.EXACT_VECTOR_STORAGE in vector_decision.artifact_kinds:
            self._bootstrap_pgvector_projection_schema(
                model_type,
                config,
                dimensions=dimensions,
            )
        elif backend_kind_value in {"sql_table_hnsw", "usearch"}:
            if self._conn.backend_type is not BackendType.SQLITE:
                self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                    tuple((_sql_table_hnsw_embedding_helpers_grammar(),)),
                    name=SchemaDdlOperationName("vector_backend:sql_table_hnsw_helpers"),
                    phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_backend"),
                )
            if backend_kind_value == "sql_table_hnsw":
                self._schema_backend._ensure_vector_index_aux_tables_lazy(self, model_type)
            elif self._conn.backend_type is BackendType.SQLITE and not _usearch_requires_cumulative_storage(model_type):
                source_table = SqlTableName(str(get_table_name(model_type)))
                self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                    (_sqlite_native_usearch_grammar(source_table, config, dimensions),),
                    name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"vector_backend:native_usearch:{source_table}:{config.index_name!s}"),
                    phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_backend"),
                )
                self._record_schema_change(SqlTableName(f"sys_{source_table}_{config.index_name!s}_usearch"))
            else:
                from l5200_vector_index.hnsw_models import create_usearch_index_class

                self._schema_backend._schema_create_table_from_schema_lazy(
                    self,
                    create_usearch_index_class(str(get_table_name(model_type))),
                    if_not_exists=True,
                )
        # Non-SQL-table vector backends own their search artifacts outside SQL
        # schema planning; this transaction records schema dependencies only.
        self._record_schema_change(self._get_model_table_name(model_type))
        return _schema_static_value_lazy(
            self,
            None,
            dependency_refs=self._schema_ddl_dependency_refs(),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _persist_direct_vector_config_metadata_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        model_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        config: VectorIndexConfig,
        backend_kind_value: VectorBackendKind,
        *,
        dimensions: int | UnknownVectorDimensions,
    ) -> None:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import (
            SqlColumnList,
            SqlOnConflict,
            SqlValuesClause,
            SqlValuesRow,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import ConflictAction
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlInlineLiteral
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlInsert
        from l1000_schema.column_utils import get_db_column_name

        vector_record_model = _get_vector_index_config_record_model()
        index_policy = config.resolved_index_policy
        requested_implementation = index_policy.requested_implementation
        effective_implementation = VectorIndexEffectiveImplementation(backend_kind_value)
        artifact_format_version = CURRENT_VECTOR_ARTIFACT_FORMATS[effective_implementation]
        table_name = str(get_table_name(model_type))
        index_name = str(config.index_name)
        metric = config.metric.value
        strategy = str(config.strategy.value)
        storage_precision = config.precision_hint.value if config.precision_hint is not None else None
        match dimensions:
            case UnknownVectorDimensions():
                requested_dimensions = None
            case int() as concrete_dimensions:
                requested_dimensions = concrete_dimensions
        persisted_dimensions = config.dimensions if config.dimensions is not None else requested_dimensions
        from l3200_metadata.hashing import compute_vector_config_hash

        config_hash = SchemaFingerprintHash(
            compute_vector_config_hash(
                index_name=SqlIndexName(index_name),
                metric=metric,
                strategy=strategy,
                dimensions=persisted_dimensions,
                storage_precision=storage_precision,
                target_dimensions=config.target_dimensions,
                hnsw_m=config.m,
                hnsw_ef_construction=config.ef_construction,
                hnsw_ef_search=config.ef_search,
                index_policy_scope=index_policy.scope.value,
                index_policy_maintenance=index_policy.maintenance.value,
                native_index=index_policy.native_index,
                approximate_index=index_policy.approximate_index,
                batch_size=config.batch_size,
                requested_implementation=requested_implementation,
                effective_implementation=effective_implementation,
                artifact_format_version=artifact_format_version,
            )
        )
        values_by_field: dict[str, str | int | float | bool | None] = {
            "sys_id": str(SysId.new()),
            "table_name": table_name,
            "index_name": index_name,
            "requested_implementation": requested_implementation.value,
            "backend_kind": effective_implementation.value,
            "artifact_format_version": int(artifact_format_version),
            "metric": metric,
            "strategy": strategy,
            "dimensions": persisted_dimensions,
            "target_dimensions": config.target_dimensions,
            "storage_precision": storage_precision,
            "hnsw_m": config.m,
            "hnsw_ef_construction": config.ef_construction,
            "hnsw_ef_search": config.ef_search,
            "batch_size": config.batch_size,
            "index_policy_scope": index_policy.scope.value,
            "index_policy_maintenance": index_policy.maintenance.value,
            "native_index": index_policy.native_index,
            "approximate_index": index_policy.approximate_index,
            "searchable_row_schema_version": 1,
            "config_hash": config_hash,
        }
        field_names = tuple(values_by_field)
        db_columns = tuple(get_db_column_name(vector_record_model, DynamicFieldName(field_name)) for field_name in field_names)
        conflict_columns = (
            SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(vector_record_model, DynamicFieldName("table_name"))),
            SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(vector_record_model, DynamicFieldName("index_name"))),
        )
        immutable_selection_columns = {
            "sys_id",
            "table_name",
            "index_name",
            "requested_implementation",
            "backend_kind",
            "artifact_format_version",
            "config_hash",
        }
        update_columns = tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in db_columns if column not in immutable_selection_columns)
        statement = SqlInsert(
            SqlTableName(get_table_name(vector_record_model)),
            columns=SqlColumnList([SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column)) for column in db_columns]),
            values=SqlValuesClause(
                [
                    SqlValuesRow(
                        [SqlParam(values_by_field[field_name]) for field_name in field_names],
                    ),
                ],
            ),
            on_conflict=SqlOnConflict(
                conflict_columns,
                ConflictAction.DO_UPDATE,
                update_columns=update_columns,
            ),
        )
        self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
            (statement,),
            name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"vector_config_metadata:{table_name}:{index_name}"),
            phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_config_metadata"),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def create_vector_index_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        model_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        *,
        index_name: VectorIndexName | Unset = UNSET,
        dimensions: int | UnknownVectorDimensions = UnknownVectorDimensions(),
    ) -> LazyResult[None]:
        """Create vector index for a model with @vector_indexed decorator.

        This creates the embedding storage table and configures the appropriate
        vector index for the backend:

        - PostgreSQL: Uses pgvector HNSW index
        - MongoDB: Uses Atlas Vector Search (requires Atlas M10+)
        - Neo4j: Uses native vector indexes (5.11+)
        - SQLite, MariaDB, DoltDB: Uses HNSW polyfill

        Design reference:
            ``docs/design/HNSW_SERVERPLAN_MAINTENANCE_REARCHITECTURE.md``

        Args:
            model_type: Model class with @vector_indexed decorator
            index_name: Name of the index (required if multiple, optional if single)
            dimensions: Embedding dimensions (required for Neo4j, optional for others)

        Raises:
            ValueError: If model doesn't have vector configuration
            RuntimeError: If backend doesn't support vector indexes

        Example::

            @vector_indexed("content")
            class Document(ApplicationObjectRow):
                content: str

            with conn.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema_txn:
                schema_txn.create_table_from_schema(Document)
                schema_txn.create_vector_index(Document, dimensions=1536)
        """
        from l5200_vector_index.index_resolution import resolve_bootstrap_vector_backend_kind
        from l5200_vector_index.vector_config import (
            get_vector_config,
            get_vector_indexes,
            resolve_vector_index_policy,
        )

        index_artifact_kind = IndexArtifactKind
        index_workload = IndexWorkload

        indexes = get_vector_indexes(model_type)
        if not indexes:
            msg = f"{model_type.__name__} does not have a vector index configured. Use @vector_indexed decorator."
            raise ValueError(msg)

        # Auto-select if single index
        if index_name is UNSET:
            if len(indexes) == 1:
                index_name = VectorIndexName(next(iter(indexes.keys())))
            else:
                index_names = ", ".join(sorted(indexes.keys()))
                msg = f"{model_type.__name__} has multiple vector indexes ({index_names}). Specify which one with index_name='name'."
                raise ValueError(msg)

        config = get_vector_config(model_type, index_name)
        if config is None:
            msg = f"{model_type.__name__} has no vector index '{index_name}'"
            raise ValueError(msg)

        vector_index_config_record = _get_vector_index_config_record_model()
        vector_config_table_name = SqlTableName(get_table_name(vector_index_config_record))
        if self.projected_or_cached_table_exists(vector_config_table_name) is not SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT:
            with self._schema_table_exists_cache_mutation_scope():
                self._schema_backend._schema_create_table_from_schema_lazy(
                    self,
                    vector_index_config_record,
                    if_not_exists=True,
                )

        # Bootstrap the shared vector schema explicitly inside the active schema
        # transaction rather than relying on a nested helper transaction.
        self._ensure_shared_vector_embedding_schema()

        backend_kind_value = _vector_bootstrap_backend_kind_value(
            self._conn,
            config,
            VectorIndexTableName(str(get_table_name(model_type))),
            resolve_bootstrap_vector_backend_kind,
        )
        if backend_kind_value == "pgvector" and self._conn.backend_type is BackendType.POSTGRES:
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.pgvector.pgvector import (
                SqlEnsurePgVectorEmbeddingHelpers,
            )

            self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                (
                    _pgvector_extension_grammar(),
                    SqlEnsurePgVectorEmbeddingHelpers(),
                ),
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName("vector_backend:pgvector_extension"),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_backend"),
            )
            _clear_capabilities_cache(self._conn)
        vector_decision = resolve_vector_index_policy(
            config,
            model_cls=model_type,
            workload=index_workload.SCHEMA_BOOTSTRAP,
            backend_type=self._conn.backend_type,
        )
        if backend_kind_value == "pgvector" and index_artifact_kind.EXACT_VECTOR_STORAGE in vector_decision.artifact_kinds:
            self._bootstrap_pgvector_projection_schema(
                model_type,
                config,
                dimensions=dimensions,
            )
        elif backend_kind_value in {"sql_table_hnsw", "usearch"}:
            if self._conn.backend_type is not BackendType.SQLITE:
                self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                    tuple((_sql_table_hnsw_embedding_helpers_grammar(),)),
                    name=SchemaDdlOperationName("vector_backend:sql_table_hnsw_helpers"),
                    phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_backend"),
                )
            if backend_kind_value == "sql_table_hnsw":
                self._schema_backend._ensure_vector_index_aux_tables_lazy(self, model_type)
            elif self._conn.backend_type is BackendType.SQLITE and not _usearch_requires_cumulative_storage(model_type):
                source_table = SqlTableName(str(get_table_name(model_type)))
                self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                    (_sqlite_native_usearch_grammar(source_table, config, dimensions),),
                    name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"vector_backend:native_usearch:{source_table}:{config.index_name!s}"),
                    phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_backend"),
                )
                self._record_schema_change(SqlTableName(f"sys_{source_table}_{config.index_name!s}_usearch"))
            else:
                from l5200_vector_index.hnsw_models import create_usearch_index_class

                self._schema_backend._schema_create_table_from_schema_lazy(
                    self,
                    create_usearch_index_class(str(get_table_name(model_type))),
                    if_not_exists=True,
                )

        # Non-SQL-table vector backends own their search artifacts outside SQL
        # schema planning; this transaction persists their configuration only.
        self._persist_direct_vector_config_metadata_lazy(
            model_type,
            config,
            backend_kind_value,
            dimensions=dimensions,
        )
        self._record_schema_change(self._get_model_table_name(model_type))
        return _schema_static_value_lazy(
            self,
            None,
            dependency_refs=self._schema_ddl_dependency_refs(),
        )

    @external_io_boundary
    def flush_schema_plan(self: LazySchemaTransaction, *, run_callbacks: bool = True) -> None:
        """Resolve pending bulk schema effects in one ServerPlan flush."""
        assert_no_schema_ddl_in_lazy_context(
            operation="SyncSchemaTransaction.flush_schema_plan()",
        )
        pending_count = self._pending_schema_ddl_work_count()
        if pending_count == 0:
            _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(DiagnosticLabel("schema_flush_skipped"), DiagnosticLabel("sync_empty"))
            return
        reason = "schema_phases" if run_callbacks else "pre_phase_boundary"
        if pending_count >= _MAX_BULK_SCHEMA_DDL_EFFECTS_PER_FLUSH:
            reason = "max_pending_effects"
        elif self._bulk_schema_mode_active():
            reason = f"bulk:{reason}"
        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(DiagnosticLabel("schema_flush"), DiagnosticLabel("sync"))
        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(DiagnosticLabel("schema_flush_reason"), DiagnosticLabel(reason))
        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(DiagnosticLabel("schema_flush_pending_effects"), DiagnosticLabel("sync"), pending_count)
        self._execute_schema_plan_terminal()

    @external_io_boundary
    def _bootstrap_pgvector_projection_schema(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        model_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        config: VectorIndexConfig,
        *,
        dimensions: int | UnknownVectorDimensions,
    ) -> None:
        """Create explicit pgvector projection tables and indexes during bootstrap."""
        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import VectorMetric
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.pgvector.pgvector import (
            SqlCreateHnswIndex,
            SqlCreateVectorEmbeddingTable,
            SqlCreateVectorScopeIndex,
            SqlCreateVectorSourceIdIndex,
            SqlEnsurePgVectorEmbeddingHelpers,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.sql_table_hnsw.sql_table_hnsw import (
            SqlEnsureSqlTableHnswEmbeddingHelpers,
        )
        from l5200_vector_index.vector_config import resolve_vector_column_spec

        sql_column_name = SqlColumnName
        sql_index_name = SqlIndexName
        sql_table_name = SqlTableName
        grammar_vector_metric = VectorMetric
        sql_create_hnsw_index = SqlCreateHnswIndex
        sql_ensure_pgvector_embedding_helpers = SqlEnsurePgVectorEmbeddingHelpers
        sql_ensure_sql_table_hnsw_embedding_helpers = SqlEnsureSqlTableHnswEmbeddingHelpers
        sql_create_vector_embedding_table = SqlCreateVectorEmbeddingTable
        sql_create_vector_scope_index = SqlCreateVectorScopeIndex
        sql_create_vector_source_id_index = SqlCreateVectorSourceIdIndex

        table_name = get_table_name(model_type)
        embedding_table = f"{table_name}_{config.index_name}_embeddings"
        column_spec = resolve_vector_column_spec(model_type, config)
        match dimensions:
            case UnknownVectorDimensions():
                requested_dimensions = None
            case int() as requested_dimensions:
                pass
        resolved_dimensions = requested_dimensions if column_spec is None or column_spec.dimensions is None else column_spec.dimensions
        metric_to_ops_class = {
            "cosine": "vector_cosine_ops",
            "euclidean": "vector_l2_ops",
            "dot_product": "vector_ip_ops",
        }

        ddl_statements: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            sql_ensure_pgvector_embedding_helpers(),
            sql_ensure_sql_table_hnsw_embedding_helpers(),
            sql_create_vector_embedding_table(
                sql_table_name(embedding_table),
                dimensions=resolved_dimensions,
                binary_dimensions=config.native_binary_dimensions,
            ),
            sql_create_vector_source_id_index(
                index_name=SqlIndexName(sql_index_name(f"idx_{embedding_table}_source_id")),
                table=sql_table_name(embedding_table),
            ),
            sql_create_vector_scope_index(
                index_name=SqlIndexName(sql_index_name(f"idx_{embedding_table}_branch_revision")),
                table=sql_table_name(embedding_table),
            ),
        ]
        self._record_schema_change(SqlTableName(embedding_table))

        from l5200_vector_index.vector_config import resolve_vector_index_policy

        index_artifact_kind = IndexArtifactKind
        index_workload = IndexWorkload
        decision = resolve_vector_index_policy(
            config,
            model_cls=model_type,
            workload=index_workload.SCHEMA_BOOTSTRAP,
            backend_type=self._conn.backend_type,
        )
        if resolved_dimensions is None or index_artifact_kind.APPROXIMATE_VECTOR not in decision.artifact_kinds:
            self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                tuple(ddl_statements),
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"vector_projection:{embedding_table}"),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_projection"),
            )
            return
        if not config.resolved_index_policy.approximate_index:
            self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                tuple(ddl_statements),
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"vector_projection:{embedding_table}"),
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_projection"),
            )
            return

        ddl_statements.append(
            sql_create_hnsw_index(
                index_name=SqlIndexName(sql_index_name(f"idx_{embedding_table}_embedding_hnsw")),
                table=sql_table_name(embedding_table),
                column=sql_column_name("embedding"),
                ops_class=grammar_vector_metric(metric_to_ops_class[config.metric.value]),
                m=config.m,
                ef_construction=config.ef_construction,
            ),
        )
        if config.native_binary_dimensions is not None:
            ddl_statements.append(
                sql_create_hnsw_index(
                    index_name=SqlIndexName(sql_index_name(f"idx_{embedding_table}_embedding_binary_hamming_hnsw")),
                    table=sql_table_name(embedding_table),
                    column=sql_column_name("embedding_binary"),
                    ops_class=grammar_vector_metric("bit_hamming_ops"),
                    m=config.m,
                    ef_construction=config.ef_construction,
                ),
            )
        self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
            tuple(ddl_statements),
            name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"vector_projection:{embedding_table}"),
            phase=SchemaDdlPhase("vector_projection"),
        )

    # Introspection Methods

class AsyncSchemaTransaction(
    AsyncSchemaTransactionContextMixin,
    SyncSchemaTransactionContextMixin,
    LazySchemaTransaction,
):
    """Async schema transaction for native async DDL execution paths."""

    @external_io_boundary
    def _exit_sync(
        self,
        exception_state: SchemaExitExceptionState,
    ) -> None:
        del exception_state
        msg = "Use 'async with conn.schema_transaction_async(...)' for async schema work."
        raise db_exc.ProgrammingError(msg)

    @external_io_boundary
    async def _enter_async(self) -> AsyncSchemaTransaction:
        if self._entered or self._exited:
            msg = "Schema transaction context manager can only be entered once"
            raise db_exc.ProgrammingError(msg)

        authority_context = explicit_execution_authority()
        authority_context.__enter__()
        self._explicit_authority_context = authority_context
        try:
            conn = self._prepare_schema_enter_common(operation=ConnectionOperationName("async schema transaction"))
            if not in_bootstrap_schema_write_boundary() and not _is_admin_session():
                lockdown_mode = await get_lockdown_mode_async(
                    cast("AsyncDatabaseConnection", self._conn),
                    session_id=self._session_id,
                )
                if lockdown_mode is not LockdownMode.UNLOCKED:
                    raise DDLLockdownError(lockdown_mode)
            self._activate_enter_state(conn)
            await self._finish_enter_after_lockdown_async(log_label=DiagnosticLabel("__aenter__"))
            return self
        except BaseException:
            self._exit_explicit_authority_context()
            raise

    async def __aenter__(self) -> AsyncSchemaTransaction:
        record_profile_counter(ProfileCounterName("schema_transaction_enter_async"))
        return await self._enter_async()

    @external_io_boundary
    async def _cleanup_failed_enter_async(self, *, log_label: DiagnosticLabel) -> None:
        """Clean up partially opened async schema work without swallowing failures."""
        await super()._cleanup_failed_enter_async(log_label=log_label)

    @external_io_boundary
    async def _exit_async(
        self,
        exception_state: SchemaExitExceptionState,
    ) -> None:
        try:
            with _bootstrap_profile_span(SchemaDdlPhase("schema_transaction.finalize_exit_async")):
                committed, cleanup_errors = await self._finalize_exit_async(
                    exception_state,
                    mode_label=DiagnosticLabel("async"),
                    cleanup_label=DiagnosticLabel("async cleanup"),
                    commit=self._commit_schema_transaction_async,
                    rollback=self._rollback_schema_transaction_async,
                )
            post_commit_error: Exception | None = None
            if committed:
                try:
                    with _bootstrap_profile_span(SchemaDdlPhase("schema_transaction.post_commit_steps_async")):
                        await self._run_post_commit_steps_async(
                            invalidate=self._post_commit_schema_invalidation_async,
                        )
                except Exception as exc:
                    post_commit_error = exc
            original_error: BaseException | Unset
            match exception_state.exception_value:
                case NoExceptionValue():
                    original_error = UNSET
                case BaseException() as concrete_error:
                    original_error = concrete_error
            self._raise_deferred_exit_errors(
                cleanup_label=DiagnosticLabel("async cleanup"),
                cleanup_errors=tuple(cleanup_errors),
                post_commit_error=UNSET if post_commit_error is None else post_commit_error,
                original_error=original_error,
            )
        finally:
            self._exit_explicit_authority_context()

    # transactions. Schema mutation is plan construction via
    # create_table_from_schema_lazy; the async context owns execution at exit.
    # Never restore an async eager/delegate facade for this operation.

    @external_io_boundary
    async def bulk_schema_context_async(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> AsyncGenerator[None]:
        """Async counterpart of :meth:`bulk_schema_context`."""
        from l2055_lazy_result.purity import intent_build_context_lazy

        outermost = self._bulk_schema_depth == 0
        self._bulk_schema_depth += 1
        should_flush = False
        try:
            if outermost:
                proven_tables = self._proven_existing_table_names_from_connection()
                observed_tables = (
                    proven_tables
                    if proven_tables is not None and type(proven_tables) is not NoTableSnapshot
                    else frozenset(SqlTableName(str(table_name)) for table_name in await self._conn._list_tables_under_authority_async())
                )
                self._bulk_table_names_snapshot = frozenset(SqlTableName(str(table_name)) for table_name in observed_tables)
                table_info_by_name: dict[SqlTableName, tuple[TableInfoRow, ...]] = {}
                for table_name in self._bulk_table_names_snapshot:
                    normalized_table_name = SqlTableName(table_name)
                    table_info_by_name[normalized_table_name] = tuple(
                        await self._conn._backend_schema_service.get_table_info_async(
                            normalized_table_name,
                        ),
                    )
                self._schema_reconciliation_snapshot = self._build_bulk_observation_snapshot(
                    tuple(table_info_by_name.items()),
                )
            with intent_build_context_lazy():
                yield
            should_flush = True
        finally:
            self._bulk_schema_depth -= 1
            if self._bulk_schema_depth == 0:
                try:
                    if should_flush:
                        with _graphql_bootstrap_profile_span(SchemaDdlPhase("bulk_schema_context_async.flush_schema_plan")):
                            await self.flush_schema_plan_async()
                finally:
                    self._bulk_backend_executors.clear()
                    self._bulk_table_names_snapshot = None
                    self._bulk_column_snapshots.clear()

    @external_io_boundary
    async def flush_schema_plan_async(self: LazySchemaTransaction, *, run_callbacks: bool = True) -> None:
        """Async callback-aware schema plan flush."""
        assert_no_schema_ddl_in_lazy_context(
            operation="AsyncSchemaTransaction.flush_schema_plan_async()",
        )
        pending_count = self._pending_schema_ddl_work_count()
        if pending_count == 0:
            _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(DiagnosticLabel("schema_flush_skipped"), DiagnosticLabel("async_empty"))
            return
        reason = "schema_phases" if run_callbacks else "pre_phase_boundary"
        if pending_count >= _MAX_BULK_SCHEMA_DDL_EFFECTS_PER_FLUSH:
            reason = "max_pending_effects"
        elif self._bulk_schema_mode_active():
            reason = f"bulk:{reason}"
        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(DiagnosticLabel("schema_flush"), DiagnosticLabel("async"))
        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(DiagnosticLabel("schema_flush_reason"), DiagnosticLabel(f"async:{reason}"))
        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(DiagnosticLabel("schema_flush_pending_effects"), DiagnosticLabel("async"), pending_count)
        with _graphql_bootstrap_profile_span(
            SchemaDdlPhase("flush_schema_plan_async.pending_effects"),
            scenario_name=DiagnosticLabel(f"run_callbacks={run_callbacks}"),
        ):
            await self._execute_schema_plan_terminal_async()
