class _SqlDirectExecutionPlanningMixin:
    """Direct execution planning and driver result shaping."""

    _allow_raw_result_fetch: bool
    _assert_sync_io_allowed: Any
    _driver_fetchall: Any
    _driver_fetchone: Any
    _prepare_terminal_execution: Any
    _raise_if_unscoped_mysql_published_relation: Any
    _ensure_async_mode_async: Any
    _driver_query_async: Any
    _driver_fetchone_async: Any
    _driver_fetchall_async: Any

    def _fetchall(self: Any) -> tuple[DatabaseRow, ...]:
        """Return all rows from the most recent cursor (guarded).

        Enforces that all result fetching happens within ServerPlan context.
        Backends implement ``_driver_fetchall`` instead.
        """
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.execution_guard import assert_in_plan_context

        self._assert_sync_io_allowed("_fetchall")
        if getattr(self, "_allow_raw_result_fetch", False):
            self._allow_raw_result_fetch = False
            return tuple(cast("Sequence[DatabaseRow]", self._driver_fetchall()))
        assert_in_plan_context("_fetchall")
        return tuple(cast("Sequence[DatabaseRow]", self._driver_fetchall()))

    def _fetchone(self: Any) -> DatabaseRow | None:
        """Return one row from the most recent cursor (guarded).

        Enforces that all result fetching happens within ServerPlan context.
        Backends implement ``_driver_fetchone`` instead.
        """
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.execution_guard import assert_in_plan_context

        self._assert_sync_io_allowed("_fetchone")
        if getattr(self, "_allow_raw_result_fetch", False):
            self._allow_raw_result_fetch = False
            return cast("DatabaseRow | None", self._driver_fetchone())
        assert_in_plan_context("_fetchone")
        return cast("DatabaseRow | None", self._driver_fetchone())

    @abstractmethod
    def _rowcount(self: Any) -> int:
        """Return number of rows affected by last operation."""

    def _build_direct_execution_plan(
        self: Any,
        sql_str: str,
        params: SqlParamTuple,
        *,
        fetch_mode: _DirectFetchMode = "none",
        use_savepoint_recovery: bool = True,
        prerender_info: QueryPrerenderInfo | None = None,
        track_rtt: bool = True,
        requires_connection_local_schema_authority: bool = False,
    ) -> _DirectGrammarExecutionPlan:
        """Build a shared direct-execution plan for SQL backends.

        Backends may override this to attach additional execution metadata while
        preserving the compiled SQL, params, fetch mode, and prerender info.
        ``use_savepoint_recovery`` is advisory at this layer and exists so
        backend-specific plans can opt into statement-level recovery envelopes.
        """
        del use_savepoint_recovery
        return _DirectGrammarExecutionPlan(
            sql=sql_str,
            params=params,
            prerender_info=prerender_info,
            fetch_mode=fetch_mode,
            track_rtt=track_rtt,
            requires_connection_local_schema_authority=requires_connection_local_schema_authority,
        )

    def _prepare_direct_execution_plan(
        self: Any,
        stmt: SqlRenderable,
        *,
        params: SqlParamTuple | None = None,
        external_params_first: bool = False,
        fetch_mode: _DirectFetchMode = "none",
        use_savepoint_recovery: bool = True,
        track_rtt: bool = True,
    ) -> _DirectGrammarExecutionPlan:
        """Prepare terminal SQL and wrap it in a shared direct-execution plan."""
        needs_returning = fetch_mode != "none"
        if params is None:
            prepared = self._prepare_terminal_execution(stmt, needs_returning=needs_returning)
        else:
            prepared = self._prepare_terminal_execution(
                stmt,
                params=params,
                external_params_first=external_params_first,
                needs_returning=needs_returning,
            )
        self._raise_if_unscoped_mysql_published_relation(prepared.sql)
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_connection_schema import (
            is_connection_local_schema_statement,
        )

        enforce_statement_capacity(
            rendered_sql_bytes=len(prepared.sql.encode("utf-8")),
            parameter_count=len(prepared.params),
            capacity=self._sql_statement_capacity(),
        )
        plan = cast(
            "_DirectGrammarExecutionPlan",
            self._build_direct_execution_plan(
                prepared.sql,
                cast(SqlParamTuple, prepared.params),
                fetch_mode=fetch_mode,
                use_savepoint_recovery=use_savepoint_recovery,
                prerender_info=prepared.prerender_info,
                track_rtt=track_rtt,
                requires_connection_local_schema_authority=is_connection_local_schema_statement(stmt),
            ),
        )
        if prepared.connection_local_statements:
            from dataclasses import replace

            return replace(
                plan,
                connection_local_statements=prepared.connection_local_statements,
            )
        return plan

    @pure_lazy
    def _build_direct_execution_request(
        self: Any,
        stmt: SqlRenderable,
        *,
        params: SqlParamTuple | None = None,
        external_params_first: bool = False,
        fetch_mode: _DirectFetchMode = "none",
        use_savepoint_recovery: bool = True,
        result_mode: _DirectResultMode = "raw",
    ) -> _DirectGrammarExecutionRequest:
        """Build a lazy direct-execution request."""
        return _DirectGrammarExecutionRequest(
            stmt=stmt,
            params=params,
            external_params_first=external_params_first,
            fetch_mode=fetch_mode,
            use_savepoint_recovery=use_savepoint_recovery,
            result_mode=result_mode,
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _transform_direct_fetchone_result(value: _DirectExecutionResult) -> DatabaseRow | None:
        """Narrow a direct execution result for fetch-one wrappers."""
        if value is None or isinstance(value, DatabaseRow):
            return value
        msg = f"Expected DatabaseRow | None, got {type(value)!r}"
        raise TypeError(msg)

    @staticmethod
    def _transform_direct_fetchall_result(value: _DirectExecutionResult) -> list[DatabaseRow]:
        """Narrow a direct execution result for fetch-all wrappers."""
        if value is None:
            msg = "Direct fetch-all execution returned no rows object"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        return list(value)

    @pure_lazy
    def _queue_direct_plan_lazy(
        self: Any,
        request: _DirectGrammarExecutionRequest,
        *,
        op: Literal["execute_raw", "first", "execute"],
    ) -> LazyResult[_DirectExecutionResult]:
        """Wrap a direct execution request in a lazy result."""
        operation: LazyOperation[_DirectExecutionResult] = LazyOperation(
            op=op,
            payload=LazyQueryPayload(request),
        )
        return _SqlDirectLazyContext(self).queue_single(operation)

    async def _query_raw_sql_async[ParamsItemT](
        self: Any,
        sql_str: str,
        params: tuple[ParamsItemT, ...],
        prerender_info: QueryPrerenderInfo | None = None,
    ) -> AsyncCursorHandle:
        """Async version of _execute_raw_sql that returns a cursor (guarded).

        Enforces that all async query execution happens within ServerPlan context.
        Backends implement ``_driver_query_async`` instead.

        Returns:
            Cursor object (type varies by backend)
        """
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.execution_guard import assert_in_plan_context

        await self._ensure_async_mode_async()
        assert_in_plan_context("_query_raw_sql_async")
        return await self._driver_query_async(
            sql_str,
            _resolve_lazy_params(params),
            prerender_info=prerender_info,
        )

    async def _fetchone_async(
        self: Any,
        cursor: AsyncCursorHandle,
    ) -> DatabaseRow | None:
        """Fetch one row from async cursor (guarded).

        Enforces that all async result fetching happens within ServerPlan context.
        Backends implement ``_driver_fetchone_async`` instead.
        """
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.execution_guard import assert_in_plan_context

        await self._ensure_async_mode_async()
        assert_in_plan_context("_fetchone_async")
        return cast("DatabaseRow | None", await self._driver_fetchone_async(cursor))

    async def _fetchall_async(
        self: Any,
        cursor: AsyncCursorHandle,
    ) -> tuple[DatabaseRow, ...]:
        """Fetch all rows from async cursor (guarded).

        Enforces that all async result fetching happens within ServerPlan context.
        Backends implement ``_driver_fetchall_async`` instead.
        """
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.execution_guard import assert_in_plan_context

        await self._ensure_async_mode_async()
        assert_in_plan_context("_fetchall_async")
        return tuple(cast("Sequence[DatabaseRow]", await self._driver_fetchall_async(cursor)))


class _SqlLazyPlanEffectMixin:
    """Lazy SQL plan references and data effect scheduling."""

    def _plan_effect_content_store_table_name_lazy(self: Any, model_cls: type) -> SqlTableName:
        return SqlTableName(self._get_content_store_table_name(model_cls))

    def _enqueue_data_effect(
        self: Any,
        stmt: SqlRenderable,
        *,
        params: SqlParamTuple | None = None,
        external_params_first: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        self._add_data_effect_step(
            stmt,
            params=params,
            external_params_first=external_params_first,
        )

    async def _enqueue_data_effect_async(
        self: Any,
        stmt: SqlRenderable,
        *,
        params: SqlParamTuple | None = None,
        external_params_first: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        self._add_data_effect_step(
            stmt,
            params=params,
            external_params_first=external_params_first,
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _add_data_effect_step(
        self: Any,
        stmt: SqlRenderable,
        *,
        params: SqlParamTuple | None,
        external_params_first: bool,
    ) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        plan = self._plan_for_sql_lazy()
        ref_id = plan._next_ref()
        plan.add_step(
            GrammarEffectStep(
                ref_id=ref_id,
                stmt=stmt,
                params=params,
                config=_GrammarExecuteConfig(
                    reads=frozenset(),
                    writes=frozenset(),
                    external_params_first=external_params_first,
                ),
            ),
        )
        return cast("ServerPlanRefId", ref_id)

    @pure_lazy
    def _plan_for_sql_lazy(self: Any) -> BaseServerPlan:
        owner = self._plan_owner_for_sql()
        get_lazy_plan = getattr(owner, "_get_lazy_plan", None)
        if callable(get_lazy_plan):
            plan = get_lazy_plan()
        else:
            plan_method = getattr(owner, "plan", None)
            if not callable(plan_method):
                msg = f"{type(owner).__name__} does not expose a ServerPlan"
                raise TypeError(msg)
            plan = plan_method()
        return cast("BaseServerPlan", plan)

    @pure_lazy
    def _publish_sql_lazy_ref[R](
        self: Any,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | str,
        *,
        op: LazyDelegatedQueryOpType = "query_value",
        expected_type: type[R] | None = None,
    ) -> LazyResult[R]:
        owner = self._plan_owner_for_sql()
        publish = getattr(owner, "_publish_pending_lazy_ref", None)
        if callable(publish):
            return cast("LazyResult[R]", publish(str(ref_id), op=op, expected_type=expected_type))

        plan = self._plan_for_sql_lazy()
        return LazyResult.published_ref(
            operation=LazyOperation(op=op),
            context=plan._flush_ctx,
            ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(ref_id),
            expected_type=expected_type,
        )

    def _lazy_dependency_ref[T](self: Any, lazy: LazyResult[T]) -> str:
        refs = tuple(lazy.dependencies())
        if len(refs) != 1:
            msg = f"Expected one lazy dependency ref, got {refs!r}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        return str(refs[0])

    @pure_lazy
    def _static_after_sql_deps_lazy[T](
        self: Any,
        value: T,
        source_refs: Sequence[ServerPlanRefId | str],
    ) -> LazyResult[T]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.collect_results import StaticValueAfterDepsStep

        normalized_refs = [str(ref) for ref in source_refs]
        plan = self._plan_for_sql_lazy()
        ref_id = plan._next_ref()
        plan.add_step(StaticValueAfterDepsStep(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id), value, normalized_refs))
        return cast("LazyResult[T]", self._publish_sql_lazy_ref(ref_id))

    @pure_lazy
    def _collect_sql_effects_lazy(
        self: Any,
        effect_refs: Sequence[ServerPlanRefId | str],
    ) -> LazyResult[list[PlanEffect]]:
        if not effect_refs:
            return LazyResult.of([])
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.collect_results import CollectResultsStep

        source_refs = [str(ref) for ref in effect_refs]
        plan = self._plan_for_sql_lazy()
        ref_id = plan._next_ref()
        plan.add_step(CollectResultsStep(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id), source_refs, collect_runtime=True))
        return cast("LazyResult[list[PlanEffect]]", self._publish_sql_lazy_ref(ref_id))

    @pure_lazy
    def _sql_plan_effect_refs(
        self: Any,
        effect_refs: Sequence[ServerPlanRefId | str],
    ) -> SqlPlanEffectRefs:
        source_refs = tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref) for ref in effect_refs)
        return SqlPlanEffectRefs(
            result=self._static_after_sql_deps_lazy([], source_refs),
            source_refs=source_refs,
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _chunked_content_effect_refs(
        self: Any,
        write: ChunkedContentWrite,
    ) -> SqlPlanEffectRefs:
        """Build content-store metadata and chunk insert effects as ref IDs."""
        table_name = SqlTableName(write.store_table)
        chunk_size = self._CHUNK_SIZE_BYTES
        total_size = len(write.stored_content)
        num_chunks = (total_size + chunk_size - 1) // chunk_size
        plan = self._plan_for_sql_lazy()
        effect_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
        store_ref = plan._next_ref()
        plan.add_step(
            ContentStoreUpsertStep(
                store_ref,
                ContentStoreEntryConfig(
                    store_table=table_name,
                    params=(
                        write.content_hash,
                        total_size,
                        write.is_binary,
                        b"",
                        num_chunks,
                        chunk_size,
                        write.compression_algorithm,
                        write.compression_level,
                        write.original_size,
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        )
        effect_refs.append(store_ref)
        for chunk_index in range(num_chunks):
            start = chunk_index * chunk_size
            end = min(start + chunk_size, total_size)
            chunk_data = write.stored_content[start:end]
            chunk_ref = plan._next_ref()
            plan.add_step(
                ContentChunkInsertStep(
                    chunk_ref,
                    ContentChunkEntryConfig(
                        store_table=table_name,
                        params=(
                            write.content_hash,
                            chunk_index,
                            hashlib.sha256(chunk_data).hexdigest(),
                            chunk_data,
                            len(chunk_data),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            )
            effect_refs.append(chunk_ref)
        return cast("SqlPlanEffectRefs", self._sql_plan_effect_refs(effect_refs))

    @pure_lazy
    def _chunked_content_lazy(
        self: Any,
        write: ChunkedContentWrite,
    ) -> LazyResult[list[PlanEffect]]:
        """Build content-store metadata and chunk insert effects for a chunked payload."""
        return cast("LazyResult[list[PlanEffect]]", self._chunked_content_effect_refs(write).result)

    @pure_lazy
    def _content_store_entries_lazy(
        self: Any,
        model_cls: type,
        entries: Sequence[ContentStoreEntry],
    ) -> LazyResult[list[PlanEffect]]:
        """Build content-store upsert effects for unique payload hashes."""
        return cast("LazyResult[list[PlanEffect]]", self._content_store_entries_effect_refs(model_cls, entries).result)

    @pure_lazy
    def _content_store_entries_effect_refs(
        self: Any,
        model_cls: type,
        entries: Sequence[ContentStoreEntry],
    ) -> SqlPlanEffectRefs:
        """Build content-store upsert effects for unique payload hashes."""
        if not entries:
            return cast("SqlPlanEffectRefs", self._sql_plan_effect_refs(()))

        store_table = self._plan_effect_content_store_table_name_lazy(model_cls)
        plan = self._plan_for_sql_lazy()
        seen: set[str] = set()
        effect_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
        for entry in entries:
            content_hash = entry[0]
            if content_hash in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(content_hash)
            ref_id = plan._next_ref()
            plan.add_step(
                ContentStoreUpsertStep(
                    ref_id,
                    ContentStoreEntryConfig(store_table=store_table, params=entry),
                ),
            )
            effect_refs.append(ref_id)

        return cast("SqlPlanEffectRefs", self._sql_plan_effect_refs(effect_refs))

    @pure_lazy
    def _content_store_fts_lazy(
        self: Any,
        model_cls: type,
        fts_entries: Sequence[ContentStoreFtsEntry],
    ) -> LazyResult[list[PlanEffect]]:
        """Build content-store FTS effects."""
        return cast("LazyResult[list[PlanEffect]]", self._content_store_fts_effect_refs(model_cls, fts_entries).result)

    @pure_lazy
    def _content_store_fts_effect_refs(
        self: Any,
        model_cls: type,
        fts_entries: Sequence[ContentStoreFtsEntry],
    ) -> SqlPlanEffectRefs:
        """Build content-store FTS effects."""
        _ = model_cls
        _ = fts_entries
        return cast("SqlPlanEffectRefs", self._sql_plan_effect_refs(()))

    @pure_lazy
    def _spill_large_columns_lazy(
        self: Any,
        model_cls: type,
        row_data: dict[str, object],
    ) -> LazyResult[dict[str, object]]:
        """Build spill effects and return the mutated row data."""
        row_data, entries, fts_entries = self._prepare_large_column_spill(model_cls, row_data)
        entry_effects = self._content_store_entries_effect_refs(model_cls, entries)
        fts_effects = self._content_store_fts_effect_refs(model_cls, fts_entries)
        source_refs = (*entry_effects.source_refs, *fts_effects.source_refs)
        return cast("LazyResult[dict[str, object]]", self._static_after_sql_deps_lazy(row_data, source_refs))

    @pure_lazy
    def _hydrate_large_columns_lazy(
        self: Any,
        _model_cls: type,
        row_data: dict[str, object],
    ) -> LazyResult[dict[str, object]]:
        """Build lazy large-column hydration work for backends with external storage."""
        return LazyResult.of(row_data)

    @pure_lazy
    def _storage_chunk_manifest_lazy[StoreRowT, ChunkRowT](
        self: Any,
        model_cls: type,
        content_hash: str,
        *,
        store_row_decoder: RowDecoder[StoreRowT],
        chunk_row_decoder: RowDecoder[ChunkRowT],
    ) -> LazyResult[ContentStoreManifest[StoreRowT, ChunkRowT]]:
        """Build lazy reads for one spilled payload manifest."""
        return cast(
            "LazyResult[ContentStoreManifest[StoreRowT, ChunkRowT]]",
            self._storage_chunk_manifest_for_table_lazy(
                self._get_content_store_table_name(model_cls),
                content_hash,
                store_row_decoder=store_row_decoder,
                chunk_row_decoder=chunk_row_decoder,
            ),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _storage_chunk_manifest_for_table_lazy[StoreRowT, ChunkRowT](
        self: Any,
        store_table: str,
        content_hash: str,
        *,
        store_row_decoder: RowDecoder[StoreRowT],
        chunk_row_decoder: RowDecoder[ChunkRowT],
    ) -> LazyResult[ContentStoreManifest[StoreRowT, ChunkRowT]]:
        """Build lazy reads for one spilled payload manifest from an explicit store table."""
        table_name = SqlTableName(store_table)
        plan = self._plan_for_sql_lazy()
        store_ref = plan._next_ref()
        plan.add_step(
            ContentStoreRowLookupStep[StoreRowT](
                store_ref,
                ContentStoreLookupConfig(
                    store_table=table_name,
                    content_hash=content_hash,
                    row_decoder=store_row_decoder,
                ),
            ),
        )
        chunks_ref = plan._next_ref()
        plan.add_step(
            ContentChunkRowsLookupStep[ChunkRowT](
                chunks_ref,
                ContentStoreLookupConfig(
                    store_table=table_name,
                    content_hash=content_hash,
                    row_decoder=chunk_row_decoder,
                ),
            ),
        )
        ref_id = plan._next_ref()
        plan.add_step(
            ContentStoreManifestLookupStep[StoreRowT, ChunkRowT](
                ref_id,
                ContentStoreManifestConfig(
                    store_ref=store_ref,
                    chunks_ref=chunks_ref,
                ),
            ),
        )
        return cast("LazyResult[ContentStoreManifest[StoreRowT, ChunkRowT]]", self._publish_sql_lazy_ref(ref_id))

    @pure_lazy
    def _increment_large_column_ref_counts_lazy(
        self: Any,
        _model_cls: type,
        _hash_counts: Mapping[str, int],
    ) -> LazyResult[list[PlanEffect]]:
        """Backend hook to increment refcounts in the content store."""
        return LazyResult.of([])

    @pure_lazy
    def _decrement_large_column_ref_counts_lazy(
        self: Any,
        _model_cls: type,
        _hash_counts: Mapping[str, int],
    ) -> LazyResult[list[PlanEffect]]:
        """Backend hook to decrement refcounts in the content store."""
        return LazyResult.of([])

class _SqlCoreSupportMixin:
    """Remaining shared SQL support methods."""

    _active_plan: BaseServerPlan | None
    _authoritative_template_existing_tables: frozenset[str] | None
    _CHUNK_SIZE_BYTES: ClassVar[int]
    _cte_template_cache: dict[tuple[object, ...], tuple[str, int]] | None
    _in_schema_transaction: bool
    _migration_existing_tables_snapshot: frozenset[str] | None
    _nera_lazy_bootstrap_fresh_schema: bool
    _query_prerender_cache: QueryPreRenderCache | None
    _query_prerender_origin_by_rendered_signature: dict[RenderedPrerenderSignature, QueryPrerenderInfo]
    _record_table_exists_result: Callable[[SqlTableName, bool], None]
    _table_exists_from_cache: Callable[[SqlTableName], bool | None]
    invalidate_bootstrap_scope_verification: _InvalidateBootstrapScope
    _sql_maintenance_service: SqlMaintenanceService
    _sql_session_context_service: SqlSessionContextService
    _terminal_prerender_cache: TerminalPreRenderCache | None
    _terminal_prerender_analysis_by_rendered_signature: dict[RenderedPrerenderSignature, TerminalPreRenderAnalysis]
    _last_ripple_context: dict[str, Any] | None

    @abstractmethod
    def _commit(self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin) -> None: ...

    @abstractmethod
    def connect(self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin) -> None: ...

    @abstractmethod
    def get_capabilities(self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin) -> set[BackendCapability]: ...

    @abstractmethod
    def get_fts_manager(self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin) -> FTSRebuildProtocol: ...

    @abstractmethod
    @pure_lazy
    def _check_in_schema_transaction(self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin, operation: str) -> None:
        """Require an active schema transaction."""

    @abstractmethod
    def _rowcount(self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin) -> int:
        """Return the affected-row count from the current driver cursor."""

    _schema_create_table_from_schema_lazy: _CreateSchemaTable
    _schema_ensure_model_table_lazy: _EnsureModelTable

    @contextmanager
    def native_pipeline(self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin) -> Generator[None, None, None]:
        with self._sql_maintenance_service.native_pipeline() as pipeline:
            yield pipeline

    def _reset_plan_flush_ctx(self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin) -> None:
        self._sql_maintenance_service._reset_plan_flush_ctx()

    def _assert_sync_io_allowed(self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin, method_name: ConnectionMethodName) -> None:
        self._sql_session_context_service._assert_sync_io_allowed(method_name)

    async def _ensure_async_mode_async(self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin) -> None:
        await self._sql_session_context_service._ensure_async_mode_async()

    def _is_in_async_schema_transaction(self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin) -> bool:
        return self._sql_session_context_service._is_in_async_schema_transaction()

    def _backend_before_existing_table_schema_reconciliation(
        self: Any,
        model_cls: type,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
    ) -> None:
        del model_cls, table_name

    def _backend_after_schema_create_table_from_schema(
        self: Any,
        model_cls: type,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        *,
        table_already_exists: bool,
        schema_txn: object,
        reconciliation_succeeded: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        del model_cls, table_name, table_already_exists, reconciliation_succeeded, schema_txn

    @abstractmethod
    @pure_lazy
    def get_dialect(self: Self) -> SqlDialect:
        """Return the SQL dialect for this connection.

        Returns:
            SqlDialect instance for this backend (e.g., SQLITE_DIALECT, POSTGRES_DIALECT)
        """

    def _format_limit_offset(
        self: Self,
        limit: int | None,
        offset: int | None,
    ) -> str:
        """Return backend-specific LIMIT/OFFSET clause."""
        del limit, offset
        msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must override _format_limit_offset()"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)

    def plan(self: Self) -> BaseServerPlan:
        """Return the active transaction-owned plan.

        Connection-owned plan creation has been removed. Callers must start
        plan execution from an active transaction via ``txn.plan()``.
        """
        active_plan = self._active_plan
        if active_plan is None:
            msg = "Connection-owned plans are no longer supported. Use txn.plan()."
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        return active_plan

    @pure_lazy
    def prepare_terminal_sql(
        self: Self,
        stmt: SqlRenderable,
        *,
        params: SqlParamTuple = (),
        external_params_first: bool = False,
        needs_returning: bool = False,
    ) -> PreparedTerminalExecution:
        """Compile a terminal grammar object to SQL, reusing cached terminal plans."""
        from impl.common.l2160_terminal_prerender_cache import compile_terminal_sql
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.rust_bridge.runtime import (
            is_sql_grammar_comparison_mode,
            is_sql_grammar_rust_backend,
        )

        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.protocols import sql_statement_framing

        typed_stmt = stmt.inner if isinstance(stmt, AttributedSqlRenderable) else stmt
        statement_framing = sql_statement_framing(typed_stmt)
        explain_eligible = _is_typed_explainable_query(typed_stmt)

        if type(stmt).__qualname__ == "_SqlTrustedText" and not params:
            trusted_sql = cast(_TrustedSqlText, stmt).sql
            trusted_sql_text = nonempty_string(trusted_sql)
            assert trusted_sql_text is not None
            return PreparedTerminalExecution(
                sql=trusted_sql_text,
                params=params,
                prerender_info=_with_query_plan_eligibility(
                    self._extract_stmt_query_prerender_info(stmt),
                    explain_eligible=explain_eligible,
                ),
            )

        cte_cache = self._cte_template_cache
        cte_fingerprint: tuple[object, ...] | None = None
        prior_info = self._extract_stmt_query_prerender_info(stmt)
        execution_needs_info = self._execution_needs_terminal_prerender_info()
        using_rust_terminal_stmt = False
        rust_backend = is_sql_grammar_rust_backend()
        if self.get_dialect().backend_type.is_mysql_family:
            rust_backend = False
        comparison_mode = is_sql_grammar_comparison_mode()
        if rust_backend or comparison_mode:
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.base import render_to_sql
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.rust_bridge.python_tree_bridge import (
                debug_python_tree_recipe,
                record_rust_terminal_bridge_use,
                rust_root_from_python_tree,
                rust_terminal_bridge_diagnostics_enabled,
            )

            python_stmt = stmt.inner if isinstance(stmt, AttributedSqlRenderable) else stmt
            rust_stmt = rust_root_from_python_tree(python_stmt)
            should_compare = comparison_mode or rust_terminal_bridge_diagnostics_enabled()
            if rust_backend and not should_compare:
                record_rust_terminal_bridge_use(python_stmt, used=True)
                stmt = rust_stmt
                using_rust_terminal_stmt = True
            else:
                dialect = self.get_dialect()
                python_rendered: tuple[str, SqlParamTuple] | None = None
                try:
                    python_rendered = render_to_sql(python_stmt, dialect)
                    rust_rendered = render_to_sql(rust_stmt, dialect)
                    python_sql, python_params = python_rendered
                    rust_sql, rust_params = rust_rendered
                    normalized_python = normalize_sql_params(tuple(python_params))
                    normalized_rust = normalize_sql_params(tuple(rust_params))
                    parity_matches = python_sql == rust_sql and normalized_python == normalized_rust
                    mismatch_reason = (
                        None
                        if parity_matches
                        else _sql_grammar_parity_mismatch_reason(
                            python_rendered=python_rendered,
                            rust_rendered=rust_rendered,
                            normalized_python=normalized_python,
                            normalized_rust=normalized_rust,
                            recipe=debug_python_tree_recipe(python_stmt),
                        )
                    )
                except Exception as exc:
                    parity_matches = False
                    recipe = debug_python_tree_recipe(python_stmt)
                    mismatch_reason = (
                        f"python={python_rendered!r}; {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}; recipe={recipe!r}"
                        if python_rendered is not None
                        else f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}; recipe={recipe!r}"
                    )
                if parity_matches:
                    if rust_backend:
                        record_rust_terminal_bridge_use(python_stmt, used=True)
                        stmt = rust_stmt
                        using_rust_terminal_stmt = True
                else:
                    record_rust_terminal_bridge_use(
                        python_stmt,
                        used=False,
                        reason=mismatch_reason,
                    )
                    msg = f"Rust SQL grammar parity mismatch: {mismatch_reason}"
                    raise RuntimeError(msg)
        if using_rust_terminal_stmt:
            cte_cache = None
        if cte_cache is not None:
            cte_fingerprint = self._compute_cte_template_fingerprint(
                stmt,
                params=params,
                external_params_first=external_params_first,
                needs_returning=needs_returning,
            )
            hit = self._try_cte_template_cache(
                stmt,
                params,
                external_params_first,
                cte_cache,
                cte_fingerprint=cte_fingerprint,
            )
            if hit is not None:
                sql_str, cached_params = hit
                all_params = self._prepare_terminal_bound_params(cached_params)
                analysis = self._lookup_rendered_terminal_prerender_analysis(sql_str, all_params)
                if analysis is None and (execution_needs_info or prior_info is not None):
                    analysis = self.analyze_terminal_prerenderability(
                        stmt,
                        params=params,
                        external_params_first=external_params_first,
                        needs_returning=needs_returning,
                    )
                    self._remember_rendered_terminal_prerender_analysis(
                        sql_str,
                        all_params,
                        analysis,
                    )
                if analysis is None:
                    return PreparedTerminalExecution(
                        statement_framing=statement_framing,
                        sql=sql_str,
                        params=all_params,
                        prerender_info=_with_query_plan_eligibility(
                            prior_info,
                            explain_eligible=explain_eligible,
                        ),
                    )
                cache_hit = True
                observed = QueryPrerenderShapeMetadata(
                    exact_shape_key=QueryPrerenderShapeKey(analysis.exact_shape_key),
                    family_shape_key=QueryPrerenderShapeKey(analysis.family_shape_key),
                    mode=None,
                    seam=QueryPrerenderSeam("server_plan_terminal"),
                )
                execution_info = (
                    prior_info.with_observed_shape(
                        observed,
                        prerender_cache_hit=cache_hit,
                        prerender_supported=analysis.is_prerenderable,
                    )
                    if prior_info is not None and prior_info.attributed.seam == "query_spec"
                    else QueryPrerenderInfo.from_shape(
                        observed,
                        prerender_cache_hit=cache_hit,
                        prerender_supported=analysis.is_prerenderable,
                    )
                )
                return PreparedTerminalExecution(
                    statement_framing=statement_framing,
                    sql=sql_str,
                    params=all_params,
                    prerender_info=_with_query_plan_eligibility(
                        execution_info,
                        explain_eligible=explain_eligible,
                    ),
                )

        cache: TerminalPreRenderCache | None = None if using_rust_terminal_stmt else self._terminal_prerender_cache
        if cache is not None and cache.is_enabled():
            sql_str, bound_params, analysis, cache_hit = cache.bind_or_compile_sql(
                stmt,
                external_params=params,
                external_params_first=external_params_first,
                needs_returning=needs_returning,
                dialect=self.get_dialect(),
            )
            all_params = self._prepare_terminal_bound_params(bound_params)
        else:
            sql_str, compiled_params, _ = compile_terminal_sql(
                stmt,
                external_params=params,
                external_params_first=external_params_first,
                dialect=self.get_dialect(),
            )
            all_params = self._prepare_terminal_bound_params(compiled_params)
            analysis = self._lookup_rendered_terminal_prerender_analysis(sql_str, all_params)
            if analysis is None and (execution_needs_info or prior_info is not None):
                analysis = self.analyze_terminal_prerenderability(
                    stmt,
                    params=params,
                    external_params_first=external_params_first,
                    needs_returning=needs_returning,
                )
                self._remember_rendered_terminal_prerender_analysis(
                    sql_str,
                    all_params,
                    analysis,
                )
            cache_hit = False

        if cte_cache is not None:
            self._populate_cte_template_cache(
                cte_fingerprint,
                stmt,
                sql_str,
                all_params,
                cte_cache,
            )

        if analysis is None:
            return PreparedTerminalExecution(
                statement_framing=statement_framing,
                sql=sql_str,
                params=all_params,
                prerender_info=_with_query_plan_eligibility(
                    prior_info,
                    explain_eligible=explain_eligible,
                ),
            )

        observed = QueryPrerenderShapeMetadata(
            exact_shape_key=QueryPrerenderShapeKey(analysis.exact_shape_key),
            family_shape_key=QueryPrerenderShapeKey(analysis.family_shape_key),
            mode=None,
            seam=QueryPrerenderSeam("server_plan_terminal"),
        )
        execution_info = (
            prior_info.with_observed_shape(
                observed,
                prerender_cache_hit=cache_hit,
                prerender_supported=analysis.is_prerenderable,
            )
            if prior_info is not None and prior_info.attributed.seam == "query_spec"
            else QueryPrerenderInfo.from_shape(
                observed,
                prerender_cache_hit=cache_hit,
                prerender_supported=analysis.is_prerenderable,
            )
        )
        return PreparedTerminalExecution(
            statement_framing=statement_framing,
            sql=sql_str,
            params=all_params,
            prerender_info=_with_query_plan_eligibility(
                execution_info,
                explain_eligible=explain_eligible,
            ),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _try_cte_template_cache(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        stmt: SqlRenderable,
        params: SqlParamTuple,
        external_params_first: bool,
        cte_cache: dict[tuple[object, ...], tuple[str, int]],
        *,
        cte_fingerprint: tuple[object, ...] | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[str, tuple[object, ...]] | None:
        """Return cached SQL and rebound params for matching CTE grammars."""

        fingerprint = (
            cte_fingerprint
            if cte_fingerprint is not None
            else self._compute_cte_template_fingerprint(
                stmt,
                params=params,
                external_params_first=external_params_first,
                needs_returning=False,
            )
        )
        if fingerprint is None:
            return None

        entry = cte_cache.get(fingerprint)
        if entry is None:
            return None

        sql_template, expected_param_count = entry
        dialect = self.get_dialect()
        embedded_params = collect_params_fast(dialect.transform_grammar_for_execution(stmt), dialect)
        all_params = params + embedded_params if external_params_first else embedded_params + params
        if len(all_params) != expected_param_count:
            del cte_cache[fingerprint]
            return None
        if rendered_bind_placeholder_count(sql_template) != len(all_params):
            del cte_cache[fingerprint]
            return None
        return sql_template, all_params

    @pure_lazy
    def _compute_cte_template_fingerprint(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        stmt: SqlRenderable,
        *,
        params: SqlParamTuple = (),
        external_params_first: bool = False,
        needs_returning: bool = False,
    ) -> tuple[object, ...] | None:
        from impl.common.l2160_terminal_prerender_cache import analyze_terminal_prerenderability

        # Fresh lazy-bootstrap seed writes are one-shot; avoid spending the startup budget
        # on optional CTE template fingerprints.
        if self._nera_lazy_bootstrap_fresh_schema:
            return None

        fingerprint_target = stmt.inner if isinstance(stmt, AttributedSqlRenderable) else stmt
        if isinstance(fingerprint_target, SqlSelectWithCte) and type(fingerprint_target._select) is not SqlSelect:
            return None
        dialect = self.get_dialect()
        fingerprint = compute_structural_fingerprint(fingerprint_target, dialect)
        if fingerprint is None:
            return None

        exact_shape_keys = self._collect_stmt_query_prerender_exact_shape_keys(stmt)
        if exact_shape_keys is None:
            return None
        terminal_analysis = analyze_terminal_prerenderability(
            stmt,
            external_params=params,
            external_params_first=external_params_first,
            needs_returning=needs_returning,
            dialect=dialect,
        )
        if not exact_shape_keys:
            return (*fingerprint, ("terminal_exact_shape", terminal_analysis.exact_shape_key))
        return (
            *fingerprint,
            ("query_spec_exact_shapes", exact_shape_keys),
            ("terminal_exact_shape", terminal_analysis.exact_shape_key),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _collect_stmt_query_prerender_exact_shape_keys(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        stmt: object,
    ) -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
        if type(stmt) in {tuple, list, set, frozenset} and len(cast("Sequence[object]", stmt)) > 512:
            return None
        exact_shape_keys: list[str] = []
        self._walk_stmt_query_prerender_info(stmt, exact_shape_keys, seen=set())
        return tuple(exact_shape_keys)

    @pure_lazy
    def _walk_stmt_query_prerender_info(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        value: object,
        exact_shape_keys: list[str],
        *,
        seen: set[int],
    ) -> None:
        if value is None or type(value) in {str, bytes, int, float, bool}:
            return

        value_id = id(value)
        if value_id in seen:
            return
        seen.add(value_id)

        if isinstance(value, AttributedSqlRenderable):
            attributed_value = value
            exact_shape_key = attributed_value.prerender_info.attributed.exact_shape_key
            if exact_shape_key is not None:
                exact_shape_keys.append(exact_shape_key)
            self._walk_stmt_query_prerender_info(attributed_value.inner, exact_shape_keys, seen=seen)
            return

        if type(value) is SqlFragment:
            fragment_value = value
            prior_info = fragment_value._query_prerender_info
            if prior_info is not None:
                exact_shape_key = prior_info.attributed.exact_shape_key
                if exact_shape_key is not None:
                    exact_shape_keys.append(exact_shape_key)
            return

        if isinstance(value, dict):
            for item in value.values():
                self._walk_stmt_query_prerender_info(item, exact_shape_keys, seen=seen)
            return

        if type(value) in {tuple, list, set, frozenset}:
            for item in cast("Iterable[object]", value):
                self._walk_stmt_query_prerender_info(item, exact_shape_keys, seen=seen)
            return

        slot_names: list[str] = []
        for cls in type(value).__mro__:
            cls_slots = cls.__dict__.get("__slots__", ())
            if type(cls_slots) is str:
                cls_slots = (cls_slots,)
            slot_names.extend(str(slot_name) for slot_name in cls_slots if slot_name not in {"__dict__", "__weakref__"})
        if slot_names:
            for slot_name in slot_names:
                try:
                    slot_value = object.__getattribute__(value, slot_name)
                except AttributeError:
                    continue
                self._walk_stmt_query_prerender_info(
                    slot_value,
                    exact_shape_keys,
                    seen=seen,
                )
        else:
            value_dict = value.__dict__
            if type(value_dict) is dict:
                for item in cast("dict[object, object]", value_dict).values():
                    self._walk_stmt_query_prerender_info(item, exact_shape_keys, seen=seen)

    @pure_lazy
    def _populate_cte_template_cache(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        cte_fingerprint: tuple[object, ...] | None,
        stmt: SqlRenderable,
        sql_str: str,
        all_params: tuple[object, ...],
        cte_cache: dict[tuple[object, ...], tuple[str, int]],
    ) -> None:
        """Store the SQL template for a cacheable CTE grammar shape."""
        fingerprint = cte_fingerprint
        if fingerprint is None:
            return
        if rendered_bind_placeholder_count(sql_str) != len(all_params):
            return
        cte_cache[fingerprint] = (sql_str, len(all_params))

    @pure_lazy
    def _prepare_terminal_execution(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        stmt: SqlRenderable,
        *,
        params: SqlParamTuple = (),
        external_params_first: bool = False,
        needs_returning: bool = False,
    ) -> PreparedTerminalExecution:
        """Prepare terminal SQL without unwrapping lazy or branded values."""
        return self.prepare_terminal_sql(
            stmt,
            params=params,
            external_params_first=external_params_first,
            needs_returning=needs_returning,
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _execution_needs_terminal_prerender_info(self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin) -> bool:
        """Return whether execution observers require prerender metadata."""
        return False

    def analyze_query_prerenderability(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        spec: QuerySpec[object],
        *,
        mode: QueryPreRenderMode = "select",
    ) -> QueryPreRenderAnalysis:
        """Analyze whether a query specification has a reusable shape."""
        from impl.common.l2155_query_prerender_cache import analyze_query_prerenderability

        return analyze_query_prerenderability(spec, mode=mode, dialect=self.get_dialect())

    def _compile_query_spec_sql(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        spec: QuerySpec[object],
        mode: QueryPreRenderMode,
        dialect: SqlDialect,
    ) -> tuple[str, tuple[object, ...]]:
        """Compile a query specification through the registered grammar builder."""
        compiler = _QUERY_SPEC_SQL_COMPILER_STATE["compiler"]
        if compiler is None:
            msg = (
                "QuerySpec SQL compiler is not registered. Import impl.common.l5200_sql_query.query_grammar before compiling QuerySpecs."
            )
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        return compiler(spec, mode, dialect)

    def compile_query_spec_fragment(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        spec: QuerySpec[object],
        *,
        mode: QueryPreRenderMode = "select",
    ) -> SqlFragment:
        """Compile a query specification and preserve prerender attribution."""
        cache = self._query_prerender_cache
        dialect = self.get_dialect()
        analysis = self.analyze_query_prerenderability(spec, mode=mode)
        cache_hit = False
        if cache is not None and cache.is_enabled():
            cache_hit = analysis.is_prerenderable and cache.has_plan(analysis.exact_shape_key)
            sql_str, params = cache.bind_or_compile_sql(
                spec,
                mode=mode,
                dialect=dialect,
                compile_sql=self._compile_query_spec_sql,
            )
        else:
            sql_str, params = self._compile_query_spec_sql(spec, mode, dialect)
        from impl.common.l2200_sql_dialect.sql_prerender_services import (
            _query_spec_prerender_result_columns,
        )

        info = QueryPrerenderInfo.from_shape(
            QueryPrerenderShapeMetadata(
                exact_shape_key=QueryPrerenderShapeKey(analysis.exact_shape_key),
                family_shape_key=QueryPrerenderShapeKey(analysis.family_shape_key),
                mode=mode,
                seam=QueryPrerenderSeam("query_spec"),
            ),
            prerender_cache_hit=cache_hit,
            prerender_supported=analysis.is_prerenderable,
            result_columns=(
                tuple(map(SqlColumnName, result_columns))
                if (result_columns := _query_spec_prerender_result_columns(spec, mode)) is not None
                else None
            ),
        )
        fragment = SqlFragment(sql_str, params)
        fragment._query_prerender_info = info
        self._remember_rendered_query_prerender_info(sql_str, normalize_sql_params(params), info)
        return fragment

    def compile_query_spec_statement(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        spec: QuerySpec[object],
        *,
        mode: QueryPreRenderMode = "select",
    ) -> SqlFragment:
        """Compile a query spec into a reusable pre-rendered terminal statement."""
        return self.wrap_prerendered_fragment(self.compile_query_spec_fragment(spec, mode=mode))

    def wrap_prerendered_fragment(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        fragment: SqlFragment,
    ) -> SqlFragment:
        """Return a pre-rendered fragment while preserving QuerySpec attribution."""
        if fragment._query_prerender_info is None:
            sql_str, params = fragment.to_sql(self.get_dialect())
            fragment._query_prerender_info = self._lookup_rendered_query_prerender_info(sql_str, params)
        return fragment

    @pure_lazy
    def analyze_terminal_prerenderability(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        stmt: SqlRenderable,
        *,
        params: SqlParamTuple = (),
        external_params_first: bool = False,
        needs_returning: bool = False,
    ) -> TerminalPreRenderAnalysis:
        """Analyze whether a terminal grammar object can skip rendering on reuse."""
        from impl.common.l2160_terminal_prerender_cache import analyze_terminal_prerenderability

        return analyze_terminal_prerenderability(
            stmt,
            external_params=params,
            external_params_first=external_params_first,
            needs_returning=needs_returning,
            dialect=self.get_dialect(),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _rendered_prerender_signature(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        sql_str: str,
        params: SqlExecutionParamTuple,
    ) -> RenderedPrerenderSignature:
        """Build a stable signature for rendered SQL attribution lookups."""
        return RenderedPrerenderSignature(sql=sql_str, param_count=len(params))

    def _remember_rendered_query_prerender_info(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        sql_str: str,
        params: SqlParamTuple,
        info: QueryPrerenderInfo,
    ) -> None:
        """Remember QuerySpec attribution for a rendered SQL shape."""
        registry = getattr(self, "_query_prerender_origin_by_rendered_signature", None)
        if registry is None:
            registry = {}
            self._query_prerender_origin_by_rendered_signature = registry
        registry[self._rendered_prerender_signature(sql_str, params)] = info

    @pure_lazy
    def _remember_rendered_terminal_prerender_analysis(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        sql_str: str,
        params: SqlExecutionParamTuple,
        analysis: TerminalPreRenderAnalysis,
    ) -> None:
        """Remember terminal prerender analysis for a rendered SQL shape."""
        registry = getattr(self, "_terminal_prerender_analysis_by_rendered_signature", None)
        if registry is None:
            registry = {}
            self._terminal_prerender_analysis_by_rendered_signature = registry
        registry[self._rendered_prerender_signature(sql_str, params)] = analysis

    @pure_lazy
    def _lookup_rendered_terminal_prerender_analysis(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        sql_str: str,
        params: SqlExecutionParamTuple,
    ) -> TerminalPreRenderAnalysis | None:
        """Lookup terminal prerender analysis for a rendered SQL shape."""
        registry = getattr(self, "_terminal_prerender_analysis_by_rendered_signature", None)
        if registry is None:
            return None
        analysis = registry.get(self._rendered_prerender_signature(sql_str, params))
        if analysis is None:
            return None
        from impl.common.l2160_terminal_prerender_cache import TerminalPreRenderAnalysis

        if type(analysis) is TerminalPreRenderAnalysis:
            return analysis
        return None

    @pure_lazy
    def _lookup_rendered_query_prerender_info(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        sql_str: str,
        params: SqlParamTuple,
    ) -> QueryPrerenderInfo | None:
        """Lookup prior QuerySpec attribution for a rendered SQL shape."""
        registry: dict[RenderedPrerenderSignature, QueryPrerenderInfo] | None = getattr(
            self,
            "_query_prerender_origin_by_rendered_signature",
            None,
        )
        if registry is None:
            return None
        return registry.get(self._rendered_prerender_signature(sql_str, params))

    def _attach_query_prerender_info(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        stmt: SqlRenderable,
        info: QueryPrerenderInfo,
    ) -> SqlRenderable:
        """Attach prerender attribution directly to the renderable object when possible."""
        if type(stmt) is SqlFragment:
            fragment_stmt = stmt
            fragment_stmt._query_prerender_info = info
            return fragment_stmt
        if isinstance(stmt, AttributedSqlRenderable):
            attributed_stmt = stmt
            return AttributedSqlRenderable(inner=attributed_stmt.inner, prerender_info=info)
        return AttributedSqlRenderable(inner=stmt, prerender_info=info)

    def _attach_query_spec_prerender_info(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        stmt: SqlRenderable,
        *,
        spec: QuerySpec[object],
        mode: QueryPreRenderMode,
    ) -> SqlRenderable:
        """Attach QuerySpec-origin attribution to a terminal statement."""
        analysis = self.analyze_query_prerenderability(spec, mode=mode)
        return self._attach_query_prerender_info(
            stmt,
            QueryPrerenderInfo.from_shape(
                QueryPrerenderShapeMetadata(
                    exact_shape_key=QueryPrerenderShapeKey(analysis.exact_shape_key),
                    family_shape_key=QueryPrerenderShapeKey(analysis.family_shape_key),
                    mode=mode,
                    seam=QueryPrerenderSeam("query_spec"),
                ),
                prerender_cache_hit=False,
                prerender_supported=analysis.is_prerenderable,
            ),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _extract_stmt_query_prerender_info(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        stmt: SqlRenderable,
    ) -> QueryPrerenderInfo | None:
        """Return attached QuerySpec attribution for one terminal statement."""
        if isinstance(stmt, AttributedSqlRenderable):
            return stmt.prerender_info
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.request_scalar import SqlRequestStatement

        if isinstance(stmt, SqlRequestStatement):
            return self._extract_stmt_query_prerender_info(stmt._inner)
        if type(stmt) is SqlFragment:
            fragment_stmt = stmt
            if fragment_stmt._query_prerender_info is not None:
                return fragment_stmt._query_prerender_info
            sql_str, params = fragment_stmt.to_sql(self.get_dialect())
            return self._lookup_rendered_query_prerender_info(sql_str, params)
        return None

    def _prepared_cache_prerender_kwargs(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        info: QueryPrerenderInfo | None,
    ) -> PreparedCachePrerenderKwargs:
        """Build prepared-cache kwargs from explicit prerender metadata."""
        return {} if info is None else info.to_prepared_cache_kwargs()

    @pure_lazy
    def _prepare_terminal_bound_params(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        params: tuple[object, ...],
    ) -> SqlExecutionParamTuple:
        """Validate terminal values and apply backend-specific coercion."""

        backend_type = self.get_dialect().backend_type

        def normalize_backend_bind(value: object) -> object:
            unwrap_sql_bind = getattr(value, "unwrap_sql_bind", None)
            if callable(unwrap_sql_bind):
                return normalize_backend_bind(unwrap_sql_bind(backend_type))
            if isinstance(value, tuple):
                return tuple(normalize_backend_bind(item) for item in value)
            if isinstance(value, list):
                return type(value)(normalize_backend_bind(item) for item in value)
            if isinstance(value, dict):
                return {key: normalize_backend_bind(item) for key, item in value.items()}
            return value

        params = tuple(normalize_backend_bind(value) for value in params)
        native_strategy = {
            BackendType.SQLITE: SqlListTransport.SQLITE_JSON_EACH,
            BackendType.POSTGRES: SqlListTransport.POSTGRES_ARRAY,
            BackendType.MARIADB: SqlListTransport.MARIADB_JSON_TABLE,
        }.get(backend_type)
        native_bound = normalize_native_list_params_for_driver(params, native_strategy) if native_strategy is not None else params
        validated = validate_sql_params(native_bound)
        assert isinstance(validated, tuple)
        if backend_type == BackendType.POSTGRES:
            return validated
        return normalize_sql_params(validated)

    @pure_lazy
    def _build_direct_execution_plan(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        sql_str: str,
        params: SqlExecutionParamTuple,
        *,
        fetch_mode: _DirectFetchMode = "none",
        use_savepoint_recovery: bool = True,
        prerender_info: QueryPrerenderInfo | None = None,
        track_rtt: bool = True,
        requires_connection_local_schema_authority: bool = False,
    ) -> _DirectGrammarExecutionPlan:
        """Build a shared direct-execution plan for SQL backends.

        Backends may override this to attach additional execution metadata while
        preserving the compiled SQL, params, fetch mode, and prerender info.
        ``use_savepoint_recovery`` is advisory at this layer and exists so
        backend-specific plans can opt into statement-level recovery envelopes.
        """
        del use_savepoint_recovery
        return _DirectGrammarExecutionPlan(
            sql=sql_str,
            params=params,
            prerender_info=prerender_info,
            fetch_mode=fetch_mode,
            track_rtt=track_rtt,
            requires_connection_local_schema_authority=requires_connection_local_schema_authority,
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _prepare_direct_execution_plan(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        stmt: SqlRenderable,
        *,
        params: SqlParamTuple | None = None,
        external_params_first: bool = False,
        fetch_mode: _DirectFetchMode = "none",
        use_savepoint_recovery: bool = True,
        track_rtt: bool = True,
    ) -> _DirectGrammarExecutionPlan:
        """Prepare terminal SQL and wrap it in a shared direct-execution plan."""
        needs_returning = fetch_mode != "none"
        if params is None:
            prepared = self._prepare_terminal_execution(stmt, needs_returning=needs_returning)
        else:
            prepared = self._prepare_terminal_execution(
                stmt,
                params=params,
                external_params_first=external_params_first,
                needs_returning=needs_returning,
            )
        self._raise_if_unscoped_mysql_published_relation(prepared.sql)
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_connection_schema import (
            is_connection_local_schema_statement,
        )

        return self._build_direct_execution_plan(
            prepared.sql,
            prepared.params,
            fetch_mode=fetch_mode,
            use_savepoint_recovery=use_savepoint_recovery,
            prerender_info=prepared.prerender_info,
            track_rtt=track_rtt,
            requires_connection_local_schema_authority=is_connection_local_schema_statement(stmt),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _raise_if_unscoped_mysql_published_relation(
        self: Self,
        sql_str: str,
    ) -> None:
        """Fail before execution when MySQL-family SQL strands a published CTE reference."""
        if not self.get_dialect().backend_type.is_mysql_family:
            return
        for match in _MYSQL_PUBLISHED_RELATION_REF_RE.finditer(sql_str):
            relation = match.group(1)
            definition_re = re.compile(
                _MYSQL_CTE_DEFINITION_TEMPLATE.format(relation=re.escape(relation)),
                re.IGNORECASE,
            )
            if definition_re.search(sql_str):
                continue
            relation_offset = sql_str.find(relation)
            excerpt_start = max(0, relation_offset - 250)
            excerpt = sql_str[excerpt_start : relation_offset + 500]
            msg = (
                "MySQL-family statement references auxiliary relation "
                f"{relation!r} without declaring or inlining it in the same statement: {excerpt}"
            )
            raise RuntimeError(msg)

    def _prefer_create_table_if_not_exists(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        stmt: SqlCreateTable,
    ) -> SqlCreateTable:
        """Mark generated CREATE TABLE grammar idempotent when the grammar supports it."""
        if not stmt._if_not_exists is not None:
            msg = f"{type(stmt).__name__} does not support CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        stmt = copy(stmt)
        try:
            stmt._if_not_exists = True
        except (AttributeError, FrozenInstanceError, TypeError) as exc:
            msg = f"{type(stmt).__name__} cannot be marked CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS"
            raise TypeError(msg) from exc
        return stmt

    @external_io_boundary
    def _system_table_columns_usable(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        required_columns: frozenset[str],
    ) -> bool:
        """Return True when cached startup metadata proves a system table has required columns."""
        existing_tables = self._migration_existing_tables_snapshot
        table_exists_is_proven: bool | None
        if type(existing_tables) is frozenset:
            table_exists_is_proven = table_name in existing_tables
        else:
            authoritative_existing_tables = self._authoritative_template_existing_tables
            if type(authoritative_existing_tables) is frozenset:
                table_exists_is_proven = table_name in authoritative_existing_tables
            else:
                table_exists_is_proven = self._table_exists_from_cache(table_name)
        if table_exists_is_proven is not True:
            return False

        if in_bootstrap_plan_active_context():
            cached_columns = self._cached_table_columns(table_name)
            if all(
                schema_txn.projected_or_cached_column_exists(
                    table_name,
                    SqlColumnName(column_name),
                )
                is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
                for column_name in required_columns
            ):
                return True
            if cached_columns is None:
                msg = (
                    f"Bootstrap-owned system table {table_name!r} exists but its column shape is not "
                    "proven from cached/projected facts. Fix the bootstrap proof path instead of "
                    "falling back to physical introspection or unconditional CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS."
                )
                raise RuntimeError(msg)
            return required_columns.issubset(cached_columns)

        if all(
            schema_txn.projected_or_cached_column_exists(
                table_name,
                SqlColumnName(column_name),
            )
            is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
            for column_name in required_columns
        ):
            return True
        if in_lazy_context():
            cached_columns = self._cached_table_columns(table_name)
            return cached_columns is not None and required_columns.issubset(cached_columns)
        snapshot = schema_txn._schema_reconciliation_snapshot
        if snapshot is not None:
            snapshot_columns = frozenset(str(name) for name in snapshot.columns_for_table(table_name))
            if required_columns.issubset(snapshot_columns):
                self._cache_table_columns(table_name, tuple(SqlColumnName(column_name) for column_name in snapshot_columns))
                return True
            return False
        cached_columns = self._cached_table_columns(table_name)
        return cached_columns is not None and required_columns.issubset(cached_columns)

    def _add_sql_rows_step[RowT](
        self: Self,
        stmt: SqlRenderable,
        *,
        row_decoder: RowDecoder[RowT],
        params: SqlParamTuple | None = None,
        external_params_first: bool = False,
        batchable: bool = True,
    ) -> LazyResult[list[RowT]]:
        plan = self._plan_for_sql_lazy()
        ref_id = plan._next_ref()
        plan.add_step(
            GrammarRowsStep[RowT](
                ref_id=ref_id,
                stmt=stmt,
                params=params,
                config=_GrammarRowsConfig(
                    batchable=batchable,
                    external_params_first=external_params_first,
                ),
            ),
        )
        if row_decoder is dict_sql_row:
            return cast(
                "LazyResult[list[RowT]]",
                self._publish_sql_lazy_ref(ref_id, op="grammar_rows"),
            )

        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.grammar_runtime_projection import (

        plan.add_step(
            DecodeGrammarRowsStep(

        )
        return cast("LazyResult[list[RowT]]", self._publish_sql_lazy_ref(out_ref, op="grammar_rows"))

    @pure_lazy
    def _chunked_content_effect_refs(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        write: ChunkedContentWrite,
    ) -> SqlPlanEffectRefs:
        """Build content-store metadata and chunk insert effects as ref IDs."""
        table_name = SqlTableName(write.store_table)
        chunk_size = self._CHUNK_SIZE_BYTES
        total_size = len(write.stored_content)
        num_chunks = (total_size + chunk_size - 1) // chunk_size
        plan = self._plan_for_sql_lazy()
        effect_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
        store_ref = plan._next_ref()
        plan.add_step(
            ContentStoreUpsertStep(
                store_ref,
                ContentStoreEntryConfig(
                    store_table=table_name,
                    params=(
                        write.content_hash,
                        total_size,
                        write.is_binary,
                        b"",
                        num_chunks,
                        chunk_size,
                        write.compression_algorithm,
                        write.compression_level,
                        write.original_size,
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        )
        effect_refs.append(store_ref)
        for chunk_index in range(num_chunks):
            start = chunk_index * chunk_size
            end = min(start + chunk_size, total_size)
            chunk_data = write.stored_content[start:end]
            chunk_ref = plan._next_ref()
            plan.add_step(
                ContentChunkInsertStep(
                    chunk_ref,
                    ContentChunkEntryConfig(
                        store_table=table_name,
                        params=(
                            write.content_hash,
                            chunk_index,
                            hashlib.sha256(chunk_data).hexdigest(),
                            chunk_data,
                            len(chunk_data),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            )
            effect_refs.append(chunk_ref)
        return self._sql_plan_effect_refs(tuple(effect_refs))

    ) -> LazyResult[list[PlanEffect]]:
        """Build content-store metadata and chunk insert effects for a chunked payload."""
        return self._chunked_content_effect_refs(write).result

    def _should_skip_versioned_polymorphic_subclass(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,

        return self._shared_table_polymorphic_base_class(model_cls) is not None

    @pure_lazy
    def _should_skip_polymorphic_subclass_lazy[T](
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        model_cls: type[T],
    ) -> LazyResult[bool]:
        """Async equivalent of polymorphic subclass table skip detection."""

        base_class = self._shared_table_polymorphic_base_class(model_cls)
        if base_class is not None:
            base_table_name = get_table_name(base_class)

            def _require_base_table(exists: bool) -> bool:
                if exists:
                    return True
                subclass_name = model_cls.__name__
                base_name = base_class.__name__
                msg = (
                    f"Cannot create table for {subclass_name}. "
                    f"Base class {base_name} table must be created first. "
                    f"Call create_table_from_schema_async({base_name}) before creating subclass tables."
                )
                raise db_exc.ProgrammingError(msg)

            required_base_table: LazyResult[bool] = self.table_exists_lazy(base_table_name).map(
                _require_base_table,
            )
            return required_base_table

        return LazyResult.of(False)

    @staticmethod
    @pure_lazy
    def _shared_table_polymorphic_base_class[T](model_cls: type[T]) -> type[Any] | None:
        """Return the STI base model when ``model_cls`` shares its physical table."""
        if not is_polymorphic_class(model_cls):
            return None

        from l1050_polymorphism.type_registry import get_polymorphic_base_class

        base_class = get_polymorphic_base_class(model_cls)
        if base_class is None or base_class == model_cls:
            return None

        from l1000_schema.table_registry import _TABLE_CONFIGS

        has_own_table_config = "SqlTable" in model_cls.__dict__ or "__table_name__" in model_cls.__dict__
        if not has_own_table_config and model_cls in _TABLE_CONFIGS:
            own_config = _TABLE_CONFIGS[model_cls]
            if not own_config.sti_config_override:
                has_own_table_config = True

        if has_own_table_config or not has_table_config(base_class):
            return None
        return cast("type[Any] | None", base_class)

    def _is_json_schema_check_available(self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin) -> bool | None:
        """Check if JSON Schema CHECK constraints are supported by this backend.

        Returns:
            True: Backend supports JSON Schema validation (MySQL/MariaDB/DoltDB)
            False: Backend does not support JSON Schema validation (SQLite)
            None: Unknown/needs runtime detection (PostgreSQL with pg_jsonschema)

        Override in backends that need runtime detection (e.g., PostgreSQL).
        """
        dialect = self.get_dialect()
        if dialect.backend_type.is_mysql_family:
            # Native JSON_SCHEMA_VALID() support
            return True
        if dialect.backend_type == BackendType.SQLITE:
            # No JSON Schema validation support
            return False
        if dialect.backend_type == BackendType.POSTGRES:
            # Requires pg_jsonschema extension - default to False
            # _PostgresConnectionCore overrides this to do actual extension detection
            return False
        return None

    @pure_lazy
    def _collect_constraint_metadata_rows[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        model_cls: type[T],
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        table_constraint_rows: list[tuple[str, str, str | None, str, str, str]],
        column_constraint_rows: list[tuple[str, str, str, str, str]],
    ) -> None:
        """Build constraint metadata rows without performing schema or DML work."""
        from l1000_schema.constraints import Check, UniqueConstraint

        if not has_table_config(model_cls) or not issubclass(model_cls, ApplicationObjectRow):
            return

        pydantic_constraint_types = frozenset(
            {
                "ge",
                "le",
                "gt",
                "lt",
                "min_length",
                "max_length",
                "pattern",
                "multiple_of",
            },
        )
        table_config = get_table_config(model_cls)
        constraints = table_config.constraints
        for constraint in constraints:
            if isinstance(constraint, Check):
                check_constraint = constraint
                expr_repr = repr(check_constraint.expression)
                expr_hash = hashlib.sha256(expr_repr.encode()).hexdigest()
                table_constraint_rows.append(
                    (str(uuid7()), table_name, check_constraint.name, "check", expr_repr, expr_hash),
                )
            elif isinstance(constraint, UniqueConstraint):
                unique_constraint = constraint
                expr_repr = json.dumps(unique_constraint.columns)
                expr_hash = hashlib.sha256(expr_repr.encode()).hexdigest()
                table_constraint_rows.append(
                    (
                        str(uuid7()),
                        table_name,
                        unique_constraint.name,
                        "unique_together",
                        expr_repr,
                        expr_hash,
                    ),
                )

        for field_name, field_info in model_cls.model_fields.items():
            field_attributes = field_info._attributes_set
            for constraint_type, value in (
                ("gt", field_attributes.get("gt")),
                ("ge", field_attributes.get("ge")),
                ("lt", field_attributes.get("lt")),
                ("le", field_attributes.get("le")),
                ("min_length", field_attributes.get("min_length")),
                ("max_length", field_attributes.get("max_length")),
                ("pattern", field_attributes.get("pattern")),
                ("multiple_of", field_attributes.get("multiple_of")),
            ):
                if value is not None:
                    column_constraint_rows.append(
                        (str(uuid7()), table_name, field_name, constraint_type, json.dumps(value)),
                    )
