    @pure_lazy
    def _store_graph_config_metadata_lazy[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
        self: Self,
        schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
        model_cls: type[T],
        table_name: SqlTableName,
    ) -> LazyResult[SqlCoreSchemaEffectResult]:
        """Store GraphEdge configuration metadata for schema drift detection.

        Called during create_table_from_schema for GraphEdge types to persist
        edge constraint settings in sys_graph_config_metadata.

        For polymorphic edge types, stores both:

        * A base-class record with ``type_name=NULL`` (backward compatible)
        * Per-subtype records with ``type_name='SubtypeName'`` for any subtype
          that has its own ``@register_table`` with ``edge_constraints``

        Args:
            model_cls: The model class being created
            table_name: The name of the created table
        """

        # Only process GraphEdge types
        if not is_graph_edge_model(model_cls):
            return LazyResult.of(None)
        _graphs = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("l9600_graphs.graph"))
        if model_cls is _graphs.GraphEdge:
            return LazyResult.of(None)  # Skip the base class itself

        _gcm = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("l3200_metadata.graph_config_metadata"))
        _ec = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("l9600_graphs.edge_constraints"))
        _gip = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("l9600_graphs.graph_index_policy"))
        get_edge_constraints = _ec.get_edge_constraints
        graph_edge_constraints_definition_hash = _ec.graph_edge_constraints_definition_hash
        resolve_graph_index_policy = _gip.resolve_graph_index_policy

        deferred_state = schema_txn._deferred_table_creation_state
        collect_graph_rows = deferred_state.graph_config_metadata_collect_rows

        graph_metadata_dependency_refs: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...] = ()
        if not collect_graph_rows:
            from l2000_connection.schema_transaction import _schema_dependency_refs_for_planning

            graph_metadata_table = self._schema_create_table_from_schema_lazy(
                schema_txn,
                _gcm.GraphConfigMetadata,
                if_not_exists=True,
            )
            graph_metadata_dependency_refs = _schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(
                graph_metadata_table,
            )

        # Get edge constraints from model (base-class constraints)
        edge_constraints = get_edge_constraints(model_cls)
        graph_index_policy = resolve_graph_index_policy(model_cls, edge_constraints)

        # Get cardinality from GraphConfig if present
        cardinality: str | None = None
        source_node_type: str | None = None
        target_node_type: str | None = None
        graph_config = model_cls.__dict__.get("GraphConfig")
        if graph_config is not None:
            cardinality = graph_config.cardinality
            source_node_type = graph_config.source_node_type
            target_node_type = graph_config.target_node_type

        # Map unique flag to allow_multi_edges for metadata storage
        allow_multi_edges = not edge_constraints.unique

        definition_hash = graph_edge_constraints_definition_hash(
            model_cls,
            cardinality=cardinality,
            source_node_type=source_node_type,
            target_node_type=target_node_type,
            graph_index_policy=graph_index_policy,
        )

        graph_row = _gcm.GraphConfigMetadata(
            table_name=table_name,
            type_name=None,
            graph_type="edge",
            cardinality=cardinality,
            source_node_type=source_node_type,
            target_node_type=target_node_type,
            allow_self_loops=edge_constraints.allow_self_loops,
            allow_multi_edges=allow_multi_edges,
            allow_dangling_edges=edge_constraints.allow_dangling,
            debug_insert_validation=edge_constraints.debug_insert_validation,
            definition_hash=definition_hash,
        )
        if collect_graph_rows and deferred_state is not None:
            deferred_state.graph_config_metadata_rows.append(graph_row.model_dump(mode="python"))
            return LazyResult.of(None)
        schema_txn.upsert_bootstrap_rows_lazy(
            _gcm.GraphConfigMetadata,
            (graph_row,),
            conflict_fields=(DynamicFieldName("table_name"), DynamicFieldName("type_name")),
            mutation_kind=BootstrapMutationKind("graph_config_metadata"),
            dependency_refs=graph_metadata_dependency_refs,
            dependency_table_reads=(get_table_name(_gcm.GraphConfigMetadata),),
        )
        return LazyResult.of(None)

    @pure_lazy
    def _graph_config_metadata_has_type_name_column_for_planning(
        self: Self,
        schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
    ) -> bool:
        """Return projected graph-config column presence during planning."""
        table_name = SqlTableName("sys_graph_config_metadata")
        type_name_column = SqlColumnName("type_name")
        answer = schema_txn.projected_or_cached_column_exists(table_name, type_name_column)
        if answer is not SchemaFactPresence.UNKNOWN:
            return answer is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
        projected = schema_txn.projected_column_exists(table_name, type_name_column)
        if projected is not SchemaFactPresence.UNKNOWN:
            return projected is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
        snapshot = schema_txn._schema_reconciliation_snapshot
        if snapshot is None:
            raise LazyPurityError(
                "Graph config metadata column absence requires SchemaStateSnapshot column facts.",
            )
        snapshot_columns = frozenset(str(column) for column in snapshot.columns_for_table(table_name))
        self._cache_table_columns(table_name, tuple(SqlColumnName(column_name) for column_name in snapshot_columns))
        return "type_name" in snapshot_columns

    def _insert_graph_config_metadata_rows_lazy(
        self: Self,
        schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
        rows: tuple[dict[str, object], ...],
        *,
        skip_existing_delete: bool = False,
    ) -> LazyResult[SqlCoreSchemaEffectResult]:
        """Replace graph config metadata for many tables in one delete plus chunked inserts."""
        from l2000_connection.schema_transaction import (
            _schema_dependency_refs_for_planning,
            _schema_static_value_lazy,
        )

        if not rows:
            return LazyResult.of(None)

        include_type_name = self._graph_config_metadata_has_type_name_column_for_planning(schema_txn)
        columns = [
            "sys_id",
            "table_name",
            "graph_type",
            *(("type_name",) if include_type_name else ()),
            "cardinality",
            "source_node_type",
            "target_node_type",
            "allow_self_loops",
            "allow_multi_edges",
            "allow_dangling_edges",
            "debug_insert_validation",
            "definition_hash",
        ]
        table_names = tuple(dict.fromkeys(str(row["table_name"]) for row in rows))
        metadata_table = SqlTableName("sys_graph_config_metadata")
        chunk_size = max(1, min(50, 900 // max(1, len(columns))))
        delete_existing = SqlDelete(
            SqlQuotedIdentifier(metadata_table),
            where=SqlIn(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("table_name")),
                [SqlParam(table_name) for table_name in table_names],
            ),
        )
        statements: list[tuple[SqlRenderable, SqlParamTuple]] = []
        if not skip_existing_delete:
            statements.append((delete_existing, ()))
        for start in range(0, len(rows), chunk_size):
            chunk = rows[start : start + chunk_size]
            insert_stmt = SqlInsert(
                SqlQuotedIdentifier(metadata_table),
                SqlParens(SqlColumnNameList([SqlColumnName(column) for column in columns])),
                SqlValuesClause([SqlValuesRow([SQL_EXPR_PLACEHOLDER] * len(columns)) for _row in chunk]),
                or_ignore=True,
            )
            params = tuple(value for row in chunk for value in (row.get(column) for column in columns))
            statements.append((insert_stmt, normalize_sql_params(params)))
        dependency_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
        schema_txn.enqueue_bootstrap_dml_statements_lazy(
            tuple(statements),
            table_name=metadata_table,
            mutation_kind=BootstrapMutationKind("graph_config_metadata"),
            result_dependency_refs=dependency_refs,
        )
        return _schema_static_value_lazy(schema_txn, None, dependency_refs=tuple(dependency_refs))

    ) -> LazyResult[SqlCoreSchemaEffectResult]:

        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _create_and_populate_type_metadata_table_lazy[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
        model_cls: type[T],
    ) -> LazyResult[SqlCoreSchemaEffectResult]:
        """Lazy variant of :meth:`_create_and_populate_type_metadata_table`."""
        from l1050_polymorphism.type_filter_helper import (
            canonical_polymorphic_type_name,
            polymorphic_type_name_matches,
        )
        from l1050_polymorphism.type_registry import (
            get_polymorphic_base_class,
            get_type_registry,
        )

        if not model_cls.__polymorphic__:
            return LazyResult.of(None)

        base_table = get_table_name(model_cls)
        unified_table = SqlTableName("sys_polymorphic_types")
        legacy_table_name = SqlTableName(f"{base_table}_types")

        metadata_cache = schema_txn._polymorphic_metadata_existing_entries
        cached_entries = metadata_cache.get(base_table)
        if cached_entries is not None:
            existing_entries = cached_entries
        else:
            unified_table_name = SqlTableName("sys_polymorphic_types")
            projected_unified_table = schema_txn.projected_table_exists(unified_table_name)
            snapshot = schema_txn._schema_reconciliation_snapshot
            existed_before_schema_batch = None
            if snapshot is not None:
                for fact in reversed(snapshot.table_facts):
                    if fact.table_name == unified_table_name:
                        existed_before_schema_batch = bool(fact.exists)
                        break
            known_after_commit = schema_txn._known_table_exists_after_commit
            last_bulk_snapshot = schema_txn._last_bulk_table_names_snapshot
            created_in_this_schema_batch = schema_batch_created_table(
                known_after_commit,
                last_bulk_snapshot,
                unified_table_name,
            )
            if (
                projected_unified_table is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT and existed_before_schema_batch is False
            ) or created_in_this_schema_batch:
                existing_entries = []
            else:
                existing_stmt = SqlSelect(
                    SqlColumnNameList(
                        [
                            SqlColumnName("type_id"),
                            SqlColumnName("type_name"),
                            SqlColumnName("python_class"),
                        ],
                    ),
                    from_=SqlTableIdent(unified_table),
                    where=SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("base_table")),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlParam(base_table),
                    ),
                    order_by=[SqlColumnIdent(SqlColumnName("type_id"))],
                )

                del existing_stmt
                msg = (
                    "Lazy polymorphic metadata registration cannot read existing "
                    f"metadata rows for {base_table}; provide observed facts before planning."
                )
                raise LazyPurityError(msg)
            metadata_cache[base_table] = existing_entries
        max_type_id = max((type_id for _type_name, type_id, _python_class in existing_entries), default=0)

        legacy_rows: list[tuple[int, str, str]] = []
        cached_legacy_exists = self._table_exists_from_cache(legacy_table_name)
        if cached_legacy_exists is not None:
            legacy_exists = cached_legacy_exists
        else:
            projected_legacy_exists = schema_txn.projected_or_cached_table_exists(legacy_table_name)
            legacy_exists = projected_legacy_exists is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
            self._record_table_exists_result(legacy_table_name, legacy_exists)
        if legacy_exists:
            legacy_stmt = SqlSelect(
                SqlColumnNameList(
                    [
                        SqlColumnName("id"),
                        SqlColumnName("name"),
                        SqlColumnName("python_class"),
                    ],
                ),
                from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(legacy_table_name)),
                order_by=[SqlColumnIdent(SqlColumnName("id"))],
            )
            del legacy_stmt
            msg = (
                "Lazy polymorphic metadata registration cannot read legacy metadata "
                f"rows from {legacy_table_name}; migrate legacy metadata before lazy bootstrap."
            )
            raise LazyPurityError(msg)

        @pure_lazy
        def _insert_unified_row_lazy(
            *,
            type_id: int,
            type_name: SqlTypeName,
            python_class: str,
            known_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow] | None,
        ) -> None:
            nonlocal max_type_id
            if known_cls is None:
                schema_hash = ""
                schema_hash_v2: str | None = None
                is_base_type = False
                is_abstract = False
                parent_type_name: str | None = None
                polymorphic_strategy = "single_table"
            else:
                schema_hash = ""
                schema_hash_v2 = None
                is_base_type = bool(known_cls.__dict__.get("__polymorphic_concrete_base__", False))
                is_abstract = bool(known_cls.__polymorphic_abstract__)
                parent_type_name = next(
                    (
                        canonical_polymorphic_type_name(parent)
                        for parent in known_cls.__mro__[1:]
                        if getattr(parent, "__polymorphic__", False) and has_table_config(parent) and get_table_name(parent) == base_table
                    ),
                    None,
                )
                polymorphic_strategy = str(
                    known_cls.__polymorphic_strategy__,
                )

            now = datetime.now(UTC)
            row_data: dict[str, object] = {
                "sys_id": SysId.new(),
                "base_table": base_table,
                "type_id": type_id,
                "type_name": type_name,
                "python_class": python_class,
                "schema_hash": schema_hash,
                "schema_hash_v2": schema_hash_v2,
                "is_base_type": is_base_type,
                "is_abstract": is_abstract,
                "parent_type_name": parent_type_name,
                "renamed_from_type_names": json.dumps([]),
                "polymorphic_strategy": polymorphic_strategy,
                "deprecated_at": None,
                "sys_created_at": now,
                "sys_updated_at": now,
            }
            db_column_names = [SqlColumnName(field_name) for field_name in row_data]
            insert_stmt = SqlInsert(
                SqlTableIdent(unified_table),
                SqlParens(SqlColumnNameList(db_column_names)),
                SqlValuesClause([SqlValuesRow([SQL_EXPR_PLACEHOLDER] * len(db_column_names))]),
                or_ignore=True,
            )
            params = tuple(row_data.values())
            if not getattr(schema_txn, "_polymorphic_metadata_table_dependency_refs", ()):
                effect = schema_txn._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                    (SqlCreateUnifiedPolymorphicTypesTable(),),
                    name=SchemaDdlOperationName("unified_polymorphic_metadata_table"),
                    phase=SchemaDdlPhase("create_table"),
                )
                setattr(
                    schema_txn,
                    "_polymorphic_metadata_table_dependency_refs",
                    tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in effect.dependencies()),
                )
            dependency_refs = tuple(
                dict.fromkeys(
                    (
                        *tuple(
                            ServerPlanRefId(ref_id)
                            for ref_id in getattr(
                                schema_txn,
                                "_polymorphic_metadata_table_dependency_refs",
                                (),
                            )
                        ),
                        *schema_txn._schema_ddl_dependency_refs(),
                    ),
                ),
            )
            schema_txn.enqueue_bootstrap_dml_statements_lazy(
                ((insert_stmt, cast(SqlParamTuple, params)),),
                table_name=unified_table,
                mutation_kind=BootstrapMutationKind("polymorphic_metadata"),
                dependency_refs=dependency_refs,
            )
            existing_entries.append((type_name, type_id, python_class))
            max_type_id = max(max_type_id, type_id)

        registry_root = get_polymorphic_base_class(model_cls) or model_cls
        registry = get_type_registry(registry_root)
        registry_tables = {get_table_name(subtype) for subtype in registry.get_all_subtypes()}
        is_dynamic_polymorphic_type = any(bool(getattr(mro_class, "_is_dynamic_base", False)) for mro_class in registry_root.__mro__)
        can_adopt_db_type_ids = len(registry_tables) <= 1 and not is_dynamic_polymorphic_type
        subtype_by_name = {
            SqlTypeName(canonical_polymorphic_type_name(subtype)): subtype
            for subtype in registry.get_all_subtypes()
            if get_table_name(subtype) == base_table
        }

        def _known_subtype_for_name(type_name: SqlTypeName) -> type[Any] | None:
            for subtype_cls in subtype_by_name.values():
                if polymorphic_type_name_matches(subtype_cls, type_name):
                    known_subtype: type[Any] = subtype_cls
                    return known_subtype
            return None

        def _has_existing_type_name(type_name: SqlTypeName) -> bool:
            return any(existing_type_name == type_name for existing_type_name, _tid, _cls in existing_entries)

        def _has_existing_alias_for_subtype(subtype_cls: type) -> bool:
            return any(
                polymorphic_type_name_matches(subtype_cls, existing_type_name) for existing_type_name, _tid, _cls in existing_entries
            )

        if bool(registry_root.__polymorphic_concrete_base__) and not _has_existing_alias_for_subtype(registry_root):
            _insert_unified_row_lazy(
                type_id=0,
                type_name=SqlTypeName(canonical_polymorphic_type_name(registry_root)),
                python_class=f"{registry_root.__module__}.{registry_root.__qualname__}",
                known_cls=registry_root,
            )

        for legacy_type_id, legacy_name, legacy_python_class in legacy_rows:
            legacy_type_name = SqlTypeName(legacy_name)
            known_legacy_cls = _known_subtype_for_name(legacy_type_name)
            if known_legacy_cls is not None:
                if _has_existing_alias_for_subtype(known_legacy_cls):
                    continue
            elif _has_existing_type_name(legacy_type_name):
                continue
            _insert_unified_row_lazy(
                type_id=legacy_type_id,
                type_name=legacy_type_name,
                python_class=legacy_python_class,
                known_cls=known_legacy_cls,
            )

        for subtype_name, subtype_cls in subtype_by_name.items():
            if _has_existing_alias_for_subtype(subtype_cls):
                continue
            if can_adopt_db_type_ids:
                max_type_id += 1
                next_type_id = max_type_id
            else:
                next_type_id = registry.get_type_id(subtype_cls)
            _insert_unified_row_lazy(
                type_id=next_type_id,
                type_name=subtype_name,
                python_class=f"{subtype_cls.__module__}.{subtype_cls.__qualname__}",
                known_cls=subtype_cls,
            )
        return LazyResult.of(None)

    def _prepare_polymorphic_registry_bootstrap_read(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    ) -> _PolymorphicRegistryBootstrapRead | None:
        """Build the metadata read used by sync and async schema bootstrap."""
        from l1050_polymorphism.type_registry import (
            get_polymorphic_base_class,
            get_type_registry,
        )
        from l3200_metadata.type_sync import (
            group_registered_polymorphic_subtypes_by_base_table,
        )

        base_class = get_polymorphic_base_class(model_cls) or model_cls
        registry = get_type_registry(base_class)

        subtypes_by_base_table = group_registered_polymorphic_subtypes_by_base_table(registry)
        if not subtypes_by_base_table:
            return None

        base_tables = tuple(subtypes_by_base_table)
        select_stmt = SqlSelect(
            SqlColumnNameList(
                [
                    SqlColumnName("base_table"),
                    SqlColumnName("type_id"),
                    SqlColumnName("type_name"),
                ],
            ),
            from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("sys_polymorphic_types")),
            where=SqlIn(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("base_table")),
                [SqlParam(base_table) for base_table in base_tables],
            ),
            order_by=[
                SqlColumnIdent(SqlColumnName("base_table")),
                SqlColumnIdent(SqlColumnName("type_name")),
            ],
        )
        return _PolymorphicRegistryBootstrapRead(
            base_class=base_class,
            base_tables=base_tables,
            subtypes_by_base_table=subtypes_by_base_table,
            select_stmt=select_stmt,
        )

    def _reconcile_polymorphic_registry_bootstrap_read(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        bootstrap_read: _PolymorphicRegistryBootstrapRead,
        rows: tuple[DatabaseRow, ...],
    ) -> None:
        """Apply compatibility-only type_id bookkeeping after name-based bootstrap."""
        if not rows:
            return

        from l3200_metadata.type_sync import (
            PolymorphicTypeMapping,
            reconcile_polymorphic_registry_with_mappings,
        )

        mappings: list[PolymorphicTypeMapping] = []
        for row in rows:
            row_type_id = _sql_cell_to_int(cast("SqlCell", row["type_id"]))
            mappings.append(
                PolymorphicTypeMapping(
                    base_table=str(row["base_table"]),
                    type_id=row_type_id,
                    type_name=str(row["type_name"]),
                ),
            )

        reconcile_polymorphic_registry_with_mappings(
            bootstrap_read.base_class,
            mappings,
            subtypes_by_base_table=bootstrap_read.subtypes_by_base_table,
        )

                if_not_exists=if_not_exists,

    _column_cache: dict[SqlTableName, frozenset[SqlColumnName]]
    _column_cache_generations: dict[SqlTableName, int]
    _column_shape_generations: dict[SqlTableName, int]

    @pure_lazy
    def _column_shape_generation(self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin, table_name: SqlTableName) -> int:
        """Return the connection-local generation for a table's column shape."""
        if self._column_shape_generations is None:
            self._column_shape_generations = {}
        return self._column_shape_generations.get(table_name, 0)

    @pure_lazy
    def _cached_table_columns(self: Self, table_name: SqlTableName) -> frozenset[SqlColumnName] | None:
        """Return cached columns only when they match the table's column-shape generation."""
        if self._column_cache is None:
            self._column_cache = {}
        if self._column_cache_generations is None:
            self._column_cache_generations = {}
        cached = self._column_cache.get(table_name)
        if cached is None:
            return None
        if self._column_cache_generations.get(table_name) != self._column_shape_generation(table_name):
            self._column_cache.pop(table_name, None)
            self._column_cache_generations.pop(table_name, None)
            return None
        return cached

    @pure_lazy
    def _cache_table_columns(
        self: Self,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        columns: tuple[SqlColumnName, ...],
    ) -> frozenset[SqlColumnName]:
        """Cache a table-column snapshot at the current column-shape generation."""
        if self._column_cache is None:
            self._column_cache = {}
        if self._column_cache_generations is None:
            self._column_cache_generations = {}
        snapshot = frozenset(columns)
        self._column_cache[table_name] = snapshot
        self._column_cache_generations[table_name] = self._column_shape_generation(table_name)
        return snapshot

    @pure_lazy
    def _invalidate_column_cache(self: Self, table_name: SqlTableName) -> None:
        """Remove cached column set for a table after DDL changes it."""
        if self._column_shape_generations is None:
            self._column_shape_generations = {}
        self._column_shape_generations[table_name] = self._column_shape_generations.get(table_name, 0) + 1
        if self._column_cache is not None:
            self._column_cache.pop(table_name, None)
        if self._column_cache_generations is not None:
            self._column_cache_generations.pop(table_name, None)

    @pure_lazy
    def _invalidate_column_cache_lazy(self: Self, table_name: SqlTableName) -> None:
        """Invalidate derived column facts during lazy schema planning."""
        if self._column_shape_generations is None:
            self._column_shape_generations = {}
        self._column_shape_generations[table_name] = self._column_shape_generations.get(table_name, 0) + 1
        if self._column_cache is not None:
            self._column_cache.pop(table_name, None)
        if self._column_cache_generations is not None:
            self._column_cache_generations.pop(table_name, None)

    @pure_lazy
    def _project_schema_column(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        column_name: SqlColumnName,
    ) -> None:
        """Tell the active schema transaction that a column now exists."""
        existing_columns = self._cached_table_columns(table_name)
        if existing_columns is None:
            authoritative_column_cache = ensure_object_dict(self, DynamicFieldName("_authoritative_template_column_cache"))
            authoritative_columns = authoritative_column_cache.get(table_name)
            if authoritative_columns is not None:
                existing_columns = frozenset(str(column) for column in cast("Iterable[object]", authoritative_columns))
        if existing_columns is None:
            bulk_snapshot = schema_txn._bulk_column_snapshots.get(table_name)
            if bulk_snapshot is not None:
                existing_columns = frozenset(str(column) for column in bulk_snapshot)
            else:
                schema_snapshot = schema_txn._schema_physical_column_snapshots.get(table_name)
                if schema_snapshot is not None:
                    existing_columns = frozenset(str(column) for column in schema_snapshot)
        existing = {SqlColumnName(column) for column in existing_columns or frozenset()}
        existing.add(SqlColumnName(column_name))
        self._cache_table_columns(table_name, tuple(existing))
        for snapshots in (
            schema_txn._bulk_column_snapshots,
            schema_txn._schema_physical_column_snapshots,
        ):
            snapshot = snapshots.get(table_name)
            if snapshot is not None:
                snapshots[table_name] = frozenset((*snapshot, SqlColumnName(column_name)))
        invalidate_bootstrap_scope = self.invalidate_bootstrap_scope_verification
        if callable(invalidate_bootstrap_scope):
            invalidate_bootstrap_scope(table_names=(table_name,))
        project_schema_effects = schema_txn._project_schema_effects
        if not callable(project_schema_effects):
            return

        from l2000_connection.schema_transaction import SchemaOperationEffects

        project_schema_effects(
            SchemaOperationEffects(
                touched_tables=frozenset({table_name}),
                existing_tables=frozenset({table_name}),
                columns_by_table={table_name: frozenset({column_name})},
                idempotent=True,
            ),
        )

        if not columns:

        self._cache_table_columns(table_name, tuple(existing))
        invalidate_bootstrap_scope = self.invalidate_bootstrap_scope_verification

        project_schema_effects = schema_txn._project_schema_effects

        from l2000_connection.schema_transaction import SchemaOperationEffects

        project_schema_effects(

    def _project_versioned_auxiliary_schema_contract(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
        *,
        project_existing_tables: bool,
    ) -> None:
        """Project cold-created versioned auxiliary table shapes before reconcilers run."""
        if not has_table_config(model_cls) or not issubclass(model_cls, ApplicationObjectRow):
            return
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_physical_contract import physical_schema_contract_for_model

        application_model_cls = model_cls
        versioned_table_helpers = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("l3250_migrations.versioned_table_helpers"))
        auxiliary_tables = frozenset(
            SqlTableName(
                str(versioned_table_helpers.get_auxiliary_table_name(application_model_cls, table_type)),
            )
            for table_type in (
                versioned_table_helpers.VersionedTableType.SPARSE,
                versioned_table_helpers.VersionedTableType.TIP,
                versioned_table_helpers.VersionedTableType.STAGED,
            )
        )
        contract = physical_schema_contract_for_model(application_model_cls)
        columns_by_table = {
            SqlTableName(table_name): frozenset(SqlColumnName(column) for column in columns)
            for table_name, columns in contract.required_columns_by_table.items()
            if SqlTableName(table_name) in auxiliary_tables
        }
        indexes_by_table = {
            SqlTableName(table_name): frozenset(SqlIndexName(index) for index in indexes)
            for table_name, indexes in contract.required_indexes_by_table.items()
            if SqlTableName(table_name) in auxiliary_tables
        }
        if columns_by_table:
            for table_name, columns in columns_by_table.items():
                self._cache_table_columns(table_name, tuple(columns))
        project_schema_effects = schema_txn._project_schema_effects
        if not callable(project_schema_effects):
            return

        from l2000_connection.schema_transaction import SchemaOperationEffects

        project_schema_effects(
            SchemaOperationEffects(
                touched_tables=auxiliary_tables,
                existing_tables=auxiliary_tables if project_existing_tables else frozenset(),
                columns_by_table=columns_by_table,
                indexes_by_table=indexes_by_table,
                ddl_artifact_fingerprints=frozenset(
                    SchemaArtifactFingerprint(f"index:{table_name}:{index_name}")
                    for table_name, indexes in indexes_by_table.items()
                    for index_name in indexes
                ),
                catalog_models=frozenset({model_cls}),
                idempotent=True,
            ),
        )

    def cached_table_columns_snapshot(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
    ) -> dict[SqlTableName, frozenset[SqlColumnName]]:
        """Return a copy of table-column metadata already known by this connection."""
        if not self._column_cache is not None:
            return {}
        return {
            SqlTableName(table_name): frozenset(SqlColumnName(column) for column in cached_columns)
            for table_name in tuple(self._column_cache)
            if (cached_columns := self._cached_table_columns(SqlTableName(table_name))) is not None
        }

    @pure_lazy
    def _load_table_columns_lazy(self: Self, table_name: SqlTableName) -> LazyResult[list[str]]:
        """Return cached column names; lazy planning must not interrogate physical schema."""
        cached = self._cached_table_columns(table_name)
        if cached is not None:
            return LazyResult.of(sorted(str(column) for column in cached))
        raise LazyPurityError(
            f"_load_table_columns_lazy({table_name!r}) requires cached, projected, or SchemaStateSnapshot column facts.",
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _load_table_columns_many_lazy(
        self: Self,
        table_names: tuple[SqlTableName, ...],
        schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
    ) -> LazyResult[Mapping[SqlTableName, frozenset[SqlColumnName]]]:
        """Fetch cached or projected column-name snapshots for many tables."""
        snapshots: dict[SqlTableName, frozenset[SqlColumnName]] = {}
        requested_names = tuple(dict.fromkeys(name for name in table_names if str(name)))
        bulk_snapshots = schema_txn._bulk_column_snapshots
        physical_snapshots = schema_txn._schema_physical_column_snapshots
        for table_name in requested_names:
            cached = self._cached_table_columns(table_name)
            if cached is not None:
                snapshots[table_name] = cached
                continue
            bulk_cached = bulk_snapshots.get(table_name)
            if bulk_cached is not None:
                snapshots[table_name] = self._cache_table_columns(
                    table_name,
                    tuple(bulk_cached),
                )
                continue
            physical_cached = physical_snapshots.get(table_name)
            if physical_cached is not None:
                snapshots[table_name] = self._cache_table_columns(
                    table_name,
                    tuple(physical_cached),
                )
                continue
        missing_names = tuple(table_name for table_name in requested_names if self._cached_table_columns(table_name) is None)
        if missing_names:
            for table_name in missing_names:
                _record_bootstrap_profile_counter("column_snapshot_miss_async", str(table_name))
        for table_name in requested_names:
            cached = self._cached_table_columns(table_name)
            if cached is None:
                raise LazyPurityError(
                    f"_load_table_columns_many_lazy({table_name!r}) requires cached, projected, or SchemaStateSnapshot column facts.",
                )
            snapshots[table_name] = frozenset(cached)
        result: Mapping[SqlTableName, frozenset[SqlColumnName]] = snapshots
        return LazyResult.of(result)

    def _schema_column_exists_impl(self: Self, table_name: SqlTableName, column_name: SqlColumnName) -> bool:
        """Check if a column exists in a table."""
        cached = self._cached_table_columns(table_name)
        if cached is not None:
            return column_name in cached

        assert_bootstrap_strict_mode_allows_lazy(
            phase=current_bootstrap_phase(),
            operation=f"column_exists({table_name!r}, {column_name!r})",
            category="physical schema interrogation",
            alternative=(
                "use projected_or_cached_column_exists(), materialized bootstrap facts, "
                "or a lazy column fact instead of loading physical columns eagerly."
            ),
        )
        owner = _require_schema_transaction_owner(self)
        with owner.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema_txn:
            exists = schema_txn.column_exists(table_name, column_name)
        if exists is None:
            msg = f"Schema transaction did not establish column existence for {table_name}.{column_name}"
            raise LazyPurityError(msg)
        return exists

    def _schema_column_exists_lazy(self: Self, table_name: SqlTableName, column_name: SqlColumnName) -> LazyResult[bool]:
        """Lazy variant of :meth:`column_exists` using :meth:`grammar_rows_lazy`."""

    @pure_lazy
    def _schema_add_column_if_missing_impl(
        self: Self,
        schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        column_name: SqlColumnName,
        field_info: FieldInfo,
        *,
        generated_expression: SqlRenderable | None = None,
        resolved_annotation: type | None = None,
        force_nullable: bool = False,
        snapshot: SchemaStateSnapshot | None = None,
        known_missing: bool = False,
    ) -> LazyResult[SqlCoreSchemaEffectResult]:
        """Lazy variant of :meth:`add_column_if_missing` using grammar async execution."""

        # A desired-schema projection does not override a closed physical fact
        # that says this column is still missing.
        if schema_txn.projected_column_exists(table_name, column_name) is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT and not known_missing:
            return LazyResult.of(None)

        if snapshot is not None:
            table_exists = None
            for fact in reversed(snapshot.table_facts):
                if fact.table_name == table_name:
                    table_exists = bool(fact.exists)
                    break
            physical_columns = {str(name) for name in snapshot.columns_for_table(table_name)}
            if table_exists is not True:
                bulk_columns = schema_txn._bulk_column_snapshots.get(table_name)
                if bulk_columns is None:
                    bulk_columns = schema_txn._schema_physical_column_snapshots.get(table_name)
                if bulk_columns is not None:
                    table_exists = True
                    physical_columns = {str(name) for name in bulk_columns}
        else:
            bulk_columns = schema_txn._bulk_column_snapshots.get(table_name)
            if bulk_columns is None:
                bulk_columns = schema_txn._schema_physical_column_snapshots.get(table_name)
            if bulk_columns is not None:
                table_exists = True
                physical_columns = {str(name) for name in bulk_columns}
            else:
                projected_table_state = schema_txn.projected_table_exists(table_name)
                table_exists = projected_table_state is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
                if not table_exists and not known_missing:
                    return LazyResult.of(None)
                if known_missing:
                    table_exists = True
                    physical_columns = set()
                else:
                    from l2055_lazy_result.purity import LazyPurityError

                    raise LazyPurityError(
                        f"_schema_add_column_if_missing_lazy({table_name}.{column_name}) "
                        "requires SchemaStateSnapshot or bootstrap interrogation column facts "
                        "when planning lazy reconciliation for an existing table.",
                    )
        if known_missing:
            table_exists = True
        if not physical_columns and table_exists is not True:
            return LazyResult.of(None)
        if not known_missing and column_name in physical_columns or not schema_txn._reserve_add(table_name, column_name):
            return LazyResult.of(None)
        dialect = self.get_dialect()

        extra = field_info.json_schema_extra if field_info.json_schema_extra is not None else None
        override_sql_type = mapping_value(extra, "sql_type")
        if override_sql_type is None:
            _fts_cfg = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("l5100_fts.fts_config"))
            override_sql_type = _fts_cfg.get_fts_hash_sql_type(column_name)
        override_sql_type_text = nonempty_string(override_sql_type)
        if override_sql_type_text is not None:
            import re

            if not re.match(
                r"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_ ]*(?:\(\d+(?:,\s*\d+)?\))?$",
                override_sql_type_text.strip(),
                re.IGNORECASE,
            ):
                import logging

                logging.getLogger(__name__).warning(
                    "Suspicious sql_type override '%s' for column %s - skipping override",
                    override_sql_type_text,
                    column_name,
                )
                override_sql_type = None
            else:
                override_sql_type = override_sql_type_text
        sql_type: str
        if override_sql_type_text is not None and override_sql_type is not None:
            sql_type = override_sql_type_text
        else:
            ann = _schema_field_annotation(field_info, resolved_annotation=UNSET if resolved_annotation is None else resolved_annotation)
            from l1000_schema.json_type import _JsonMarker, is_json_column

            if not is_json_column(ann) and metadata_contains_instance(
                tuple(field_info.metadata),
                _JsonMarker,
            ):
                ann = Annotated[ann, _JsonMarker()]
            _sb_add_col = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("impl.common.l3000_schema_builder.schema_builder"))

            sql_type = _sb_add_col._get_sql_type(cast(Any, ann), dialect)

        # Normalize declared SQL type for dialect-specific DDL restrictions
        # (SQLite STRICT rejects BIGINT/BOOLEAN/VARCHAR/TIMESTAMP declarations).
        from impl.common.l2200_sql_dialect.sql_dialect import (
            normalize_declared_sql_type_for_dialect,
        )

        sql_type = normalize_declared_sql_type_for_dialect(sql_type, dialect)

        use_generated = generated_expression is not None and dialect.supports_generated_columns()
        if use_generated and dialect.backend_type == BackendType.SQLITE and _is_optional_generated_storage_column(field_info):
            # SQLite cannot add STORED generated columns through ALTER TABLE.
            # Optional hash storage still has to exist after schema evolution,
            # so add it as an ordinary nullable application-maintained column.
            use_generated = False

        if use_generated:
            assert generated_expression is not None
            from l1000_schema.schema_def import is_derived_column

            generated_kind = (
                ColumnConstraintKind.GENERATED_VIRTUAL
                if dialect.backend_type is BackendType.SQLITE and is_derived_column(field_info)
                else ColumnConstraintKind.GENERATED_STORED
            )
            constraints_gen: tuple[SqlColumnConstraint, ...] = (
                SqlColumnConstraint(
                    generated_kind,
                    generated_expression,
                ),
            )
        elif force_nullable:
            constraints_gen = (SqlColumnConstraint(ColumnConstraintKind.NULL),)
        else:
            constraints_gen = _compute_add_column_constraints(
                field_info,
                dialect,
                resolved_annotation=resolved_annotation,
            )

        col_def = SqlColumnDef(
            SqlColumnName(column_name),
            SqlTypeName(sql_type),
            constraints=tuple(constraints_gen),
        )

        use_if_not_exists = dialect.supports_if_not_exists_on_add_column()

        stmt: SqlRenderable = SqlAlterTable(
            SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(table_name)),
            [
                SqlAlterAction(
                    AlterActionKind.ADD_COLUMN,
                    column_def=col_def,
                    if_not_exists=use_if_not_exists,
                ),
            ],
        )
        if dialect.backend_type is BackendType.POSTGRES and not force_nullable:
            from pydantic_core import PydanticUndefined

            annotation = _schema_field_annotation(
                field_info,
                resolved_annotation=UNSET if resolved_annotation is None else resolved_annotation,
            )
            required_without_default = (
                field_info.is_required()
                and not _model_field_nullable(field_info, annotation)
                and field_info.default is PydanticUndefined
                and generated_expression is None
            )
            if required_without_default:
                from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.reconciliation.conditional_ddl import (
                    SqlExecuteDdlIfTableEmpty,
                )

                stmt = SqlExecuteDdlIfTableEmpty(SqlTableName(table_name), stmt)

        ddl_effect = schema_txn._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
            (stmt,),
            name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"add_column:{table_name}.{column_name}"),
            phase=SchemaDdlPhase("schema_reconciliation"),
        )
        self._invalidate_column_cache_lazy(table_name)
        self._project_schema_column(schema_txn, table_name, column_name)
        from l2000_connection.schema_transaction import _schema_dependency_refs_for_planning, _schema_static_value_lazy

        return _schema_static_value_lazy(
            schema_txn,
            None,
            dependency_refs=_schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(ddl_effect),
        )

    def _python_type_to_sql_type(
        self: Self,
        python_type: object,
    ) -> str:
        """Convert a Python type annotation to SQL column type.

        Uses the same SQL type derivation as schema creation so migration DDL
        stays aligned with ``create_table_from_schema()`` and reconciliation.
        Unsupported or opaque types still fall back to ``TEXT``.

        Args:
            python_type: Python type annotation

        Returns:
            SQL type string appropriate for the current dialect
        """

        _sb_type_mapping = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("impl.common.l3000_schema_builder.schema_builder"))

        try:
            sql_type = _sb_type_mapping._get_sql_type(python_type, self.get_dialect())
            sql_type_text = nonempty_string(sql_type)
            assert sql_type_text is not None
            return sql_type_text
        except (TypeError, ValueError, NotImplementedError):
            return "TEXT"

    @pure_lazy
    def _existing_table_is_empty_for_reconcile_lazy(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
    ) -> LazyResult[bool]:
        """Lazy variant of :meth:`_existing_table_is_empty_for_reconcile`."""
        snapshot = schema_txn._schema_reconciliation_snapshot
        snapshot_exists = None
        if snapshot is not None:
            for fact in reversed(snapshot.table_facts):
                if fact.table_name == SqlTableName(table_name):
                    snapshot_exists = bool(fact.exists)
                    break
        if snapshot_exists is False:
            return LazyResult.of(True)
        if snapshot_exists is None and schema_txn.projected_table_exists(table_name) is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT:
            return LazyResult.of(True)
        from l2055_lazy_result.purity import LazyPurityError

        raise LazyPurityError(
            f"_existing_table_is_empty_for_reconcile_lazy({table_name}) cannot run a "
            "row probe during lazy reconciliation; data-dependent NOT NULL column "
            "migration requires an explicit migration path.",
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _with_projected_introspected_columns(
        introspected: IntrospectedTable,
        column_names: tuple[SqlColumnName, ...],
    ) -> IntrospectedTable:
        """Return an introspection snapshot including schema DDL queued in this transaction."""
        from impl.common.l3100_schema_introspector.schema_introspector import (
            IntrospectedColumn,
            IntrospectedTable,
        )

        known_columns = {column.name for column in introspected.columns}
        projected_columns = [
            IntrospectedColumn(name=SqlColumnName(column_name), data_type=SqlTypeName("UNKNOWN"), nullable=True)
            for column_name in column_names
            if column_name not in known_columns
        ]
        if not projected_columns:
            return introspected
        return IntrospectedTable(
            name=SqlTableName(introspected.name),
            columns=(*introspected.columns, *projected_columns),
            indexes=introspected.indexes,
            constraints=introspected.constraints,
            triggers=introspected.triggers,
            fts_indexes=introspected.fts_indexes,
            is_view=introspected.is_view,
            extra_metadata=introspected.extra_metadata,
        )

    def _drop_large_column_source_not_null(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        column_name: SqlColumnName,
        logger: logging.Logger,
        *,
        column_type: str | None = None,
    ) -> LazyResult[SqlCoreSchemaEffectResult]:
        from l2000_connection.schema_transaction import _schema_dependency_refs_for_planning, _schema_static_value_lazy

        dialect = self.get_dialect()
        if dialect.uses_modify_column_syntax() and not column_type:
            logger.warning(
                "Schema reconciliation: large-column source %s.%s is NOT NULL; backend %s requires column type to render nullable migration",
                table_name,
                column_name,
                dialect.backend_type,
            )
            return LazyResult.of(None)
        stmt = SqlAlterTable(
            SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(table_name)),
            [
                SqlAlterAction(
                    AlterActionKind.DROP_NOT_NULL,
                    column=SqlColumnName(column_name),
                    column_type=SqlTypeName(column_type) if dialect.uses_modify_column_syntax() and column_type else None,
                ),
            ],
        )
        effect = schema_txn._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
            (stmt,),
            name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"drop_large_column_not_null:{table_name}.{column_name}"),
            phase=SchemaDdlPhase("schema_reconciliation"),
        )
        self._invalidate_column_cache_lazy(table_name)
        logger.info(
            "Schema reconciliation: dropped NOT NULL from large-column source %s.%s",
            table_name,
            column_name,
        )
        return _schema_static_value_lazy(schema_txn, None, dependency_refs=_schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(effect))

    def _reconcile_legacy_fts_hash_column_names_lazy(
        self: Self,
        schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        introspected: IntrospectedTable,
        logger: logging.Logger,
    ) -> LazyResult[bool]:
        """Lazy variant of :meth:`_reconcile_legacy_fts_hash_column_names`."""
        from l2000_connection.schema_transaction import _schema_dependency_refs_for_planning, _schema_static_value_lazy

        changed = False
        statements: list[SqlRenderable] = []
        for legacy_name, current_name in _LEGACY_FTS_HASH_COLUMN_RENAMES:
            if introspected.get_column(SqlColumnName(current_name)) is not None:
                continue
            if introspected.get_column(SqlColumnName(legacy_name)) is None:
                continue

            stmt = SqlAlterTable(
                SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(table_name)),
                [
                    SqlAlterAction(
                        AlterActionKind.RENAME_COLUMN,
                        column=SqlColumnName(legacy_name),
                        new_name=SqlColumnName(current_name),
                    ),
                ],
            )
            statements.append(stmt)
            self._invalidate_column_cache_lazy(table_name)
            self._project_schema_column_rename(
                schema_txn,
                table_name,
                SqlColumnName(legacy_name),
                SqlColumnName(current_name),
            )
            logger.info(
                "Schema reconciliation: renamed legacy FTS column %s.%s to %s.%s",
                table_name,
                legacy_name,
                table_name,
                current_name,
            )
            changed = True
        if not statements:
            return LazyResult.of(changed)
        effect = schema_txn._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
            tuple(statements),
            name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"rename_legacy_fts_hash_columns:{table_name}"),
            phase=SchemaDdlPhase("schema_reconciliation"),
        )
        dependency_refs = _schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(effect)
        return _schema_static_value_lazy(schema_txn, changed, dependency_refs=dependency_refs)

    @staticmethod
    def _strip_redundant_outer_parentheses_index_predicate(expr: str) -> str:
        """Peel outer ``( ... )`` wrappers that enclose the whole predicate."""
        result = expr.strip()
        while _SqlCoreSupportMixin._has_wrapping_parentheses(result):
            inner = result[1:-1].strip()
            if not inner:
                break
            result = inner
        return result

    @staticmethod
    def _balanced_parenthesis_group_close_index(s: str) -> int | None:
        """If *s* starts with ``(``, return the index of its matching ``)``, else None."""
        stripped = s.strip()
        if not stripped or stripped[0] != "(":
            return None
        depth = 0
        for index, char in enumerate(stripped):
            if char == "(":
                depth += 1
            elif char == ")":
                depth -= 1
                if depth == 0:
                    return index
        return None

    @staticmethod
    def _is_simple_index_predicate_column_ref(s: str) -> bool:
        """True for a single unquoted column reference (optionally schema-qualified)."""
        token = s.strip()
        if not token or re.search(r"\s", token):
            return False
        return bool(re.fullmatch(r"[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*(?:\.[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*)?", token))

    @staticmethod
    @pure_lazy
    def _normalize_index_predicate_sql(value: str | None) -> str | None:
        """Normalize partial-index predicates for comparison across dialect renderers."""
        if value is None:
            return None
        normalized = value.strip().replace('"', "").replace("`", "")
        normalized = " ".join(normalized.lower().split())
        if not normalized:
            return None
        normalized = _SqlCoreSupportMixin._strip_redundant_outer_parentheses_index_predicate(normalized)
        not_match = re.match(r"^not\s+", normalized)
        if not_match:
            rest_stripped = normalized[not_match.end() :].strip()
            close_idx = _SqlCoreSupportMixin._balanced_parenthesis_group_close_index(rest_stripped)
            if close_idx is not None and close_idx == len(rest_stripped) - 1:
                inner = rest_stripped[1:close_idx].strip()
                inner_canon = _SqlCoreSupportMixin._strip_redundant_outer_parentheses_index_predicate(inner)
                if _SqlCoreSupportMixin._is_simple_index_predicate_column_ref(inner_canon):
                    return f"not {inner_canon}"
        return normalized or None

    @pure_lazy
    def _reconcile_polymorphic_check_constraint_lazy[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
        model_cls: type[T],
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        introspected: IntrospectedTable,
        logger: logging.Logger,
    ) -> LazyResult[SqlCoreSchemaEffectResult]:
        """Lazy variant of :meth:`_reconcile_polymorphic_check_constraint`."""
        plan = self._build_polymorphic_check_reconciliation_plan(model_cls, table_name, introspected)
        assert plan is not None, "polymorphic check reconciliation planning must produce a plan"

        if plan.ambiguous:
            self._raise_ambiguous_polymorphic_check_constraint(table_name)
        elif plan.existing_constraint is None:
            existing_names = frozenset(constraint.name for constraint in introspected.constraints)
            constraint_name = self._choose_polymorphic_check_constraint_name(table_name, existing_names)
            self._add_polymorphic_check_constraint_lazy(
                schema_txn,
                table_name,
                constraint_name,
                plan.expected_constraint,
                logger,
            )
        else:
            existing_normalized = self._normalize_check_definition(plan.existing_constraint.definition)
            if existing_normalized != plan.expected_normalized or plan.extra_constraint_names:
                self._replace_polymorphic_check_constraint_lazy(
                    schema_txn,
                    table_name,
                    SqlConstraintName(plan.existing_constraint.name),
                    plan.expected_constraint,
                    logger,
                    extra_constraint_names=tuple(SqlConstraintName(name) for name in plan.extra_constraint_names),
                )
        return LazyResult.of(None)

    @pure_lazy
    def _reconcile_polymorphic_check_constraint_for_write_lazy[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        model_cls: type[T],
    ) -> LazyResult[SqlCoreSchemaEffectResult]:
        """Lazy variant of :meth:`_reconcile_polymorphic_check_constraint_for_write`."""
        from l1050_polymorphism.type_registry import get_polymorphic_base_class

        root_cls = get_polymorphic_base_class(model_cls) or model_cls
        if (
            not root_cls.__polymorphic__
            or root_cls.__polymorphic_strategy__ != "single_table"
            or not self.get_dialect().supports_drop_constraint()
        ):
            return LazyResult.of(None)

        table_name = get_table_name(root_cls)
        msg = (
            "Lazy polymorphic CHECK reconciliation cannot introspect or execute DDL "
            f"for {table_name}; declare the constraint change through the schema transaction plan."
        )
        raise LazyPurityError(msg)

    @pure_lazy
    def _build_polymorphic_check_reconciliation_plan[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        model_cls: type[T],
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        introspected: IntrospectedTable,
    ) -> _PolymorphicCheckReconciliationPlan | None:
        """Build the shared sync/async plan for STI CHECK reconciliation."""
        if not model_cls.__polymorphic__ or model_cls.__polymorphic_strategy__ != "single_table":
            return None

        dialect = self.get_dialect()
        if not dialect.supports_drop_constraint():
            return None

        expected_constraint = generate_polymorphic_check_constraint(model_cls)
        if expected_constraint is None:
            return None
        missing_check_columns = self._missing_polymorphic_check_columns(model_cls, introspected)
        if missing_check_columns:
            missing_text = ", ".join(missing_check_columns)
            msg = (
                "Polymorphic CHECK constraint references columns absent from target table: "
                f"model={model_cls.__module__}.{model_cls.__qualname__} "
                f"table={table_name} missing_columns={missing_text}"
            )
            raise ValueError(msg)
        expected_sql, params = render_to_sql(expected_constraint, dialect)
        assert not params, "CHECK constraint DDL must not use bind params"

        expected_normalized = self._normalize_check_definition(expected_sql)
        subtype_field_names = self._get_polymorphic_constraint_field_names(model_cls)
        existing_constraint, ambiguous = self._find_polymorphic_check_constraint(
            tuple(introspected.constraints),
            expected_normalized,
            frozenset(subtype_field_names),
            table_name=table_name,
        )
        extra_constraint_names = self._polymorphic_check_constraints_to_replace(
            tuple(introspected.constraints),
            expected_normalized=expected_normalized,
            existing_constraint=existing_constraint,
            table_name=table_name,
        )
        return _PolymorphicCheckReconciliationPlan(
            expected_constraint=expected_constraint,
            expected_normalized=expected_normalized,
            existing_constraint=existing_constraint,
            ambiguous=ambiguous,
            extra_constraint_names=extra_constraint_names,
        )

    @staticmethod
    @pure_lazy
    def _polymorphic_check_constraints_to_replace(
        constraints: tuple[IntrospectedConstraint, ...],
        *,
        expected_normalized: str,
        existing_constraint: IntrospectedConstraint | None,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
    ) -> tuple[SqlConstraintName, ...]:
        """Return stale generated discriminator branches replaced with the current branch."""
        generated_type_name_check_re = re.compile(
            rf"^{re.escape(table_name)}_type_name_check\d*$",
        )
        canonical_name = _SqlCoreSupportMixin._build_polymorphic_check_constraint_name(
            table_name,
        )
        create_table_name = f"{table_name}_check"
        generated_name_prefix = f"{canonical_name}_"
        return tuple(
            sorted(
                constraint.name
                for constraint in constraints
                if constraint.constraint_type == "CHECK"
                and (
                    generated_type_name_check_re.match(constraint.name)
                    or _SqlCoreSupportMixin._normalize_check_definition(
                        str(constraint.definition),
                    )
                    == expected_normalized
                    or (
                        re.search(
                            r"\btype_(?:id|name)\b[^=]*(?<![<>!])=(?!=)",
                            _SqlCoreSupportMixin._normalize_check_definition(
                                str(constraint.definition),
                            ),
                        )
                        and (
                            constraint.name == canonical_name
                            or constraint.name == create_table_name
                            or constraint.name.startswith(generated_name_prefix)
                            or constraint.name.startswith("CONSTRAINT_")
                        )
                    )
                )
                and (existing_constraint is None or constraint.name != existing_constraint.name)
            ),
        )

    @staticmethod
    @pure_lazy
    def _missing_polymorphic_check_columns[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
        model_cls: type[T],
        introspected: IntrospectedTable,
    ) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        """Return generated polymorphic CHECK columns absent from the physical table."""
        from l1050_polymorphism.type_registry import get_type_registry

        table_columns = {column.name for column in introspected.columns}
        required_columns = {"type_name"}
        base_fields = set(model_cls.model_fields)
        for subtype in get_type_registry(model_cls).get_all_subtypes():
            for field_name in set(subtype.model_fields) - base_fields:
                required_columns.add(get_db_column_name(subtype, DynamicFieldName(field_name)))
        return tuple(sorted(column for column in required_columns if column not in table_columns))
