    @staticmethod
    @pure_lazy
    def _build_add_polymorphic_check_constraint_ddl(
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        constraint_name: SqlConstraintName,
        expected_constraint: SqlCheckConstraintDef,
    ) -> SqlAlterTable:
        """Build grammar for adding an STI CHECK constraint."""

        table_ref = SqlQuotedIdentifier(SqlTableName(table_name))
        alter_actions = [
            SqlAlterAction(
                AlterActionKind.ADD_CONSTRAINT,
                value=SqlConstraintName(constraint_name),
                column_def=SqlCheckConstraintBody(expected_constraint.expression),
            ),
        ]
        return SqlAlterTable(table_ref, alter_actions)

    @staticmethod
    @pure_lazy
    def _build_replace_polymorphic_check_constraint_ddl(
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        constraint_name: SqlConstraintName,
        expected_constraint: SqlCheckConstraintDef,
        *,
        extra_constraint_names: tuple[SqlConstraintName, ...] = (),
    ) -> SqlAlterTable:
        """Build grammar for replacing an STI CHECK constraint."""

        table_ref = SqlQuotedIdentifier(SqlTableName(table_name))
        branded_constraint_name = SqlConstraintName(constraint_name)
        alter_actions = [
            SqlAlterAction(
                AlterActionKind.DROP_CONSTRAINT,
                value=branded_constraint_name,
                if_exists=True,
            ),
            *(
                SqlAlterAction(
                    AlterActionKind.DROP_CONSTRAINT,
                    value=SqlConstraintName(extra_constraint_name),
                    if_exists=True,
                )
                for extra_constraint_name in extra_constraint_names
            ),
            SqlAlterAction(
                AlterActionKind.ADD_CONSTRAINT,
                value=branded_constraint_name,
                column_def=SqlCheckConstraintBody(expected_constraint.expression),
            ),
        ]
        return SqlAlterTable(table_ref, alter_actions)

    @staticmethod
    @pure_lazy
    def _raise_ambiguous_polymorphic_check_constraint(table_name: SqlTableName) -> NoReturn:
        msg = f"Schema reconciliation found multiple polymorphic CHECK candidates on {table_name}; manual migration is required"
        raise RuntimeError(msg)

    @staticmethod
    @pure_lazy
    def _find_polymorphic_check_constraint(
        constraints: tuple[IntrospectedConstraint, ...],
        expected_normalized: str,
        subtype_field_names: frozenset[str],
        *,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
    ) -> tuple[IntrospectedConstraint | None, bool]:
        """Locate the existing CHECK constraint that enforces polymorphic subtype branches."""
        exact_matches: list[IntrospectedConstraint] = []
        legacy_constraints: list[tuple[IntrospectedConstraint, str]] = []
        canonical_name = _SqlCoreSupportMixin._build_polymorphic_check_constraint_name(table_name)
        create_table_name = f"{table_name}_check"
        generated_name_prefix = f"{canonical_name}_"
        postgres_generated_check_re = re.compile(rf"^{re.escape(create_table_name)}\d*$")
        postgres_generated_type_name_check_re = re.compile(
            rf"^{re.escape(table_name)}_type_name_check\d*$",
        )
        for constraint in constraints:
            constraint_type = constraint.constraint_type
            definition = _SqlCoreSupportMixin._normalize_check_definition(
                str(constraint.definition),
            )
            if constraint_type != "CHECK":
                continue
            if definition == expected_normalized:
                exact_matches.append(constraint)
                continue
            if "length" in definition and "type_name" in definition and "<=" in definition:
                continue
            if not re.search(r"\btype_(?:id|name)\b[^=]*(?<![<>!])=(?!=)", definition):
                continue
            if (
                constraint.name != canonical_name
                and constraint.name != create_table_name
                and not constraint.name.startswith(generated_name_prefix)
                and not constraint.name.startswith("CONSTRAINT_")
                and not postgres_generated_check_re.match(constraint.name)
                and not postgres_generated_type_name_check_re.match(constraint.name)
            ):
                continue
            legacy_constraints.append((constraint, definition))

        resolved_constraint: IntrospectedConstraint | None = None
        ambiguous = False
        normalized_field_names = {
            field_name.lower() for field_name in subtype_field_names if field_name.lower() not in {"type_id", "type_name"}
        }
        if len(exact_matches) == 1:
            resolved_constraint = exact_matches[0]
        elif len(exact_matches) > 1:
            preferred_exact_matches = [constraint for constraint in exact_matches if constraint.name == canonical_name]
            if not preferred_exact_matches:
                preferred_exact_matches = [constraint for constraint in exact_matches if constraint.name == create_table_name]
            if len(preferred_exact_matches) == 1:
                resolved_constraint = preferred_exact_matches[0]
            else:
                resolved_constraint = sorted(
                    exact_matches,
                    key=lambda constraint: constraint.name,
                )[0]
        elif len(legacy_constraints) == 1:
            resolved_constraint = legacy_constraints[0][0]
        elif len(legacy_constraints) > 1:
            preferred_legacy_constraints = [
                constraint for constraint, _definition in legacy_constraints if constraint.name == canonical_name
            ]
            if not preferred_legacy_constraints:
                preferred_legacy_constraints = [
                    constraint for constraint, _definition in legacy_constraints if constraint.name == create_table_name
                ]
            if len(preferred_legacy_constraints) == 1:
                resolved_constraint = preferred_legacy_constraints[0]
                return resolved_constraint, ambiguous
            type_name_generated_constraints = [
                constraint
                for constraint, _definition in legacy_constraints
                if postgres_generated_type_name_check_re.match(constraint.name)
            ]
            if len(type_name_generated_constraints) == 1:
                resolved_constraint = type_name_generated_constraints[0]
                return resolved_constraint, ambiguous
            if len(type_name_generated_constraints) > 1:
                resolved_constraint = sorted(
                    type_name_generated_constraints,
                    key=lambda constraint: constraint.name,
                )[0]
                return resolved_constraint, ambiguous
            if not normalized_field_names:
                legacy_constraint_values = [constraint for constraint, _definition in legacy_constraints]
                canonical_legacy = [constraint for constraint in legacy_constraint_values if constraint.name == canonical_name]
                if len(canonical_legacy) == 1:
                    resolved_constraint = canonical_legacy[0]
                else:
                    generated_table_legacy = [
                        constraint for constraint in legacy_constraint_values if constraint.name == create_table_name
                    ]
                    if len(generated_table_legacy) == 1:
                        resolved_constraint = generated_table_legacy[0]
                    else:
                        return None, True
                return resolved_constraint, ambiguous
            scored_constraints: list[tuple[int, IntrospectedConstraint]] = []
            for constraint, definition in legacy_constraints:
                score = _SqlCoreSupportMixin._polymorphic_constraint_field_overlap_score(
                    definition,
                    frozenset(normalized_field_names),
                )
                scored_constraints.append((score, constraint))

            best_score = max(score for score, _constraint in scored_constraints)
            best_constraints = [constraint for score, constraint in scored_constraints if score == best_score]
            if len(best_constraints) == 1:
                resolved_constraint = best_constraints[0]
            else:
                canonical_best = [constraint for constraint in best_constraints if constraint.name == canonical_name]
                if len(canonical_best) == 1:
                    resolved_constraint = canonical_best[0]
                else:
                    resolved_constraint = sorted(
                        best_constraints,
                        key=lambda constraint: constraint.name,
                    )[0]

        return resolved_constraint, ambiguous

    @staticmethod
    def _polymorphic_constraint_field_overlap_score(
        definition: str,
        subtype_field_names: frozenset[str],
    ) -> int:
        """Score how likely a CHECK definition is the generated polymorphic constraint."""
        score = 0
        for field_name in subtype_field_names:
            if field_name == "type_id":
                continue
            if re.search(rf"\b{re.escape(field_name)}\b", definition):
                score += 1
        return score

    @staticmethod
    @pure_lazy
    def _get_polymorphic_constraint_field_names[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
        model_cls: type[T],
    ) -> set[str]:
        """Return field names that should appear in the generated polymorphic CHECK."""
        from l1050_polymorphism.type_registry import get_type_registry

        field_names = {"type_name"}
        base_fields = set(model_cls.model_fields.keys())
        for subtype in get_type_registry(model_cls).get_all_subtypes():
            for field_name in set(subtype.model_fields.keys()) - base_fields:
                field_names.add(field_name)
                field_names.add(get_db_column_name(subtype, DynamicFieldName(field_name)))
        return field_names

    @staticmethod
    @pure_lazy
    def _build_polymorphic_check_constraint_name(table_name: SqlTableName, suffix: str = "") -> str:
        """Build a deterministic, Postgres-safe name for an auto-added CHECK constraint."""
        base_name = f"ck_{table_name}_polymorphic_type_id{suffix}"
        if len(base_name) <= _MAX_POSTGRES_IDENTIFIER_LEN:
            return base_name
        digest = hashlib.sha1(f"{table_name}{suffix}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:8]
        prefix_length = _MAX_POSTGRES_IDENTIFIER_LEN - len(digest) - 1
        return f"{base_name[:prefix_length]}_{digest}"

    @staticmethod
    @pure_lazy
    def _choose_polymorphic_check_constraint_name(
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        existing_names: frozenset[str],
    ) -> SqlConstraintName:
        """Choose a deterministic free name for an auto-added polymorphic CHECK constraint."""
        for attempt in range(1000):
            suffix = "" if attempt == 0 else f"_{attempt}"
            candidate = _SqlCoreSupportMixin._build_polymorphic_check_constraint_name(table_name, suffix)
            if candidate not in existing_names:
                return SqlConstraintName(candidate)
        msg = f"Could not find a free polymorphic CHECK constraint name for {table_name}"
        raise RuntimeError(msg)

    @staticmethod
    @pure_lazy
    def _normalize_check_definition(definition: str) -> str:
        """Normalize CHECK SQL for semantic comparison across dialect renderers."""
        normalized = definition.strip()
        if normalized.upper().startswith("CHECK "):
            normalized = normalized[5:].strip()
        while _SqlCoreSupportMixin._has_wrapping_parentheses(normalized):
            inner = normalized[1:-1].strip()
            if not inner:
                break
            normalized = inner
        normalized = normalized.replace('"', "").replace("`", "")
        normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", normalized)
        return normalized.lower().strip()

    @staticmethod
    def _has_wrapping_parentheses(expression: str) -> bool:
        """Return True when one outer parenthesis pair wraps the entire expression."""
        stripped = expression.strip()
        if len(stripped) < _MIN_PAREN_WRAPPER_LEN or stripped[0] != "(" or stripped[-1] != ")":
            return False

        depth = 0
        for index, char in enumerate(stripped):
            if char == "(":
                depth += 1
            elif char == ")":
                depth -= 1
                if depth < 0:
                    return False
                if depth == 0 and index != len(stripped) - 1:
                    return False

        return depth == 0

    @pure_lazy
    def _check_column_compatibility_lazy(
        self: Self,
        schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        db_col_name: SqlColumnName,
        annotation: type,
        introspected_col: IntrospectedColumn,
        logger: logging.Logger,
        field_info: FieldInfo | None = None,
    ) -> LazyResult[SqlCoreSchemaEffectResult]:
        """Lazy variant of :meth:`_check_column_compatibility`."""
        if db_col_name.startswith("sys_") and db_col_name != "sys_id":
            return LazyResult.of(None)

        _sb_col_compat = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("impl.common.l3000_schema_builder.schema_builder"))

        expected_sql_type = _sb_col_compat._get_sql_type(annotation, self.get_dialect())
        actual_type = introspected_col.data_type

        if not _sql_types_compatible(expected_sql_type, actual_type):
            if _is_safe_type_promotion(
                SqlNormalizedTypeName(expected_sql_type),
                SqlNormalizedTypeName(actual_type),
            ):
                self._auto_promote_column_type_lazy(
                    schema_txn,
                    table_name,
                    db_col_name,
                    expected_sql_type,
                    actual_type,
                    logger,
                    nullable=introspected_col.nullable,
                )
                actual_type = expected_sql_type
            else:
                logger.warning(
                    "Schema reconciliation: column %s.%s type mismatch: "
                    "model expects %s (%s), database has %s "
                    "(requires manual migration)",
                    table_name,
                    db_col_name,
                    expected_sql_type,
                    annotation,
                    actual_type,
                )

        model_nullable = _model_field_nullable(field_info, annotation) if field_info is not None else _annotation_is_nullable(annotation)
        db_nullable = introspected_col.nullable

        if model_nullable == db_nullable:
            return LazyResult.of(None)

        if model_nullable and not db_nullable and self._supports_automatic_nullable_relaxation():
            self._auto_relax_column_nullability_lazy(
                schema_txn,
                table_name,
                db_col_name,
                actual_type,
                logger,
            )
            return LazyResult.of(None)

        logger.warning(
            "Schema reconciliation: column %s.%s nullable mismatch: model expects %s, database is %s",
            table_name,
            db_col_name,
            "NULL" if model_nullable else "NOT NULL",
            "NULL" if db_nullable else "NOT NULL",
        )
        return LazyResult.of(None)

    @pure_lazy
    def _supports_automatic_nullable_relaxation(self: Self) -> bool:
        """Return True if this backend can safely relax NOT NULL in place."""
        supports_relaxation: bool = self.get_dialect().backend_type != BackendType.SQLITE
        return supports_relaxation

    @pure_lazy
    def _auto_relax_column_nullability_lazy(
        self: Self,
        schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        column_name: SqlColumnName,
        column_type: str,
        logger: logging.Logger,
    ) -> LazyResult[SqlCoreSchemaEffectResult]:
        """Lazy variant of :meth:`_auto_relax_column_nullability`."""
        from l2000_connection.schema_transaction import _schema_dependency_refs_for_planning, _schema_static_value_lazy

        dialect = self.get_dialect()
        action = SqlAlterAction(
            AlterActionKind.DROP_NOT_NULL,
            column=SqlColumnName(column_name),
            column_type=SqlTypeName(column_type) if dialect.uses_modify_column_syntax() else None,
        )
        alter_stmt = SqlAlterTable(
            SqlQuotedIdentifier(SqlTableName(table_name)),
            [action],
        )
        effect = schema_txn._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
            (alter_stmt,),
            name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"relax_column_nullability:{table_name}.{column_name}"),
            phase=SchemaDdlPhase("schema_reconciliation"),
        )
        logger.info(
            "Schema reconciliation: relaxed column %s.%s from NOT NULL to NULL",
            table_name,
            column_name,
        )
        return _schema_static_value_lazy(schema_txn, None, dependency_refs=_schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(effect))

    def _validate_column_data_for_uuid_promotion_lazy(

    @pure_lazy
    def _auto_promote_column_type_lazy(
        self: Self,
        schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        column_name: SqlColumnName,
        expected_type: str,
        actual_type: str,
        logger: logging.Logger,
        *,
        nullable: bool = True,
    ) -> LazyResult[SqlCoreSchemaEffectResult]:
        """Lazy variant of :meth:`_auto_promote_column_type`."""
        expected_affinity = _normalize_type_affinity(SqlNormalizedTypeName(expected_type))

        if expected_affinity not in {"UUID", "JSON"}:
            msg = (
                f"Schema reconciliation: unsupported type promotion "
                f"{actual_type} -> {expected_type} for column {table_name}.{column_name}"
            )
            raise db_exc.IntegrityError(msg)

        dialect = self.get_dialect()
        if expected_affinity == "JSON" and dialect.backend_type is BackendType.POSTGRES and dialect.version_tuple < (16,):
            logger.warning(
                "Schema reconciliation: column %s.%s promotion from %s to %s requires manual migration",
                table_name,
                column_name,
                actual_type,
                expected_type,
            )
            return LazyResult.of(None)

        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.reconciliation.json_validation import (
            SqlJsonCastUsing,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.reconciliation.uuid_validation import (
            SqlUuidCastUsing,
        )
        from l2000_connection.schema_transaction import (
            _schema_dependency_refs_for_planning,
            _schema_static_value_lazy,
        )

        using = None
        if not dialect.uses_modify_column_syntax():
            using = (
                SqlJsonCastUsing(SqlColumnName(column_name))
                if expected_affinity == "JSON"
                else SqlUuidCastUsing(SqlColumnName(column_name))
            )
        alter_stmt = SqlAlterTable(
            SqlQuotedIdentifier(SqlTableName(table_name)),
            [
                SqlAlterAction(
                    AlterActionKind.ALTER_TYPE,
                    column=SqlColumnName(column_name),
                    new_type=SqlTypeName(expected_type),
                    nullable=nullable,
                    using=using,
                ),
            ],
        )
        effect = schema_txn._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
            (alter_stmt,),
            name=SchemaDdlOperationName(f"promote_column_type:{table_name}.{column_name}"),
            phase=SchemaDdlPhase("schema_reconciliation"),
        )
        logger.info(
            "Schema reconciliation: promoted column %s.%s from %s to %s",
            table_name,
            column_name,
            actual_type,
            expected_type,
        )
        return _schema_static_value_lazy(
            schema_txn,
            None,
            dependency_refs=_schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(effect),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _is_vector_index_aux_model(self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin, model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]) -> bool:
        """Return True for SQL vector-index auxiliary tables that should be idempotent."""
        auxiliary_base_names = frozenset(
            {
                "HnswNodeBase",
                "HnswEdgeBase",
                "HnswMetadataBase",
                "HnswContentNodeBase",
                "HnswContentEdgeBase",
                "USearchIndexBlobBase",
            }
        )
        return any(
            base.__module__ == "l5200_vector_index.hnsw_models" and base.__name__ in auxiliary_base_names for base in model_cls.__mro__
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _ensure_vector_index_aux_tables_lazy(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        schema_txn: LazySchemaTransaction,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    ) -> LazyResult[SqlCoreSchemaEffectResult]:
        """Lazy variant of :meth:`_ensure_vector_index_aux_tables`."""
        if self._is_vector_index_aux_model(model_cls):
            return LazyResult.of(None)
        if not getattr(model_cls, "__vector_indexes__", None):
            return LazyResult.of(None)

        _hnsw_aux = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("l5200_vector_index.hnsw_models"))
        _vcfg_row = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("l3200_metadata.vector_config_record"))
        create_hnsw_node_class = _hnsw_aux.create_hnsw_node_class
        create_hnsw_edge_class = _hnsw_aux.create_hnsw_edge_class
        create_hnsw_metadata_class = _hnsw_aux.create_hnsw_metadata_class
        create_hnsw_content_node_class = _hnsw_aux.create_hnsw_content_node_class
        create_hnsw_content_edge_class = _hnsw_aux.create_hnsw_content_edge_class
        vector_index_config_record = _vcfg_row.VectorIndexConfigRecord
        _vcfg = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("l5200_vector_index.vector_config"))
        get_vector_indexes = _vcfg.get_vector_indexes

        vector_indexes = get_vector_indexes(model_cls)
        if not vector_indexes:
            return LazyResult.of(None)

        self._schema_create_table_from_schema_lazy(schema_txn, vector_index_config_record, if_not_exists=True)
        if not any(config.resolved_index_policy.approximate_index for config in vector_indexes.values()):
            return LazyResult.of(None)
        table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
        for aux_model in (
            create_hnsw_node_class(table_name),
            create_hnsw_edge_class(table_name),
            create_hnsw_content_node_class(table_name),
            create_hnsw_content_edge_class(table_name),
            create_hnsw_metadata_class(table_name),
        ):
            self._schema_create_table_from_schema_lazy(schema_txn, aux_model, if_not_exists=True)
        return LazyResult.of(None)

    def _finalize_commit_branch_ripple_context(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        *,
        revision_id: RevisionId,
    ) -> RevisionId:
        """Finalize branch publication by enforcing SQL-trigger ripple authority."""
        ripple_context = self._last_ripple_context
        try:
            if ripple_context is not None and ripple_context.get("should_ripple") and ripple_context["domain"].graphs:
                _ripple_reg = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("l9800_rippling.registry"))
                registry = _ripple_reg.RippleRegistry.get_instance()
                registry.require_domain_sql_triggers(
                    ripple_context["domain"],
                    standard=True,
                    connection=True,
                )
        finally:
            # Always clear the context to prevent stale state (even if rippling was disabled)
            self._last_ripple_context = None

        return revision_id

    async def _finalize_commit_branch_ripple_context_async(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        *,
        revision_id: RevisionId,
    ) -> RevisionId:
        """Async entrypoint for the shared branch-publish ripple finalizer."""
        return self._finalize_commit_branch_ripple_context(revision_id=revision_id)

    def _collect_large_column_metadata(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        model_cls: type,
    ) -> tuple[LargeColumnMetadataSnapshot, ...]:
        """Collect declared large column metadata for a versioned table."""

        if not is_versioned_object_model(model_cls):
            return ()

        # Get large_columns from table registry
        if not has_table_config(model_cls):
            return ()
        table_config = get_table_config(model_cls)
        if not table_config.large_columns:
            return ()
        large_columns = table_config.large_columns

        metadata: list[LargeColumnMetadataSnapshot] = []
        for config in large_columns:
            large_column_config = object_of_type_or_none(config, LargeColumnConfig)
            config_mapping = mapping_or_none(config)
            if large_column_config is not None:
                compression_policy = large_column_config.compression_policy
                application_compression = large_column_application_compression_enabled(
                    parse_column_compression_policy(compression_policy),
                )
                metadata.append(
                    LargeColumnMetadataSnapshot.model_validate(
                        {
                            "column": SqlColumnName(str(large_column_config.column)),
                            "spill_threshold_bytes": large_column_config.spill_threshold_bytes,
                            "content_type": large_column_config.content_type,
                            "compression_policy": compression_policy,
                            "resolved_compression": "application_zstd" if application_compression else None,
                            "compression_algorithm": "zstd" if application_compression else None,
                            "compression_level": 6 if application_compression else None,
                            "native_compression_applied": False if application_compression else None,
                        },
                    ),
                )
            elif config_mapping is not None:
                column_name = config_mapping.get("column")
                if not column_name:
                    continue
                compression_policy_text = str(config_mapping.get("compression_policy", "default"))
                application_compression = large_column_application_compression_enabled(
                    parse_column_compression_policy(compression_policy_text),
                )
                metadata.append(
                    LargeColumnMetadataSnapshot.model_validate(
                        {
                            "column": SqlColumnName(str(column_name)),
                            "spill_threshold_bytes": config_mapping.get("spill_threshold_bytes"),
                            "content_type": config_mapping.get("content_type"),
                            "compression_policy": compression_policy_text,
                            "resolved_compression": "application_zstd" if application_compression else None,
                            "compression_algorithm": "zstd" if application_compression else None,
                            "compression_level": 6 if application_compression else None,
                            "native_compression_applied": False if application_compression else None,
                        },
                    ),
                )
        return tuple(metadata)

    @pure_lazy
    def _get_content_store_table_name(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        model_cls: type,
    ) -> SqlTableName:
        """Return the per-model content-store table name."""
        store_name = f"{get_table_name(model_cls)}_content_store"
        backend_type = getattr(self, "backend_type")
        is_mysql_family = backend_type.is_mysql_family
        is_postgres = backend_type is BackendType.POSTGRES
        if not (is_mysql_family or is_postgres) or len(store_name) <= 48:
            return SqlTableName(store_name)
        from hashlib import sha1

        digest = sha1(store_name.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12]
        return SqlTableName(f"{store_name[:35]}_{digest}")

    @pure_lazy
    def _get_fts_spilled_columns(self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin, model_cls: type) -> list[str]:
        """Return large-column names that are also FTS-indexed text fields."""
        return [field_name for field_name, _pointer_name in get_spilled_fts_text_columns(model_cls)]

    def _ensure_content_store_fts(self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin, model_cls: type) -> None:
        """Create content-store FTS infrastructure when spilled text is searchable."""
        _ = model_cls

    @pure_lazy
    def _prepare_large_column_spill[RowDataT: dict[str, object]](
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        model_cls: type,
        row_data: RowDataT,
    ) -> tuple[RowDataT, list[ContentStoreEntry], list[ContentStoreFtsEntry]]:
        """Compute large-column spill metadata and compressed payloads (CPU only, no SQL).

        Returns a triple:
        1. Mutated ``row_data`` (content replaced by pointer).
        2. Content-store parameter tuples ready for batch INSERT.
        3. FTS entries ``(content_hash, plaintext)`` for columns that are
           both FTS-indexed and text-typed.  Empty when not applicable.
        """
        configs = get_large_column_configs(model_cls)
        if not configs:
            return row_data, [], []

        timing_enabled = is_detailed_timing_enabled()
        timing_started = time.perf_counter() if timing_enabled else None
        input_bytes = 0
        stored_bytes = 0
        columns_spilled = 0
        fts_spilled_cols = frozenset(self._get_fts_spilled_columns(model_cls))

        entries: list[ContentStoreEntry] = []
        fts_entries: list[ContentStoreFtsEntry] = []
        for config in configs:
            column_name = config.column
            pointer_name = large_column_pointer_name(ContentColumnName(column_name))
            value = row_data.get(column_name)
            pointer_override = row_data.get(pointer_name)
            precomputed_hash: str | None = nonempty_string(pointer_override)

            if value is None:
                row_data[pointer_name] = None
                continue

            payload, is_binary = self._encode_large_column_value(value, MimeContentType(config.content_type))

            input_bytes += len(payload)
            if len(payload) <= config.spill_threshold_bytes:
                row_data[pointer_name] = None
                continue

            content_hash = precomputed_hash or hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
            compression_policy = parse_column_compression_policy(config.compression_policy)
            if large_column_application_compression_enabled(compression_policy):
                stored_content, compression_metadata = compress(
                    payload,
                    algorithm=CompressionAlgorithm.ZSTD,
                    level=6,
                    skip_if_compressed=True,
                )
                if compression_metadata is not None and compression_metadata.is_compressed():
                    comp_algo = compression_metadata.algorithm.value
                    comp_level = compression_metadata.compression_level
                    comp_original_size = compression_metadata.original_size
                else:
                    comp_algo = "none"
                    comp_level = 0
                    comp_original_size = 0
            else:
                stored_content = payload
                comp_algo = "none"
                comp_level = 0
                comp_original_size = 0

            columns_spilled += 1
            stored_bytes += len(stored_content)
            entries.append(
                (
                    content_hash,
                    len(stored_content),
                    is_binary,
                    stored_content,
                    0,  # total_chunks
                    0,  # chunk_size
                    comp_algo,
                    comp_level,
                    comp_original_size,
                ),
            )
            row_data[pointer_name] = content_hash
            row_data[column_name] = None

            if column_name in fts_spilled_cols and not is_binary:
                fts_entries.append((content_hash, payload.decode("utf-8")))

        if timing_started is not None:
            merge_detailed_timing(
                "large_column_spill",
                {
                    "model": model_cls.__name__,
                    "columns_considered": len(configs),
                    "columns_spilled": columns_spilled,
                    "content_store_entries": len(entries),
                    "fts_entries": len(fts_entries),
                    "input_bytes": input_bytes,
                    "stored_bytes": stored_bytes,
                    "duration_ms": round((time.perf_counter() - timing_started) * 1000, 3),
                },
            )

        return row_data, entries, fts_entries

    @pure_lazy
    def _encode_large_column_value(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        value: object,
        content_type: MimeContentType,
    ) -> tuple[bytes, bool]:
        """Normalize a large-column value to canonical content-store bytes."""
        return large_column_value_bytes(value, content_type)

    def backfill_large_column_storage_from_schema(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        model_cls: type,
        *,
        batch_size: int = 1000,
        max_rows: int | None = None,
        progress_callback: Callable[[LargeColumnBackfillProgress], None] | None = None,
        force_all_inline: bool = False,
    ) -> list[LargeColumnBackfillResult]:
        """Move existing oversized inline values into configured content stores.

        This is the common SQL-owned maintenance path for adding
        ``LargeColumnConfig`` to an existing table. It reuses the same canonical
        encoding, compression, content-store grammar, chunk grammar, and backend
        commit primitive as normal SQL large-column writes.
        """
        if batch_size <= 0:
            msg = "batch_size must be positive"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if max_rows is not None and max_rows < 0:
            msg = "max_rows must be non-negative or None"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        self.connect()

        configs = get_large_column_configs(model_cls)
        if not configs:
            return []

        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import ContentHashValue
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.content_store import (
            SqlContentChunkInsertTemplate,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_content_store import (
            SqlBatchedContentStoreUpsert,
            SqlContentStoreUpsert,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_large_column_backfill import (
            SqlLargeColumnBackfillCandidateScan,
            SqlLargeColumnBackfillPointerUpdate,
        )
        from impl.common.l2505_compression.algorithms import hash_and_compress_batch

        table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
        store_table = SqlTableName(self._get_content_store_table_name(model_cls))
        table_ident = SqlTableName(table_name)
        results: list[LargeColumnBackfillResult] = []

        def _write_chunked_content(write: ChunkedContentWrite) -> None:
            chunk_size = self._CHUNK_SIZE_BYTES
            total_size = len(write.stored_content)
            total_chunks = (total_size + chunk_size - 1) // chunk_size
            self._execute_direct_internal(
                SqlContentStoreUpsert(
                    store_table,
                    ContentHashValue(write.content_hash),
                    total_size,
                    write.is_binary,
                    b"",
                    total_chunks=total_chunks,
                    chunk_size=chunk_size,
                    compression_algorithm=write.compression_algorithm,
                    compression_level=write.compression_level,
                    original_size=write.original_size,
                ),
            )
            chunk_stmt = SqlContentChunkInsertTemplate(store_table)
            for chunk_index in range(total_chunks):
                start = chunk_index * chunk_size
                chunk = write.stored_content[start : start + chunk_size]
                self._execute_direct_internal(
                    chunk_stmt,
                    params=(
                        write.content_hash,
                        chunk_index,
                        hashlib.sha256(chunk).hexdigest(),
                        chunk,
                        len(chunk),
                    ),
                )

        for config in configs:
            column_name = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(config.column))
            pointer_name = large_column_pointer_name(config.column)
            scanned = 0
            converted = 0
            skipped_small = 0
            input_bytes = 0
            stored_bytes = 0
            pointer_bytes = 0
            last_seen_sys_id: object | None = None
            started_at = time.perf_counter()

            while max_rows is None or converted < max_rows:
                batch_limit = batch_size if max_rows is None else min(batch_size, max_rows - converted)
                if batch_limit <= 0:
                    break
                rows = self._execute_direct_internal(
                    SqlLargeColumnBackfillCandidateScan(
                        table_ident,
                        SqlColumnName(column_name),
                        SqlColumnName(pointer_name),
                        threshold=config.spill_threshold_bytes,
                        limit=batch_limit,
                        last_seen_sys_id=last_seen_sys_id,
                    ),
                    fetch_mode="all",
                )
                self._commit()
                if not rows:
                    break

                scanned += len(rows)
                last_seen_sys_id = rows[-1]["sys_id"]
                encoded_rows: list[tuple[object, bytes, bool]] = []
                for row in rows:
                    payload, is_binary = self._encode_large_column_value(
                        row[column_name],
                        MimeContentType(config.content_type),
                    )
                    input_bytes += len(payload)
                    if len(payload) <= config.spill_threshold_bytes and not force_all_inline:
                        skipped_small += 1
                        continue
                    encoded_rows.append((row["sys_id"], payload, is_binary))

                compressed_rows = hash_and_compress_batch([payload for _sys_id, payload, _is_binary in encoded_rows])
                content_entries: list[ContentStoreEntry] = []
                chunked_writes: list[ChunkedContentWrite] = []
                row_updates: list[tuple[str, object]] = []
                batch_stored_bytes = 0
                for (sys_id, _payload, is_binary), (content_hash, stored_content, compression_metadata) in zip(
                    encoded_rows,
                    compressed_rows,
                    strict=True,
                ):
                    if compression_metadata is not None and compression_metadata.is_compressed():
                        comp_algo = compression_metadata.algorithm.value
                        comp_level = compression_metadata.compression_level
                        comp_original_size = compression_metadata.original_size
                    else:
                        comp_algo = "none"
                        comp_level = 0
                        comp_original_size = 0
                    size_bytes = len(stored_content)
                    batch_stored_bytes += size_bytes
                    if size_bytes > self._CHUNK_SIZE_BYTES:
                        chunked_writes.append(
                            ChunkedContentWrite(
                                store_table=str(store_table),
                                content_hash=content_hash,
                                stored_content=stored_content,
                                is_binary=is_binary,
                                compression_algorithm=comp_algo,
                                compression_level=comp_level,
                                original_size=comp_original_size,
                            ),
                        )
                    else:
                        content_entries.append(
                            (
                                ContentHashValue(content_hash),
                                size_bytes,
                                is_binary,
                                stored_content,
                                0,
                                0,
                                comp_algo,
                                comp_level,
                                comp_original_size,
                            ),
                        )
                    row_updates.append((content_hash, sys_id))

                converted_before = converted
                if content_entries:
                    self._execute_direct_internal(
                        SqlBatchedContentStoreUpsert(
                            store_table,
                            cast(
                                "Sequence[tuple[ContentHashValue, int, bool, bytes, int, int, str, int, int]]",
                                content_entries,
                            ),
                        ),
                    )
                for write in chunked_writes:
                    _write_chunked_content(write)
                for content_hash, sys_id in row_updates:
                    self._execute_direct_internal(
                        SqlLargeColumnBackfillPointerUpdate(
                            table_ident,
                            SqlColumnName(column_name),
                            SqlColumnName(pointer_name),
                            content_hash=content_hash,
                            sys_id=sys_id,
                        ),
                    )
                    converted += max(self._rowcount(), 0)
                if row_updates:
                    self._commit()
                stored_bytes += batch_stored_bytes
                pointer_bytes += sum(len(content_hash) for content_hash, _sys_id in row_updates)

                if progress_callback is not None:
                    progress_callback(
                        {
                            "table": table_name,
                            "column": SqlColumnName(str(column_name)),
                            "batch_converted": converted - converted_before,
                            "scanned": scanned,
                            "converted": converted,
                            "skipped_small": skipped_small,
                            "input_bytes": input_bytes,
                            "stored_bytes": stored_bytes,
                            "pointer_bytes": pointer_bytes,
                            "elapsed_seconds": round(time.perf_counter() - started_at, 6),
                        },
                    )

            results.append(
                {
                    "table": table_name,
                    "column": SqlColumnName(str(column_name)),
                    "scanned": scanned,
                    "converted": converted,
                    "skipped_small": skipped_small,
                    "input_bytes": input_bytes,
                    "stored_bytes": stored_bytes,
                    "pointer_bytes": pointer_bytes,
                    "elapsed_seconds": round(time.perf_counter() - started_at, 6),
                },
            )
        return results

    @pure_lazy
    def _content_store_entries_lazy(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        model_cls: type,
        entries: tuple[ContentStoreEntry, ...],
    ) -> LazyResult[list[PlanEffect]]:
        """Build content-store upsert effects for unique payload hashes."""
        return self._content_store_entries_effect_refs(model_cls, entries).result

    @pure_lazy
    def _content_store_entries_effect_refs(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        model_cls: type,
        entries: tuple[ContentStoreEntry, ...],
    ) -> SqlPlanEffectRefs:
        """Build content-store upsert effects for unique payload hashes."""
        if not entries:
            return self._sql_plan_effect_refs(())

        store_table = SqlTableName(self._get_content_store_table_name(model_cls))
        plan = self._plan_for_sql_lazy()
        seen: set[str] = set()
        effect_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
        for entry in entries:
            content_hash = entry[0]
            if content_hash in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(content_hash)
            ref_id = plan._next_ref()
            plan.add_step(
                ContentStoreUpsertStep(
                    ref_id,
                    ContentStoreEntryConfig(store_table=store_table, params=entry),
                ),
            )
            effect_refs.append(ref_id)

        return self._sql_plan_effect_refs(tuple(effect_refs))

    @pure_lazy
    def _content_store_fts_lazy(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        model_cls: type,
        fts_entries: tuple[ContentStoreFtsEntry, ...],
    ) -> LazyResult[list[PlanEffect]]:
        """Build content-store FTS effects."""

    def _content_store_fts_effect_refs(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        model_cls: type,
        fts_entries: tuple[ContentStoreFtsEntry, ...],
    ) -> SqlPlanEffectRefs:
        """Build content-store FTS effects."""

        return self._sql_plan_effect_refs(())

    @pure_lazy
    def _spill_large_columns_lazy(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        model_cls: type,
        row_data: dict[str, object],
    ) -> LazyResult[dict[str, object]]:
        """Build spill effects and return the mutated row data."""
        row_data, entries, fts_entries = self._prepare_large_column_spill(model_cls, row_data)
        entry_effects = self._content_store_entries_effect_refs(model_cls, tuple(entries))
        fts_effects = self._content_store_fts_effect_refs(model_cls, tuple(fts_entries))
        source_refs = (*entry_effects.source_refs, *fts_effects.source_refs)
        return self._static_after_sql_deps_lazy(row_data, source_refs)

    @pure_lazy
    def _hydrate_large_columns_lazy(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        _model_cls: type,
        row_data: dict[str, object],
    ) -> LazyResult[dict[str, object]]:
        """Build lazy large-column hydration work for backends with external storage."""
        return LazyResult.of(row_data)

    def _hydrate_large_columns_with_runtime_step(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        model_cls: type,
        row_data: dict[str, object],
    ) -> LazyResult[dict[str, object]]:
        """Hydrate spilled large columns through one explicit runtime projection step."""
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.plan_helpers import _publish_ref

        configs = get_large_column_configs(model_cls)
        if not configs:
            return LazyResult.of(row_data)

        hydrated_row = dict(row_data)
        entries: list[_LargeColumnHydrationEntry] = []
        for config in configs:
            column_name = config.column
            db_column_name = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(column_name))
            if column_name not in hydrated_row and db_column_name in hydrated_row:
                hydrated_row[column_name] = hydrated_row[db_column_name]
            pointer_name = large_column_pointer_name(ContentColumnName(column_name))
            pointer = hydrated_row.get(pointer_name)
            hydrated_row.pop(pointer_name, None)
            if pointer is None or hydrated_row.get(column_name) is not None:
                continue
            manifest = self._storage_chunk_manifest_lazy(
                model_cls,
                str(pointer),
                store_row_decoder=dict_sql_row,
                chunk_row_decoder=dict_sql_row,
            )
            shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
                cast("LazyResult[SqlCoreInspectableLazyValue]", manifest),
                site=f"{type(self).__name__}._hydrate_large_columns_with_runtime_step",
            )
            if shape.symbolic_ref_id is None:
                if not shape.has_literal_value:
                    msg = "Large-column manifest requires a literal value or symbolic ServerPlan ref"
                    raise TypeError(msg)
                hydrated_row = materialize_large_column_hydration_runtime(
                    _LargeColumnHydrationRuntimeConfig(
                        backend_type=self.get_dialect().backend_type,
                        row_data=hydrated_row,
                        entries=(
                            _LargeColumnHydrationEntry(
                                source_ref=ServerPlanRefId("__literal_manifest__"),
                                column_config=config,
                                pointer=str(pointer),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                    ResolvedRefs({"__literal_manifest__": shape.literal_value}),
                )
                continue
            entries.append(
                _LargeColumnHydrationEntry(
                    source_ref=shape.symbolic_ref_id,
                    column_config=config,
                    pointer=str(pointer),
                ),
            )
        if not entries:
            return LazyResult.of(hydrated_row)

        plan = self._plan_for_sql_lazy()
        ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(plan._next_ref())
        plan.add_step(
            _LargeColumnHydrationRuntimeStep(
                ref_id,
                config=_LargeColumnHydrationRuntimeConfig(
                    backend_type=self.get_dialect().backend_type,
                    row_data=hydrated_row,
                    entries=tuple(entries),
                ),
            )
        )
        return cast(
            "LazyResult[dict[str, object]]",
            _publish_ref(self, plan, ref_id, op="select_one", expected_type=dict),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _storage_chunk_manifest_lazy[StoreRowT, ChunkRowT](
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        model_cls: type,
        content_hash: str,
        *,
        store_row_decoder: RowDecoder[StoreRowT],
        chunk_row_decoder: RowDecoder[ChunkRowT],
    ) -> LazyResult[ContentStoreManifest[StoreRowT, ChunkRowT]]:
        """Build lazy reads for one spilled payload manifest."""
        return self._storage_chunk_manifest_for_table_lazy(
            self._get_content_store_table_name(model_cls),
            content_hash,
            store_row_decoder=store_row_decoder,
            chunk_row_decoder=chunk_row_decoder,
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _storage_chunk_manifest_for_table_lazy[StoreRowT, ChunkRowT](
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        store_table: str,
        content_hash: str,
        *,
        store_row_decoder: RowDecoder[StoreRowT],
        chunk_row_decoder: RowDecoder[ChunkRowT],
    ) -> LazyResult[ContentStoreManifest[StoreRowT, ChunkRowT]]:
        """Build lazy reads for one spilled payload manifest from an explicit store table."""
        table_name = SqlTableName(store_table)
        plan = self._plan_for_sql_lazy()
        store_ref = plan._next_ref()
        plan.add_step(
            ContentStoreRowLookupStep[StoreRowT](
                store_ref,
                ContentStoreLookupConfig(
                    store_table=table_name,
                    content_hash=content_hash,
                    row_decoder=store_row_decoder,
                ),
            ),
        )
        chunks_ref = plan._next_ref()
        plan.add_step(
            ContentChunkRowsLookupStep[ChunkRowT](
                chunks_ref,
                ContentStoreLookupConfig(
                    store_table=table_name,
                    content_hash=content_hash,
                    row_decoder=chunk_row_decoder,
                ),
            ),
        )
        ref_id = plan._next_ref()
        plan.add_step(
            ContentStoreManifestLookupStep[StoreRowT, ChunkRowT](
                ref_id,
                ContentStoreManifestConfig(
                    store_ref=store_ref,
                    chunks_ref=chunks_ref,
                ),
            ),
        )
        return self._publish_sql_lazy_ref(ref_id)

    def _read_storage_chunk_manifest_rows(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        model_cls: type,
        content_hash: str,
    ) -> tuple[dict[str, object], list[dict[str, object]]] | None:
        """Read committed large-column storage manifest rows through the direct SQL lane."""

        store_table = SqlTableName(self._get_content_store_table_name(model_cls))
        store_row = self._execute_direct_internal(
            SqlContentStoreSelectTemplate(store_table),
            params=(content_hash,),
            fetch_mode="one",
        )
        if store_row is None:
            return None
        chunk_rows = self._execute_direct_internal(
            SqlContentChunksSelectTemplate(store_table),
            params=(content_hash,),
            fetch_mode="all",
        )
        return dict(store_row), [dict(row) for row in chunk_rows]

    async def _read_storage_chunk_manifest_rows_async(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        model_cls: type,
        content_hash: str,
    ) -> tuple[dict[str, object], list[dict[str, object]]] | None:
        """Async counterpart to ``_read_storage_chunk_manifest_rows``."""

        store_table = SqlTableName(self._get_content_store_table_name(model_cls))
        store_row = await self._execute_direct_internal_async(
            SqlContentStoreSelectTemplate(store_table),
            params=(content_hash,),
            fetch_mode="one",
        )
        if store_row is None:
            return None
        chunk_rows = await self._execute_direct_internal_async(
            SqlContentChunksSelectTemplate(store_table),
            params=(content_hash,),
            fetch_mode="all",
        )
        return dict(store_row), [dict(row) for row in chunk_rows]

    def _extract_large_column_hashes_from_rows(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        model_cls: type,
        rows: tuple[Mapping[str, object], ...],
    ) -> Counter[ContentHashValue]:
        """Count occurrences of large-column content hashes within in-memory rows."""
        configs = get_large_column_configs(model_cls)
        if not configs or not rows:
            return Counter()

        pointer_columns = [large_column_pointer_name(ContentColumnName(cfg.column)) for cfg in configs]
        counts: Counter[ContentHashValue] = Counter()

        for row in rows:
            for pointer in pointer_columns:
                value = row.get(pointer)
                if value is None:
                    continue
                value_str = str(value)
                if not value_str:
                    continue
                counts[ContentHashValue(value_str)] += 1

        return counts

    def get_large_column_metadata(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
    ) -> JsonDocumentText | None:
        """Fetch persisted large-column metadata JSON for a versioned table."""
        select_stmt = SqlSelect(
            SQL_METADATA,
            SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("versioned_large_columns")),
            where=SQL_TABLE_NAME_EQ,
        )
        row = self._transform_direct_fetchone_result(
            self._execute_direct_internal(
                select_stmt,
                params=(table_name,),
                external_params_first=True,
                fetch_mode="one",
            ),
        )
        if row is None and not table_name.endswith(("_tip", "_staged", "_sparse")):
            from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_table_info import VersionedBaseTableName, derive_versioned_table_names

            row = self._transform_direct_fetchone_result(
                self._execute_direct_internal(
                    select_stmt,
                    params=(derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(table_name))).tip,),
                    external_params_first=True,
                    fetch_mode="one",
                ),
            )
        if not row:
            return None
        metadata_value = row["metadata"]
        if metadata_value is None:
            return None
        result_2 = metadata_value
        assert isinstance(result_2, str)
        return JsonDocumentText(result_2)

    def _get_type_metadata[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        model_cls: type[T],
    ) -> list[tuple[int, str, str]]:
        """Get unified type metadata for a polymorphic base class.

        Private method for testing/verification purposes. This is an immediate
        schema metadata load through the schema direct-execution surface, not
        lazy construction.

        Args:
            model_cls: The polymorphic base class

        Returns:
            List of (type_id, name, python_class) tuples ordered by type_id
        """
        base_table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
        select_stmt = SqlSelect(
            SqlColumnNameList(
                [
                    SqlColumnName("type_id"),
                    SqlColumnName("type_name"),
                    SqlColumnName("python_class"),
                ],
            ),
            from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("sys_polymorphic_types")),
            where=SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("base_table")),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(base_table_name),
            ),
            order_by=[SqlColumnIdent(SqlColumnName("type_id"))],
        )
        rows = cast(
            "Sequence[DatabaseRow]",
            self._execute_direct_internal(select_stmt, fetch_mode="all"),
        )
        return [
            (
                _sql_cell_to_int(row["type_id"]),
                _sql_cell_to_str(row["type_name"]),
                _sql_cell_to_str(row["python_class"]),
            )
            for row in rows
        ]

    def _clear_type_metadata[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        model_cls: type[T],
    ) -> None:
        """Clear unified type metadata for a polymorphic base class.

        Private method for testing purposes only.

        Args:
            model_cls: The polymorphic base class
        """

        base_table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
        delete_stmt = SqlDelete(
            SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("sys_polymorphic_types")),
            where=SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("base_table")),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(base_table_name),
            ),
        )
        self._enqueue_data_effect(delete_stmt)

    def _update_type_metadata_python_class(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        base_table: str,
        type_name: SqlTypeName,
        python_class: str,
    ) -> None:
        """Update ``python_class`` for an existing unified type metadata row."""

        update_stmt = SqlUpdate(
            SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("sys_polymorphic_types")),
            [SqlSetItem(SqlColumnName("python_class"), SqlParam(python_class))],
            where=SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("base_table")),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlParam(base_table),
                ),
                BinaryOp.AND,
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("type_name")),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlParam(type_name),
                ),
            ),
        )
        self._enqueue_data_effect(update_stmt)

    def _insert_type_metadata[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        model_cls: type[T],
        type_id: int,
        name: str,
        python_class: str,
    ) -> None:
        """Insert unified type metadata outside schema transactions.

        SQL bootstrap now uses ``sys_polymorphic_types`` as the registry source of
        truth and runtime sync for canonical population. Direct helper inserts are
        still supported for tests that intentionally mutate metadata.
        """
        if self._in_schema_transaction:
            return

        base_table = get_table_name(model_cls)
        columns = [
            SqlColumnName("sys_id"),
            SqlColumnName("base_table"),
            SqlColumnName("type_id"),
            SqlColumnName("type_name"),
            SqlColumnName("python_class"),
            SqlColumnName("schema_hash"),
        ]
        values_row = SqlValuesRow(
            [
                SqlParam(uuid7()),
                SqlParam(base_table),
                SqlParam(type_id),
                SqlParam(name),
                SqlParam(python_class),
                SqlParam(""),
            ],
        )
        insert_stmt = SqlInsert(
            SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("sys_polymorphic_types")),
            SqlParens(SqlColumnNameList(columns)),
            SqlValuesClause([values_row]),
        )
        self._enqueue_data_effect(insert_stmt)

    def _insert_orphaned_row_for_testing[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
        self: Self,
        model_cls: type[T],
        row_data: dict[str, object],
    ) -> None:
        """Insert a row with orphaned/invalid type_id for testing error handling.

        Private method for testing purposes only. Bypasses type_id validation
        and auto-population to allow inserting rows with invalid type_ids.

        Args:
            model_cls: The model class
            row_data: Dictionary of field values (Python field names) including invalid type_id
        """
        from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

        table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
        python_columns = list(row_data.keys())
        db_columns = [get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(col)) for col in python_columns]
        db_col_names = [SqlColumnName(col) for col in db_columns]
        values_list = [row_data[col] for col in python_columns]

        # Insert directly via grammar, bypassing validation
        columns = SqlParens(SqlColumnNameList(db_col_names))
        values_row = SqlValuesRow([SqlParam(v) for v in values_list])
        values_clause = SqlValuesClause([values_row])
        insert_stmt = SqlInsert(SqlTableIdent(GrammarTableName(table_name)), columns, values_clause)
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.execution_context import server_plan_execution_context

        with server_plan_execution_context():
            self._execute_direct_internal(insert_stmt)

    def build_type_filter(
        self: Self,
        model_class: type,
    ) -> list[int]:
        """Get type IDs for polymorphic queries.

        For polymorphic model hierarchies using single-table inheritance,
        returns the list of type_ids that match all subclasses of a given model.

        Args:
            model_class: The model class being queried (may be abstract/parent type)

        Returns:
            List of type_id values for the model and all its subclasses.
            Empty list for non-polymorphic models.

        Examples:
            For Employee with subclasses Manager and Developer::

                type_ids = conn.build_type_filter(Employee)
                # Returns: [1, 2, 3]

            For non-polymorphic models::

                type_ids = conn.build_type_filter(Product)
                # Returns: []
        """

        # Collect type_ids for this model and all its subclasses
        type_ids = collect_polymorphic_type_ids(model_class)

        return list(type_ids)

    def _normalize_column_type(
        self: Self,
        col_name: str,
        col_type: str,
        is_primary_key: bool,
        *,
        is_autoincrement: bool = False,
    ) -> str:
        """Normalize column type for backend-specific requirements.

        Args:
            col_name: Column name
            col_type: Original column type
            is_primary_key: Whether this column is a primary key
            is_autoincrement: Whether this column should auto-generate values

        Returns:
            Normalized column type for this backend
        """
        dialect = self.get_dialect()
        col_type_upper = col_type.upper()
        if is_primary_key and is_autoincrement and col_type_upper in {"INTEGER", "BIGINT"}:
            autoincrement_type: str = dialect.get_integer_autoincrement_type()
            return autoincrement_type
        # MariaDB/MySQL identifier columns use one physical UUID collation so
        # recursive and non-recursive UNION operands remain compatible.
        mysql_uuid_type = dialect.get_type_mapping().get(uuid.UUID)
        if dialect.backend_type.is_mysql_family and col_type_upper == "TEXT" and is_primary_key:
            assert mysql_uuid_type is not None
            return mysql_uuid_type
        if dialect.backend_type.is_mysql_family and col_type_upper == "TEXT" and col_name.endswith("_id"):
            assert mysql_uuid_type is not None
            return mysql_uuid_type
        return col_type

    def _get_autoincrement_clause(self: Self) -> str:
        """Get backend-specific AUTO_INCREMENT clause.

        Returns:
            SQL clause for auto-increment (e.g., "AUTOINCREMENT", "AUTO_INCREMENT", "")

        Note:
            Override in backends to customize:
            - SQLite: "AUTOINCREMENT"
            - MySQL/MariaDB: "AUTO_INCREMENT"
            - PostgreSQL: "" (use SERIAL type instead)
        """
        return "AUTOINCREMENT"  # SQLite default

    def _supports_partial_indexes(self: Self) -> bool:
        """Check if backend supports partial indexes (WHERE clause).

        Returns:
            True if partial indexes supported, False otherwise

        Note:
            Override in backends:
            - SQLite: True
            - PostgreSQL: True
            - MySQL/MariaDB: False
        """
        return True  # SQLite/Postgres default

    def _get_validator(self: Self) -> SchemaValidatorProtocol:
        """Get backend-specific schema validator.

        Returns:
            SchemaValidator instance for this backend

        Raises:
            db_exc.InterfaceError: If not connected
        """
        msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must override _get_validator()"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)

    def get_validator(self: Self) -> SchemaValidatorProtocol:
        """Get the schema validator for this connection.

        Returns:
            SchemaValidator instance for validating schema against models

        Raises:
            db_exc.InterfaceError: If not connected to database
        """
        return self._get_validator()

    @abstractmethod
    def delete_many_returning(
        self: Self,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        ids: Sequence[SysId],
        returning_columns: tuple[str, ...] | None = None,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Delete multiple records by ID and return specified columns.

        Uses DELETE...RETURNING if supported, otherwise SELECT-then-DELETE.

        This method must be implemented by each SQL backend to handle
        backend-specific cursor management and result fetching.

        Args:
            table_name: Name of the table to delete from
            ids: IDs of the records to delete
            returning_columns: Columns to return (None = all columns)

        Returns:
            List of dictionaries of column values from deleted records
        """

    @abstractmethod
    async def delete_many_returning_async(
        self: Self,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        ids: Sequence[SysId],
        returning_columns: tuple[str, ...] | None = None,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Async version of :meth:`delete_many_returning`.

        Each SQL backend must implement this using its native async execution.
        """

    @property
    def _planner_stats_tracker(self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin) -> PlannerStatsTracker:
        return self._sql_maintenance_service._planner_stats_tracker

    def queue_table_for_analyze(
        self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        row_count: int = 0,
    ) -> None:
        self._sql_maintenance_service.queue_table_for_analyze(table_name, row_count)

    def _run_pending_analyze(self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin) -> None:
        self._sql_maintenance_service._run_pending_analyze()

    def _get_table_row_estimate(self: _SqlCoreSupportMixin, table_name: SqlTableName) -> int:
        return self._sql_maintenance_service._get_table_row_estimate(table_name)

@pure_lazy
@contextmanager
def _graphql_bootstrap_profile_span(
    phase: str,  # broad-type: accepted
    *,
    model_name: SchemaModelName | Unset = UNSET,
) -> Generator[None, None, None]:
    """Emit a timed SQL schema bootstrap span when GraphQL bootstrap profiling is enabled."""
    if not _GRAPHQL_BOOTSTRAP_PROFILE:
        yield
        return

    start = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        duration_ms = (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000
        profile_module = sys.modules.get("conform.l9750_graphql.bootstrap_profile")
        record_bootstrap_profile_event = None if profile_module is None else profile_module.__dict__.get("record_bootstrap_profile_event")
        if callable(record_bootstrap_profile_event):
            record_bootstrap_profile_event(
                f"sql_connection.{phase}",
                duration_ms,
                scenario_name=model_name,
            )
            return
        model_suffix = f" model={model_name}" if model_name is not UNSET else ""
        print(
            f"[GRAPHQL_BOOTSTRAP] sql_connection.{phase}{model_suffix} {duration_ms:.2f} ms",
            flush=True,
        )

class SyncSqlDriverChannel:
    """Sync SQL driver dispatch boundary."""

    def __init__(
        self: SyncSqlDriverChannel,
        execute_direct_plan: Callable[[_DirectGrammarExecutionPlan], _DirectExecutionResult],
    ) -> None:
        self._execute_direct_plan = execute_direct_plan

    def execute_direct_plan(
        self: SyncSqlDriverChannel,
        plan: _DirectGrammarExecutionPlan,
    ) -> _DirectExecutionResult:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.execution_context import raise_if_sql_execution_forbidden

        raise_if_sql_execution_forbidden(
            operation="SyncSqlDriverChannel.execute_direct_plan",
            path="SyncSqlDriverChannel.execute_direct_plan",
        )
        return self._execute_direct_plan(plan)

class SqlSessionContextService:
    """Common SQL sessioncontext service boundary."""

    def __init__(
        self: SqlSessionContextService,
        conn: _SqlConnectionCore,
    ) -> None:
        self._conn = conn

    def _assert_sync_io_allowed(self: Self, method_name: ConnectionMethodName) -> None:
        conn = self._conn
        """Crash if this connection is in async mode.

        Called at the top of every sync I/O method. Once ``connect_async()``
        has been called, the connection is permanently async and sync I/O
        is forbidden.

        The check is skipped when:
        * Inside a ServerPlan execution context (sync methods are leaf primitives).
        * The ``disable_sync_in_async_check()`` context manager is active (test harness).
        """
        if conn._io_mode == "async":
            from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.backend_type import BackendType

            # SQLite uses a shared connection handle, so mixed mode is safe.
            if conn.backend_type == BackendType.SQLITE:
                return

            # Inside ServerPlan execution, sync methods are used as leaf primitives
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.execution_context import in_server_plan_execution

            if in_server_plan_execution():
                return

            # Synchronous schema transactions may run after async mode is enabled
            # in test harnesses. Async schema transactions must still reject sync
            # I/O because PostgreSQL uses separate physical channels.
            if conn._in_schema_transaction and not conn._is_in_async_schema_transaction():
                return

            # Test harness: disable_sync_in_async_check() allows intentional mixing
            from l2000_connection.sync_async_guard import _sync_in_async_check_disabled

            if _sync_in_async_check_disabled.get():
                return

            msg = (
                f"Sync I/O method {method_name}() called on an async connection. "
                f"Once connect_async() is called, only async I/O methods may be "
                f"used. Mixing sync and async I/O causes deadlocks on backends "
                f"with separate physical connections (e.g. PostgreSQL)."
            )
            raise RuntimeError(msg)

    async def _ensure_async_mode_async(self: Self) -> None:
        """Ensure the backend async channel has been connected."""
        conn = self._conn
        if conn._io_mode != "async" or not await conn.is_connected_async():
            await conn.connect_async()

    def _is_in_async_schema_transaction(self: Self) -> bool:
        """Return whether an async schema transaction is active."""
        return bool(self._conn._in_schema_transaction)

    def execute_read_plan_workflow[T](self: Self, workflow: SyncReadPlanWorkflow[T]) -> T:
        """Execute one read workflow through the connection session boundary."""
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.execution_context import explicit_plan_execution_scope

        with explicit_plan_execution_scope():
            with self._conn.session(workflow.session_id).open_read_plan() as scope:
                return scope.execute_read_workflow(workflow)

    def _raise_if_pending_active_plan_for_immediate_sql(
        self: Self,
        *,
        operation: ConnectionOperationName,
    ) -> None:
        conn = self._conn
        """Reject direct SQL that would bypass already-queued plan work."""
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.execution_context import in_server_plan_execution

        active_plan = conn._active_plan
        if in_server_plan_execution() or active_plan is None or not active_plan._steps:
            return
        msg = (
            f"{operation} cannot run direct SQL while the active ServerPlan already has pending "
            "work. Lower the operation into that plan or execute it before queuing lazy steps."
        )
        raise RuntimeError(msg)

    def _finalize_commit_branch_ripple_context(
        self: Self,
        *,
        revision_id: RevisionId,
    ) -> RevisionId:
        conn = self._conn
        """Finalize branch publication by enforcing SQL-trigger ripple authority."""
        ripple_context = conn._last_ripple_context
        try:
            if ripple_context is not None and ripple_context.get("should_ripple") and ripple_context["domain"].graphs:
                _ripple_reg = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("l9800_rippling.registry"))
                registry = _ripple_reg.RippleRegistry.get_instance()
                registry.require_domain_sql_triggers(
                    ripple_context["domain"],
                    standard=True,
                    connection=True,
                )
        finally:
            # Always clear the context to prevent stale state (even if rippling was disabled)
            conn._last_ripple_context = None

        return revision_id

    async def _finalize_commit_branch_ripple_context_async(
        self: Self,
        *,
        revision_id: RevisionId,
    ) -> RevisionId:
        conn = self._conn
        """Async entrypoint for the shared branch-publish ripple finalizer."""
        return cast(RevisionId, conn._finalize_commit_branch_ripple_context(revision_id=revision_id))
