@pure_lazy
def _sqlite_registered_table_columns(table_name: SqlTableName) -> frozenset[SqlColumnName] | None:
    from l1000_schema.column_utils import get_db_column_name
    from l1000_schema.reflection_cache import cached_model_fields
    from l1000_schema.table_registry import get_registered_tables
    from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name
    from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_physical_contract import physical_schema_contract_for_model

    for model_cls in get_registered_tables():
        contract = physical_schema_contract_for_model(model_cls)
        contract_columns = contract.required_columns_by_table.get(table_name)
        if contract_columns is not None:
            columns = {SqlColumnName(column_name) for column_name in contract_columns}
            if get_table_name(model_cls) == table_name:
                columns.update(
                    SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)))
                    for field_name in cached_model_fields(model_cls)
                )
            return frozenset(columns)
        if get_table_name(model_cls) == table_name:
            return frozenset(
                SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)))
                for field_name in cached_model_fields(model_cls)
            )
    return None


class SqliteReadOnlyWriteAuthorization(Enum):
    """State whether typed planning proved a write to connection-local state."""

    DENIED = auto()
    CONNECTION_LOCAL = auto()
    PERSISTENT_WRITE_DENIED = auto()


def _check_sqlite_read_only_write_authorization(
    *,
    read_only: bool,
    sql: RawSqlText,
    write_authorization: SqliteReadOnlyWriteAuthorization,
) -> None:
    """Reject persistent writes before SQLite receives a batch statement."""
    if not read_only or write_authorization is SqliteReadOnlyWriteAuthorization.CONNECTION_LOCAL:
        return
    sql_upper = sql.strip().upper()
    write_prefixes = ("INSERT", "UPDATE", "DELETE", "CREATE", "DROP", "ALTER", "TRUNCATE", "REPLACE")
    if write_authorization is SqliteReadOnlyWriteAuthorization.PERSISTENT_WRITE_DENIED or any(
        sql_upper.startswith(prefix) for prefix in write_prefixes
    ):
        msg = "Cannot perform persistent SQL write on read-only connection"
        raise db_exc.ProgrammingError(msg)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SqliteGuardedRegion:
    """Dispatch a closed statement range from one authoritative Boolean result."""

    guard_statement_index: int
    body_start_index: int
    body_end_index: int
    outcome_column: SqlColumnName

    def __post_init__(self: SqliteGuardedRegion) -> None:
        if not self.outcome_column:
            raise ValueError("A SQLite guard outcome column is required")
        if self.guard_statement_index < 0:
            raise ValueError("A SQLite guard statement index cannot be negative")
        if self.body_start_index <= self.guard_statement_index:
            raise ValueError("A SQLite guarded body must follow its guard outcome")
        if self.body_end_index <= self.body_start_index:
            raise ValueError("A SQLite guarded body must contain at least one statement")


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _SqliteCompoundDirectExecutionPlan(_DirectGrammarExecutionPlan):
    statements: tuple[PreparedTerminalExecution, ...]
    result_labels: tuple[str | None, ...]
    collect_results: tuple[bool, ...]
    write_authorizations: tuple[SqliteReadOnlyWriteAuthorization, ...]
    category: str | None = None
    precondition_indices: frozenset[int] = frozenset()
    precondition_errors: tuple[DiagnosticMessage, ...] = ()
    native_bootstrap_invocation_id: BootstrapInvocationId | BootstrapProgramIdentityAbsent = BootstrapProgramIdentityAbsent.ABSENT
    native_bootstrap_phase: BootstrapProgramPhase | BootstrapProgramIdentityAbsent = BootstrapProgramIdentityAbsent.ABSENT
    native_bootstrap_node_ids: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...] = ()
    native_bootstrap_dependencies: tuple[tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...], ...] = ()
    native_bootstrap_result_columns: tuple[tuple[SqlColumnName, ...], ...] = ()
    native_bootstrap_generation_tags: tuple[SchemaGenerationTag, ...] = ()
    bootstrap_generation_sources: tuple[tuple[SchemaGenerationTag, ServerPlanRefId, SqlColumnName], ...] = ()
    bootstrap_result_types: tuple[tuple[BootstrapResultTypeName, ...], ...] = ()
    bootstrap_read_only: bool = False
    guarded_regions: tuple[SqliteGuardedRegion, ...] = ()

    def __post_init__(self: _SqliteCompoundDirectExecutionPlan) -> None:
        """Reject incomplete per-statement metadata before driver execution."""
        statement_count = len(self.statements)
        metadata_counts = {
            "result_labels": len(self.result_labels),
            "collect_results": len(self.collect_results),
            "write_authorizations": len(self.write_authorizations),
        }
        invalid_counts = {name: count for name, count in metadata_counts.items() if count != statement_count}
        if invalid_counts:
            msg = (
                "SQLite compound plan metadata must contain one value per statement: "
                f"statements={statement_count}, invalid_counts={invalid_counts}"
            )
            raise ValueError(msg)
        occupied_body_indices: set[int] = set()
        for region in self.guarded_regions:
            if region.body_end_index > statement_count:
                raise ValueError("A SQLite guarded region extends beyond its statement plan")
            if not self.collect_results[region.guard_statement_index]:
                raise ValueError("A SQLite guarded region must collect its guard outcome")
            body_indices = set(range(region.body_start_index, region.body_end_index))
            if occupied_body_indices & body_indices:
                raise ValueError("SQLite guarded regions cannot overlap")
            occupied_body_indices.update(body_indices)


def _sqlite_statement_batch_template_key(
    compound_stmt: object,
    *,
    fetch_mode: Literal["none", "one", "all"],
    track_rtt: bool,
) -> tuple[Hashable, ...] | None:
    statements = getattr(compound_stmt, "statements", None)
    params_per_stmt = getattr(compound_stmt, "params_per_stmt", None)
    external_params_first_per_stmt = getattr(compound_stmt, "external_params_first_per_stmt", None)
    needs_returning_per_stmt = getattr(compound_stmt, "needs_returning_per_stmt", None)
    collect_results = getattr(compound_stmt, "collect_results_per_stmt", None)
    result_labels = getattr(compound_stmt, "result_labels_per_stmt", None)
    if not isinstance(statements, Sequence) or isinstance(statements, str):
        return None
    if not isinstance(params_per_stmt, Sequence) or isinstance(params_per_stmt, str):
        return None
    statement_keys: list[tuple[Hashable, ...]] = []
    for statement, params in zip(statements, params_per_stmt, strict=True):
        statement_key = _sqlite_single_statement_template_key(statement)
        if statement_key is None:
            if os.getenv("NERA_DEBUG_SQLITE_STATEMENT_BATCH_TEMPLATE_KEY") == "1":
                print(
                    "[sqlite-statement-template-key-miss]",
                    type(statement).__module__,
                    type(statement).__qualname__,
                    file=sys.stderr,
                )
            return None
        statement_keys.append(
            (
                type(statement).__module__,
                type(statement).__qualname__,
                statement_key,
                len(params or ()),
            ),
        )
    return (
        "sqlite-statement-batch-template.v1",
        tuple(statement_keys),
        tuple(external_params_first_per_stmt or ()),
        tuple(needs_returning_per_stmt or ()),
        tuple(collect_results or ()),
        tuple(
            bool(label) if collect_results_for_stmt else False
            for label, collect_results_for_stmt in zip(result_labels or (), collect_results or (), strict=True)
        ),
        fetch_mode,
        track_rtt,
    )


def _sqlite_single_statement_template_key(statement: object) -> tuple[Hashable, ...] | None:
    template_cache_key = getattr(statement, "template_cache_key", None)
    if callable(template_cache_key):
        return cast("tuple[Hashable, ...] | None", template_cache_key())
    trusted_sql = getattr(statement, "sql", None)
    if type(statement).__qualname__ == "_SqlTrustedText" and isinstance(trusted_sql, str):
        return ("trusted", trusted_sql)
    return _sqlite_statement_structural_template_key(statement)


def _sqlite_child_statement_template_key(
    statement: SqlInsert,
    child_params: SqlParamTuple,
    *,
    external_params_first: bool,
    needs_returning: bool,
    fetch_mode: Literal["none", "one", "all"],
    track_rtt: bool,
) -> tuple[Hashable, ...] | None:
    statement_key = _sqlite_single_statement_template_key(statement)
    if statement_key is None:
        return None
    rebind_params = _sqlite_rebindable_statement_params(
        statement,
        child_params,
        external_params_first=external_params_first,
    )
    if rebind_params is None:
        return None
    return (
        "sqlite-child-statement-template.v1",
        type(statement).__module__,
        type(statement).__qualname__,
        statement_key,
        len(rebind_params),
        external_params_first,
        needs_returning,
        fetch_mode,
        track_rtt,
    )


def _sqlite_statement_structural_template_key(statement: object) -> tuple[Hashable, ...] | None:
    shape = _sqlite_structural_shape(statement, max_depth=32)
    if shape is None:
        return None
    return (
        "structural-sql-renderable.v1",
        type(statement).__module__,
        type(statement).__qualname__,
        shape,
    )


def _sqlite_structural_shape(value: object, *, max_depth: int) -> bytes | None:
    """Reduce a statement tree to a value that identifies its shape, or ``None``.

    ``None`` means "cannot be characterized" and the caller must treat the statement as
    unique rather than risk sharing a prepared template between statements of different
    shape. Depth exhaustion, an unrecognized node type and a reference cycle all report
    it for that reason.

    Two properties are what make this usable on the statement path, and neither is
    visible from the shape of the recursion:

    Each node collapses to a fixed-size digest instead of nesting its children's
    structures, so the result stays 32 bytes wide however large the tree is. Building
    the nested structure instead makes the key's size grow with the tree, and this key is
    hashed on every statement.

    Composite nodes are memoized by ``id``, so a subtree reachable by several paths is
    walked once. Statement trees share aggressively -- the same column, table and
    parameter nodes recur throughout one statement -- so without the memo the walk costs
    time proportional to the number of *paths* through the tree rather than the number of
    nodes, which for a wide statement is exponentially worse.

    ``active_ids`` holds the nodes on the current path so a cycle is reported rather than
    recursed into; the memo alone cannot do this, since a node is only memoized once its
    own walk has finished.
    """
    memo: dict[int, bytes] = {}
    active_ids: set[int] = set()

    def _digest(structure: object) -> bytes:
        return hashlib.blake2b(
            repr(structure).encode("utf-8"),
            digest_size=32,
            person=b"nera-sql-shape",
        ).digest()

    def _shape(candidate: object, remaining_depth: int) -> bytes | None:
        if remaining_depth < 0:
            return None
        if isinstance(candidate, type):
            return _digest(("type", candidate.__module__, candidate.__qualname__))
        if candidate is None:
            return _digest(("NoneType",))
        if isinstance(candidate, bool | int | float | str):
            return _digest((type(candidate).__qualname__, candidate))
        if isinstance(candidate, bytes):
            return _digest(("bytes", len(candidate)))

        candidate_id = id(candidate)
        cached = memo.get(candidate_id)
        if cached is not None:
            return cached
        if candidate_id in active_ids:
            return None
        active_ids.add(candidate_id)
        try:
            shaped: object | None
            if isinstance(candidate, tuple):
                items = tuple(_shape(item, remaining_depth - 1) for item in candidate)
                shaped = None if any(item is None for item in items) else ("tuple", items)
            elif isinstance(candidate, list):
                items = tuple(_shape(item, remaining_depth - 1) for item in candidate)
                shaped = None if any(item is None for item in items) else ("list", items)
            elif isinstance(candidate, frozenset | set):
                items = tuple(_shape(item, remaining_depth - 1) for item in candidate)
                shaped = (
                    None
                    if any(item is None for item in items)
                    else ("set", tuple(sorted(cast("tuple[Hashable, ...]", item) for item in items)))
                )
            elif isinstance(candidate, Mapping):
                entries = tuple(
                    (
                        _shape(key, remaining_depth - 1),
                        _shape(item, remaining_depth - 1),
                    )
                    for key, item in candidate.items()
                )
                shaped = None if any(key is None or item is None for key, item in entries) else ("mapping", tuple(sorted(entries)))
            elif type(candidate).__qualname__ == "SqlBindExternalParams":
                inner = getattr(candidate, "_inner", None)
                params = getattr(candidate, "_params", ())
                inner_shape = _shape(inner, remaining_depth - 1)
                shaped = (
                    None
                    if inner_shape is None or not isinstance(params, tuple)
                    else (
                        "external-params-wrapper",
                        bool(getattr(candidate, "_external_params_first", False)),
                        len(params),
                        inner_shape,
                    )
                )
            elif is_dataclass(candidate):
                entries = tuple(
                    (
                        field.name,
                        _shape(getattr(candidate, field.name), remaining_depth - 1),
                    )
                    for field in fields(candidate)
                )
                shaped = (
                    None
                    if any(item is None for _name, item in entries)
                    else ("dataclass", type(candidate).__module__, type(candidate).__qualname__, entries)
                )
            else:
                slots = getattr(type(candidate), "__slots__", ())
                if isinstance(slots, str):
                    slots = (slots,)
                if not isinstance(slots, tuple) or not slots:
                    shaped = None
                else:
                    entries_list: list[tuple[str, object]] = []
                    for slot in slots:
                        if not isinstance(slot, str) or slot.startswith("__"):
                            continue
                        try:
                            slot_value = getattr(candidate, slot)
                        except AttributeError:
                            continue
                        slot_shape = _shape(slot_value, remaining_depth - 1)
                        if slot_shape is None:
                            return None
                        entries_list.append((slot, slot_shape))
                    shaped = (
                        "slots",
                        type(candidate).__module__,
                        type(candidate).__qualname__,
                        tuple(entries_list),
                    )
            if shaped is None:
                return None
            digest = _digest(shaped)
            memo[candidate_id] = digest
            return digest
        finally:
            active_ids.remove(candidate_id)

    return _shape(value, max_depth)


def _sqlite_rebind_compound_template_plan(
    template_plan: _SqliteCompoundDirectExecutionPlan,
    compound_stmt: object,
) -> _SqliteCompoundDirectExecutionPlan | None:
    statements = getattr(compound_stmt, "statements", None)
    params_per_stmt = getattr(compound_stmt, "params_per_stmt", None)
    external_params_first_per_stmt = getattr(compound_stmt, "external_params_first_per_stmt", None)
    if not isinstance(statements, Sequence) or isinstance(statements, str):
        return None
    if not isinstance(params_per_stmt, Sequence) or isinstance(params_per_stmt, str):
        return None
    if not isinstance(external_params_first_per_stmt, Sequence) or isinstance(external_params_first_per_stmt, str):
        return None
    if len(params_per_stmt) != len(template_plan.statements) or len(statements) != len(template_plan.statements):
        return None
    rebound_statements: list[PreparedTerminalExecution] = []
    for prepared, statement, child_params, child_external_params_first in zip(
        template_plan.statements,
        statements,
        params_per_stmt,
        external_params_first_per_stmt,
        strict=True,
    ):
        params = _sqlite_rebindable_statement_params(
            statement,
            tuple(child_params or ()),
            external_params_first=bool(child_external_params_first),
        )
        if params is None:
            return None
        if len(prepared.params) != len(params):
            return None
        rebound_statements.append(
            PreparedTerminalExecution(
                sql=prepared.sql,
                params=params,
                prerender_info=prepared.prerender_info,
                transaction_kind=prepared.transaction_kind,
            ),
        )
    return _SqliteCompoundDirectExecutionPlan(
        sql=template_plan.sql,
        params=tuple(param for prepared in rebound_statements for param in prepared.params),
        prerender_info=template_plan.prerender_info,
        fetch_mode=template_plan.fetch_mode,
        track_rtt=template_plan.track_rtt,
        statements=tuple(rebound_statements),
        result_labels=template_plan.result_labels,
        collect_results=template_plan.collect_results,
        category=template_plan.category,
        precondition_indices=template_plan.precondition_indices,
        precondition_errors=template_plan.precondition_errors,
        native_bootstrap_invocation_id=template_plan.native_bootstrap_invocation_id,
        native_bootstrap_phase=template_plan.native_bootstrap_phase,
        native_bootstrap_node_ids=template_plan.native_bootstrap_node_ids,
        native_bootstrap_dependencies=template_plan.native_bootstrap_dependencies,
        native_bootstrap_result_columns=template_plan.native_bootstrap_result_columns,
        native_bootstrap_generation_tags=template_plan.native_bootstrap_generation_tags,
        bootstrap_generation_sources=template_plan.bootstrap_generation_sources,
        bootstrap_result_types=template_plan.bootstrap_result_types,
        bootstrap_read_only=template_plan.bootstrap_read_only,
        write_authorizations=template_plan.write_authorizations,
    )


def _sqlite_rebindable_statement_params(
    statement: SqlInsert,
    child_params: SqlParamTuple,
    *,
    external_params_first: bool,
) -> SqlParamTuple | None:
    wrapper_params: SqlParamTuple = ()
    if type(statement).__qualname__ == "SqlBindExternalParams":
        raw_wrapper_params = getattr(statement, "_params", ())
        if not isinstance(raw_wrapper_params, tuple):
            return None
        wrapper_params = raw_wrapper_params
    if external_params_first:
        return child_params + wrapper_params
    return wrapper_params + child_params


@pure_lazy
def _sqlite_statement_parts(sql_str: RawSqlText) -> tuple[RawSqlText, ...]:
    """Find complete statements without splitting literals or trigger bodies."""
    statements: list[RawSqlText] = []
    start = 0
    separator = sql_str.find(";")
    while separator >= 0:
        candidate = sql_str[start : separator + 1]
        if sqlite3.complete_statement(candidate):
            if candidate.strip().strip(";").strip():
                statements.append(RawSqlText(candidate.strip()))
            start = separator + 1
        separator = sql_str.find(";", separator + 1)
    tail = sql_str[start:].strip()
    if tail:
        statements.append(RawSqlText(tail))
    return tuple(statements)


def _sqlite_parameter_free_script[ParamsItemT](
    sql_str: RawSqlText | PossiblyEmptySqlText,
    params: tuple[ParamsItemT, ...],
) -> bool:
    """Detect multiple parameter-free statements, not trigger-body separators."""
    if params or ";" not in sql_str.strip().rstrip(";"):
        return False
    return len(_sqlite_statement_parts(RawSqlText(sql_str))) > 1


_SQLITE_QUOTED_IDENTIFIER_RE = re.compile(r'^\s*"(?P<name>[^"]+)"')
_SQLITE_BARE_IDENTIFIER_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(?P<name>[A-Za-z_][\w]*)")


@pure_lazy
def _sqlite_replay_analysis_effects[EffectsItemT](
    effects: tuple[tuple[RawSqlText | PossiblyEmptySqlText, tuple[EffectsItemT, ...]], ...],
) -> tuple[tuple[RawSqlText | PossiblyEmptySqlText, tuple[Any, ...]], ...]:
    """Expand parameter-free replay scripts for schema-shape analysis."""
    expanded: list[tuple[RawSqlText | PossiblyEmptySqlText, tuple[Any, ...]]] = []
    for sql_str, params in effects:
        if params:
            expanded.append((sql_str, params))
            continue
        statements = _sqlite_statement_parts(RawSqlText(sql_str))
        if len(statements) <= 1:
            expanded.append((sql_str, params))
            continue
        expanded.extend((statement, ()) for statement in statements)
    return tuple(expanded)


@pure_lazy
def _sqlite_schema_replay_has_unsafe_add_columns[EffectsItemT](
    effects: tuple[tuple[RawSqlText | PossiblyEmptySqlText, tuple[EffectsItemT, ...]], ...],
) -> bool:
    """Return whether cached SQLite ADD COLUMN replay is not self-contained."""

    created_tables: set[str] = set()
    seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
    for sql_str, params in _sqlite_replay_analysis_effects(effects):
        if params:
            continue
        for statement in _sqlite_split_top_level_semicolons(sql_str):
            created_table = _sqlite_create_table_columns(statement)
            if created_table is not None:
                table_name, column_names = created_table
                created_tables.add(table_name.casefold())
                for column_name in column_names:
                    seen.add((table_name.casefold(), column_name.casefold()))
                continue
            add_column = alter_table_add_column(statement)
            if add_column is None:
                continue
            raw_table_name, raw_column_name = add_column
            target = (raw_table_name.casefold(), raw_column_name.casefold())
            if target in seen:
                return True
            seen.add(target)
    return False


@pure_lazy
def _sqlite_known_columns_from_cache(
    conn: _SqliteConnectionCore,
) -> MappingProxyType[SqlTableName, frozenset[SqlColumnName]]:
    """Return cached SQLite column shapes keyed by normalized table name."""

    raw_cache = getattr(conn, "_column_cache", None)
    if not isinstance(raw_cache, dict):
        return MappingProxyType({})
    columns_by_table: dict[SqlTableName, frozenset[SqlColumnName]] = {}
    for table_name, columns in raw_cache.items():
        if not isinstance(columns, frozenset):
            continue
        columns_by_table[SqlTableName(str(table_name).casefold())] = frozenset(
            SqlColumnName(str(column).casefold()) for column in columns
        )
    return MappingProxyType(columns_by_table)


@pure_lazy
def _sqlite_schema_replay_conflicts_with_known_schema[EffectsItemT](
    conn: _SqliteConnectionCore,
    effects: tuple[tuple[RawSqlText | PossiblyEmptySqlText, tuple[EffectsItemT, ...]], ...],
    *,
    known_tables: tuple[SqlTableName, ...],
) -> bool:
    """Return True when replay would re-create known schema that already exists."""
    known_table_names = {SqlTableName(str(table_name).casefold()) for table_name in known_tables}
    known_columns_by_table = _sqlite_known_columns_from_cache(conn)
    for sql_str, params in _sqlite_replay_analysis_effects(effects):
        if params:
            continue
        for statement in _sqlite_split_top_level_semicolons(sql_str):
            created_table = _sqlite_create_table_columns(statement)
            if created_table is not None:
                table_name, column_names = created_table
                normalized_table_name = SqlTableName(table_name.casefold())
                if normalized_table_name in known_table_names:
                    if create_table_uses_if_not_exists(statement):
                        continue
                    known_columns = known_columns_by_table.get(normalized_table_name)
                    if known_columns is None or all(column_name.casefold() in known_columns for column_name in column_names):
                        return True
                continue
            add_column = alter_table_add_column(statement)
            if add_column is None:
                continue
            raw_table_name, raw_column_name = (part.casefold() for part in add_column)
            table_name = SqlTableName(raw_table_name)
            column_name = SqlColumnName(raw_column_name)
            if table_name in known_table_names and column_name:
                known_columns = known_columns_by_table.get(table_name)
                if known_columns is None or column_name in known_columns:
                    return True
    return False


def _sqlite_duplicate_add_column_target(
    sql_str: RawSqlText | PossiblyEmptySqlText,
    exc: BaseException,
) -> tuple[SqlTableName, SqlColumnName] | None:
    error_msg = str(exc).lower()
    if "duplicate column" not in error_msg and "already exists" not in error_msg:
        return None
    add_column = alter_table_add_column(sql_str)
    if add_column is None:
        return None
    table_name, column_name = add_column
    if not table_name or not column_name:
        return None
    return (SqlTableName(table_name), SqlColumnName(column_name))

@pure_lazy
def _sqlite_split_top_level_semicolons(
    sql_str: RawSqlText | PossiblyEmptySqlText,
) -> tuple[RawSqlText, ...]:
    parts: list[str] = []
    start = 0
    in_double_quote = False
    in_single_quote = False
    index = 0
    while index < len(sql_str):
        char = sql_str[index]
        if char == '"' and not in_single_quote:
            in_double_quote = not in_double_quote
        elif char == "'" and not in_double_quote:
            escaped_quote = index + 1 < len(sql_str) and sql_str[index + 1] == "'"
            if escaped_quote:
                index += 1
            else:
                in_single_quote = not in_single_quote
        elif char == ";" and not in_double_quote and not in_single_quote:
            statement = sql_str[start:index].strip()
            if statement:
                parts.append(statement)
            start = index + 1
        index += 1
    statement = sql_str[start:].strip()
    if statement:
        parts.append(statement)
    return tuple(map(RawSqlText, tuple(parts)))


@pure_lazy
def _sqlite_create_table_columns(
    sql_str: RawSqlText | PossiblyEmptySqlText,
) -> tuple[SqlTableName, tuple[SqlColumnName, ...]] | None:
    table_name = create_table_name(sql_str)
    if table_name is None:
        return None
    body_start = sql_str.find("(")
    body_end = sql_str.rfind(")")
    if body_start < 0 or body_end <= body_start:
        return (SqlTableName(table_name), ())
    columns: list[SqlColumnName] = []
    for item in _sqlite_split_top_level_commas(RawSqlText(sql_str[body_start + 1 : body_end])):
        stripped = item.lstrip()
        keyword = stripped.split(None, 1)[0].upper() if stripped else ""
        if keyword in {"CHECK", "CONSTRAINT", "FOREIGN", "PRIMARY", "UNIQUE"}:
            continue
        identifier = _SQLITE_QUOTED_IDENTIFIER_RE.match(stripped) or _SQLITE_BARE_IDENTIFIER_RE.match(stripped)
        if identifier is not None:
            columns.append(SqlColumnName(identifier.group("name")))
    return (SqlTableName(table_name), tuple(columns))


@pure_lazy
def _sqlite_split_top_level_commas(
    sql_str: RawSqlText | PossiblyEmptySqlText,
) -> tuple[RawSqlText, ...]:
    parts: list[str] = []
    start = 0
    depth = 0
    in_quote = False
    index = 0
    while index < len(sql_str):
        char = sql_str[index]
        if char == '"':
            in_quote = not in_quote
        elif not in_quote:
            if char == "(":
                depth += 1
            elif char == ")" and depth:
                depth -= 1
            elif char == "," and depth == 0:
                parts.append(sql_str[start:index])
                start = index + 1
        index += 1
    parts.append(sql_str[start:])
    return tuple(map(RawSqlText, tuple(parts)))

def _sqlite_cache_kib() -> int:
    configured = os.getenv(_SQLITE_CACHE_KIB_ENV)
    if configured:
        try:
            configured_kib = int(configured)
        except ValueError as exc:
            msg = f"{_SQLITE_CACHE_KIB_ENV} must be an integer KiB value"
            raise ValueError(msg) from exc
        return max(128, configured_kib)
    if os.getenv("RUNNING_TESTS") == "1":
        return _TEST_SQLITE_CACHE_KIB
    return _DEFAULT_SQLITE_CACHE_KIB


def _sqlite_sql_cell_to_int(value: SqlCell) -> int:
    if isinstance(value, SqlNull):
        msg = "Expected integer SQL cell, got NULL"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    if isinstance(value, memoryview):
        return int(bytes(value))
    if isinstance(value, str | int | float | bool | bytes | Decimal):
        return int(value)
    msg = f"Expected integer SQL cell, got {type(value).__name__}"
    raise TypeError(msg)


def _sqlite_sql_cell_to_bytes(value: SqlCell) -> bytes:
    if isinstance(value, bytes):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, memoryview):
        return bytes(value)
    msg = f"Expected bytes SQL cell, got {type(value).__name__}"
    raise TypeError(msg)


def _sqlite_sql_cell_to_str(value: SqlCell) -> RawSqlText:
    if isinstance(value, SqlNull):
        msg = "Expected text SQL cell, got NULL"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    return RawSqlText(str(value))

class SqliteStatementTimeoutError(Exception):
    """Internal exception raised by progress handler when timeout is exceeded."""

    def __init__(self: SqliteStatementTimeoutError, timeout_ms: int) -> None:
        """Initialize the timeout error.

        Args:
            timeout_ms: The configured timeout in milliseconds
        """
        self.timeout_ms = timeout_ms
        super().__init__(f"Statement cancelled: exceeded {timeout_ms}ms timeout")


@pure_lazy
def _translate_sqlite_operational_error(exc: sqlite3.OperationalError) -> Exception:
    """Translate SQLite operational errors to DB-API exceptions."""
    from impl.common.l2200_sql_dialect.exception_translation import (
        extract_column_name_sqlite,
        extract_table_name_sqlite,
    )

    error_msg = str(exc).lower()

    if "no such table" in error_msg:
        table_name = extract_table_name_sqlite(str(exc))
        return DbTableNotFoundError(
            message=str(exc),
            table_name=table_name,
            original_exception=exc,
        )
    if "no such column" in error_msg:
        column_name = extract_column_name_sqlite(str(exc))
        return DbColumnNotFoundError(
            message=str(exc),
            column_name=column_name,
            original_exception=exc,
        )
    if "database is locked" in error_msg or "locked" in error_msg:
        return DbDatabaseLockedError(
            message="SQLite database locked - will retry automatically",
            original_exception=exc,
        )
    if "interrupted" in error_msg:
        return DbStatementTimeoutError(
            message="Statement interrupted by timeout handler",
            original_exception=exc,
        )
    return DbOperationalError(original_exception=exc)


@pure_lazy
def _translate_sqlite_driver_error(exc: sqlite3.Error) -> Exception:
    """Translate generic SQLite DB-API errors to DB-API exceptions."""
    if getattr(exc, "sqlite_errorcode", None) == sqlite3.SQLITE_AUTH:
        return DbProgrammingError(
            message="SQLite rejected an operation on a read-only handle",
            original_exception=exc,
        )
    if isinstance(exc, sqlite3.ProgrammingError):
        return DbProgrammingError(original_exception=exc)
    if isinstance(exc, sqlite3.DataError):
        return DbDataError(original_exception=exc)
    if isinstance(exc, sqlite3.DatabaseError):
        return DbDatabaseError(original_exception=exc)
    if isinstance(exc, sqlite3.InterfaceError):
        return DbInterfaceError(original_exception=exc)
    return DbDatabaseError(original_exception=exc)


@pure_lazy
def _translate_sqlite_exception(exc: Exception) -> Exception:
    """Translate SQLite exceptions to our DB-API exceptions.

    This function ensures NO sqlite3 exception types leak through to application code.
    All exceptions are wrapped in the appropriate db_exc type.
    """
    # Pass through our own custom exceptions unchanged
    if isinstance(exc, DbApiError):
        return exc

    # Check for our internal statement timeout error first
    if isinstance(exc, SqliteStatementTimeoutError):
        return DbStatementTimeoutError(
            timeout_seconds=exc.timeout_ms / 1000.0,
            message=f"Statement cancelled: exceeded {exc.timeout_ms}ms timeout",
            original_exception=exc,
        )

    if isinstance(exc, sqlite3.IntegrityError):
        msg = str(exc)
        revision_identity_constraints = (
            "UNIQUE constraint failed: sys_revision_physical_keys.revision_sys_id",
            "UNIQUE constraint failed: sys_revision_parents.revision_sys_id, sys_revision_parents.ordinal",
        )
        if any(constraint in msg for constraint in revision_identity_constraints):
            return DbProgrammingError(
                "Revision identity already exists",
                original_exception=exc,
            )
        from impl.common.l7100_versioned_operations.incremental_graph_exception_translation import (
            translate_incremental_graph_unique_error,
        )

        translated_graph_error = translate_incremental_graph_unique_error(
            message=msg,
            constraint_name=None,
            original_exception=exc,
        )
        if translated_graph_error is not None:
            return translated_graph_error
        if "UNIQUE constraint failed" in msg and "branches" in msg.lower():
            msg = f"already exists ({msg})"
        elif "UNIQUE constraint failed" in msg and "duplicate" not in msg.lower():
            msg = f"duplicate value ({msg})"
        return DbIntegrityError(msg, original_exception=exc)

    if isinstance(exc, sqlite3.DataError):
        translated_null_byte_error = translate_null_byte_error(exc)
        if translated_null_byte_error is not None:
            return translated_null_byte_error

    if isinstance(exc, sqlite3.OperationalError):
        return _translate_sqlite_operational_error(exc)
    if isinstance(exc, sqlite3.Error):
        return _translate_sqlite_driver_error(exc)

    # CRITICAL: Wrap any unknown exceptions to prevent driver leakage
    # This ensures no sqlite3-specific types escape to application code
    return DbDatabaseError(
        message=f"Unexpected database error: {exc}",
        original_exception=exc,
    )


# REGEXP polyfill functions for SQLite
# SQLite has REGEXP syntax but no implementation - we provide it via the `regex` module
#
# SECURITY (COMPOSER-036/075/076): We use the `regex` module with timeout protection.
# The `regex` module (https://pypi.org/project/regex/) is an enhanced replacement for
# Python's `re` that:
# 1. Has built-in optimizations that prevent many backtracking ReDoS patterns
# 2. Supports a `timeout` parameter that terminates long-running matches
#
# This provides robust ReDoS protection without requiring platform-specific binaries
# (important for Pyodide compatibility).

# SECURITY: Timeout for regex operations in seconds
# This prevents ReDoS attacks by terminating matches that take too long
_REGEX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 0.1  # 100ms is generous for any legitimate match


def _sqlite_regexp(
    pattern: RegexPatternText | None,
    value: str | None,  # broad-type: accepted
) -> bool:
    """SQLite REGEXP -- returns False on timeout or invalid pattern.

    Security (COMPOSER-036/075/076): Protected against ReDoS via timeout.
    """
    if pattern is None or value is None:
        return False
    return _udf_safe(
        lambda: _regex_module.search(pattern, value, timeout=_REGEX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) is not None,
        fallback=False,
        exceptions=(TimeoutError, _regex_module.error),
        udf_name=DiagnosticLabel("REGEXP"),
        pattern=pattern,
    )


def _sqlite_regexp_icase(
    pattern: RegexPatternText | None,
    value: str | None,  # broad-type: accepted
) -> bool:
    """SQLite IREGEXP (case-insensitive) -- returns False on timeout or invalid pattern.

    Security (COMPOSER-036/075/076): Protected against ReDoS via timeout.
    """
    if pattern is None or value is None:
        return False
    return _udf_safe(
        lambda: (
            _regex_module.search(
                pattern,
                value,
                _regex_module.IGNORECASE,
                timeout=_REGEX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
            )
            is not None
        ),
        fallback=False,
        exceptions=(TimeoutError, _regex_module.error),
        udf_name=DiagnosticLabel("IREGEXP"),
        pattern=pattern,
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SQL UDF helpers
#
# UDFs are called by the database engine during query execution.  If a UDF
# raises an exception, SQLite surfaces an opaque "user-defined function
# raised exception" error that crashes the entire query -- the caller has no
# way to know what went wrong.
#
# SQL semantics say that domain errors return NULL (e.g. SQRT(-1) is NULL,
# LOG(0) is NULL, POWER(big, big) is NULL).  The helper below encapsulates
# this contract: call a callable and return its result, or return a fallback
# value when the callable raises one of the expected exception types.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

T_UDF = TypeVar("T_UDF")


def _udf_safe(
    fn: Callable[[], T_UDF],
    fallback: T_UDF,
    exceptions: tuple[type[BaseException], ...],
    udf_name: DiagnosticLabel,
    **log_kwargs: object,
) -> T_UDF:
    """Call *fn* and return its result, or *fallback* on expected domain errors.

    SQL UDFs MUST NOT raise -- the database engine cannot propagate exceptions
    to the caller.  The SQL standard defines NULL as the result for domain
    errors (e.g. SQRT(-1), LOG(0)).  This helper encapsulates that contract.

    Only *exceptions* listed are caught; anything else propagates (a real bug).
    """
    try:
        return fn()
    except exceptions as e:
        logger.debug("%s UDF domain error (%s): %s", udf_name, log_kwargs, e)
        return fallback


def _sqlite_power(base: float | None, exponent: float | None) -> float | None:
    """SQLite POWER(base, exponent) -- returns NULL for domain errors."""
    if base is None or exponent is None:
        return None
    return _udf_safe(
        lambda: _math_module.pow(base, exponent),
        fallback=None,
        exceptions=(ValueError, OverflowError),
        udf_name=DiagnosticLabel("POWER"),
        base=base,
        exponent=exponent,
    )


def _sqlite_sqrt(value: float | None) -> float | None:
    """SQLite SQRT(value) -- returns NULL for negative inputs."""
    if value is None:
        return None
    return _udf_safe(
        lambda: _math_module.sqrt(value),
        fallback=None,
        exceptions=(ValueError,),
        udf_name=DiagnosticLabel("SQRT"),
        value=value,
    )


def _sqlite_log(value: float | None) -> float | None:
    """SQLite LOG/LN(value) -- returns NULL for non-positive inputs."""
    if value is None:
        return None
    return _udf_safe(
        lambda: _math_module.log(value),
        fallback=None,
        exceptions=(ValueError, ZeroDivisionError),
        udf_name=DiagnosticLabel("LOG"),
        value=value,
    )


def _sqlite_exp(value: float | None) -> float | None:
    """SQLite EXP(value) -- returns NULL on overflow."""
    if value is None:
        return None
    return _udf_safe(
        lambda: _math_module.exp(value),
        fallback=None,
        exceptions=(OverflowError,),
        udf_name=DiagnosticLabel("EXP"),
        value=value,
    )


def _sqlite_reverse(value: str | None) -> str | None:  # broad-type: accepted
    """SQLite REVERSE implementation.

    Args:
        value: String to reverse

    Returns:
        Reversed string, or None if value is None
    """
    return None if value is None else value[::-1]


def _sqlite_udf_scalar_is_text(value: SqliteUdfScalar) -> TypeGuard[_SqliteMatchText]:
    return isinstance(value, str)


def _sqlite_udf_scalar_is_binary(
    value: SqliteUdfScalar,
) -> TypeGuard[bytes | bytearray | memoryview]:
    return isinstance(value, bytes | bytearray | memoryview)


def _sqlite_sha256(value: SqliteUdfValue) -> bytes | None:
    """SQLite SHA-256 UDF returning the raw 32-byte digest."""
    value = _sqlite_udf_python_value(value)
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, str):
        payload = value.encode("utf-8")
    elif isinstance(value, bytes):
        payload = value
    elif isinstance(value, bytearray | memoryview):
        payload = bytes(value)
    else:
        payload = str(value).encode("utf-8")
    return hashlib.sha256(payload).digest()


def _normalize_matching_text(
    value: _SqliteMatchText,
    unicode_form: _SqliteMatchUnicodeForm,
    case_handling: _SqliteMatchCaseHandling,
) -> _SqliteMatchText:
    normalized: str
    if unicode_form == "NONE":
        normalized = value
    elif unicode_form == "NFC":
        normalized = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", value)
    elif unicode_form == "NFD":
        normalized = unicodedata.normalize("NFD", value)
    elif unicode_form == "NFKC":
        normalized = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", value)
    elif unicode_form == "NFKD":
        normalized = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", value)
    else:
        raise ValueError("unknown Unicode normalization form")
    return _SqliteMatchText(normalized.casefold() if case_handling == "casefold" else normalized)


def _sqlite_matching_substring_occurrences(
    pattern: SqliteUdfValue,
    text: SqliteUdfValue,
    unicode_form: SqliteUdfValue,
    case_handling: SqliteUdfValue,
) -> SqliteUdfScalar:
    if not all(isinstance(value, str) for value in (pattern, text, unicode_form, case_handling)):
        return SqliteUdfScalar(None)
    assert isinstance(pattern, str)
    assert isinstance(text, str)
    assert isinstance(unicode_form, str)
    assert isinstance(case_handling, str)
    normalized_pattern = _normalize_matching_text(
        _SqliteMatchText(pattern),
        _SqliteMatchUnicodeForm(unicode_form),
        _SqliteMatchCaseHandling(case_handling),
    )
    normalized_text = _normalize_matching_text(
        _SqliteMatchText(text),
        _SqliteMatchUnicodeForm(unicode_form),
        _SqliteMatchCaseHandling(case_handling),
    )
    if normalized_pattern == "":
        raise ValueError("substring patterns must not be empty")
    return SqliteUdfScalar(sum(normalized_text.startswith(normalized_pattern, offset) for offset in range(len(normalized_text))))


def _sqlite_matching_qgram_count(
    text: SqliteUdfValue,
    gram: SqliteUdfValue,
    unicode_form: SqliteUdfValue,
    case_handling: SqliteUdfValue,
) -> SqliteUdfScalar:
    if not all(isinstance(value, str) for value in (text, gram, unicode_form, case_handling)):
        return SqliteUdfScalar(None)
    assert isinstance(text, str)
    assert isinstance(gram, str)
    assert isinstance(unicode_form, str)
    assert isinstance(case_handling, str)
    normalized_text = _normalize_matching_text(
        _SqliteMatchText(text),
        _SqliteMatchUnicodeForm(unicode_form),
        _SqliteMatchCaseHandling(case_handling),
    )
    normalized_gram = _normalize_matching_text(
        _SqliteMatchText(gram),
        _SqliteMatchUnicodeForm(unicode_form),
        _SqliteMatchCaseHandling(case_handling),
    )
    if normalized_gram == "":
        return SqliteUdfScalar(0)
    return SqliteUdfScalar(sum(normalized_text.startswith(normalized_gram, offset) for offset in range(len(normalized_text))))


def _sqlite_matching_normalize(
    text: SqliteUdfValue,
    form: SqliteUdfValue,
    case: SqliteUdfValue,
) -> SqliteUdfScalar:
    if not isinstance(text, str) or not isinstance(form, str) or not isinstance(case, str):
        return SqliteUdfScalar(None)
    return SqliteUdfScalar(
        _normalize_matching_text(
            _SqliteMatchText(text),
            _SqliteMatchUnicodeForm(form),
            _SqliteMatchCaseHandling(case),
        )
    )


def _sqlite_matching_banded_cell_count(
    left: SqliteUdfValue,
    right: SqliteUdfValue,
    threshold: SqliteUdfValue,
) -> SqliteUdfScalar:
    if not isinstance(left, str) or not isinstance(right, str):
        return SqliteUdfScalar(None)
    if not isinstance(threshold, int) or isinstance(threshold, bool) or threshold < 0:
        return SqliteUdfScalar(None)
    if abs(len(left) - len(right)) > threshold:
        return SqliteUdfScalar(0)
    return SqliteUdfScalar(
        sum(
            max(0, min(len(right), left_index + threshold) - max(1, left_index - threshold) + 1) for left_index in range(1, len(left) + 1)
        )
    )


def _sqlite_matching_banded_evaluation(
    left: SqliteUdfValue,
    right: SqliteUdfValue,
    unicode_form: SqliteUdfValue,
    case_handling: SqliteUdfValue,
    threshold: SqliteUdfValue,
) -> SqliteUdfScalar:
    receipt = _sqlite_matching_banded_run(left, right, unicode_form, case_handling, threshold)
    if isinstance(receipt, _InvalidBandedRun):
        return SqliteUdfScalar(None)
    distance, cells, peak_entries = receipt
    return SqliteUdfScalar(json.dumps({"distance": distance, "cells": cells, "peak_entries": peak_entries}))


def _sqlite_matching_banded_levenshtein(
    left: SqliteUdfValue,
    right: SqliteUdfValue,
    unicode_form: SqliteUdfValue,
    case_handling: SqliteUdfValue,
    threshold: SqliteUdfValue,
) -> SqliteUdfScalar:
    receipt = _sqlite_matching_banded_run(left, right, unicode_form, case_handling, threshold)
    return SqliteUdfScalar(None if isinstance(receipt, _InvalidBandedRun) else receipt[0])


def _sqlite_matching_banded_run(
    left: SqliteUdfValue,
    right: SqliteUdfValue,
    unicode_form: SqliteUdfValue,
    case_handling: SqliteUdfValue,
    threshold: SqliteUdfValue,
) -> tuple[int, int, int] | _InvalidBandedRun:
    if not all(isinstance(value, str) for value in (left, right, unicode_form, case_handling)):
        return _INVALID_BANDED_RUN
    if not isinstance(threshold, int) or isinstance(threshold, bool) or threshold < 0:
        return _INVALID_BANDED_RUN
    assert isinstance(left, str)
    assert isinstance(right, str)
    assert isinstance(unicode_form, str)
    assert isinstance(case_handling, str)
    normalized_left = _normalize_matching_text(
        _SqliteMatchText(left),
        _SqliteMatchUnicodeForm(unicode_form),
        _SqliteMatchCaseHandling(case_handling),
    )
    normalized_right = _normalize_matching_text(
        _SqliteMatchText(right),
        _SqliteMatchUnicodeForm(unicode_form),
        _SqliteMatchCaseHandling(case_handling),
    )
    if abs(len(normalized_left) - len(normalized_right)) > threshold:
        return threshold + 1, 0, 0
    if len(normalized_right) > len(normalized_left):
        normalized_left, normalized_right = normalized_right, normalized_left
    unreachable = threshold + 1
    previous = {index: index for index in range(min(len(normalized_right), threshold) + 1)}
    cells = 0
    peak_entries = len(previous)
    for left_index, left_value in enumerate(normalized_left, start=1):
        current: dict[int, int] = {}
        if left_index <= threshold:
            current[0] = left_index
        start = max(1, left_index - threshold)
        stop = min(len(normalized_right), left_index + threshold)
        for right_index in range(start, stop + 1):
            current[right_index] = min(
                current.get(right_index - 1, unreachable) + 1,
                previous.get(right_index, unreachable) + 1,
                previous.get(right_index - 1, unreachable) + (left_value != normalized_right[right_index - 1]),
                unreachable,
            )
            cells += 1
        peak_entries = max(peak_entries, len(previous) + len(current))
        previous = current
    return previous.get(len(normalized_right), unreachable), cells, peak_entries


def _sqlite_matching_levenshtein(
    left: SqliteUdfValue,
    right: SqliteUdfValue,
    unicode_form: SqliteUdfValue,
    case_handling: SqliteUdfValue,
) -> SqliteUdfScalar:
    if not all(isinstance(value, str) for value in (left, right, unicode_form, case_handling)):
        return SqliteUdfScalar(None)
    assert isinstance(left, str)
    assert isinstance(right, str)
    assert isinstance(unicode_form, str)
    assert isinstance(case_handling, str)
    normalized_left = _normalize_matching_text(
        _SqliteMatchText(left),
        _SqliteMatchUnicodeForm(unicode_form),
        _SqliteMatchCaseHandling(case_handling),
    )
    normalized_right = _normalize_matching_text(
        _SqliteMatchText(right),
        _SqliteMatchUnicodeForm(unicode_form),
        _SqliteMatchCaseHandling(case_handling),
    )
    if len(normalized_left) < len(normalized_right):
        normalized_left, normalized_right = normalized_right, normalized_left
    previous = list(range(len(normalized_right) + 1))
    for left_index, left_value in enumerate(normalized_left, start=1):
        current = [left_index]
        for right_index, right_value in enumerate(normalized_right, start=1):
            current.append(
                min(
                    current[-1] + 1,
                    previous[right_index] + 1,
                    previous[right_index - 1] + (left_value != right_value),
                ),
            )
        previous = current
    return SqliteUdfScalar(previous[-1])


_CanonicalMatchingJson = NewType("_CanonicalMatchingJson", str)

_SQLITE_MATCHING_JSON_VECTOR_CACHE: LocalMetadataCache[npt.NDArray[np.float32] | _InvalidMatchingVector] = LocalMetadataCache(
    name="sqlite:matching_json_vectors",
    max_entries=4096,
    invalidation_policy=LocalMetadataInvalidationPolicy.IMMUTABLE_KEY_METADATA,
)
_SQLITE_MATCHING_JSON_DOT_CACHE: LocalMetadataCache[SqliteUdfScalar] = LocalMetadataCache(
    name="sqlite:matching_json_dot_products",
    max_entries=2048,
    invalidation_policy=LocalMetadataInvalidationPolicy.IMMUTABLE_KEY_METADATA,
)


def _sqlite_matching_json_vector_cached(
    value: _CanonicalMatchingJson,
    dimensions: int,
) -> npt.NDArray[np.float32] | _InvalidMatchingVector:
    """Decode one immutable canonical JSON vector."""
    cache_key = f"{dimensions}:{value}"
    cached = _SQLITE_MATCHING_JSON_VECTOR_CACHE.get_immutable(cache_key)
    if cached is not None:
        return cached
    result = _sqlite_matching_json_vector_uncached(value, dimensions)
    _SQLITE_MATCHING_JSON_VECTOR_CACHE.set_many_values(((cache_key, result),))
    return result


def _sqlite_matching_json_vector_uncached(
    value: _CanonicalMatchingJson,
    dimensions: int,
) -> npt.NDArray[np.float32] | _InvalidMatchingVector:
    import numpy as np

    from impl.common.l2300_json_serialization.fast_json import loads

    try:
        decoded = loads(value)
        if not isinstance(decoded, list):
            return _INVALID_MATCHING_VECTOR
        vector = np.asarray(decoded, dtype=np.float32)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return _INVALID_MATCHING_VECTOR
    if vector.ndim != 1 or vector.size != dimensions:
        return _INVALID_MATCHING_VECTOR
    vector.flags.writeable = False
    return vector


def _sqlite_matching_json_vector(
    value: SqliteUdfValue,
    dimensions: SqliteUdfValue,
) -> npt.NDArray[np.float32] | _InvalidMatchingVector:
    """Decode one canonical JSON vector with bounded immutable reuse."""
    value = _sqlite_udf_python_value(value)
    dimensions = _sqlite_udf_python_value(dimensions)
    if (
        not isinstance(value, str)
        or not isinstance(dimensions, int)
        or dimensions <= 0
        or not value.startswith("[")
        or not value.endswith("]")
    ):
        return _INVALID_MATCHING_VECTOR
    return _sqlite_matching_json_vector_cached(_CanonicalMatchingJson(value), dimensions)


def _sqlite_matching_json_dot_cached(
    left_json: _CanonicalMatchingJson,
    right_json: _CanonicalMatchingJson,
    dimensions: int,
) -> SqliteUdfScalar:
    """Score one immutable canonical JSON-vector pair."""
    cache_key = f"{dimensions}:{len(left_json)}:{left_json}{right_json}"
    cached = _SQLITE_MATCHING_JSON_DOT_CACHE.get_immutable(cache_key)
    if cached is not None:
        return cached
    result = _sqlite_matching_json_dot_uncached(left_json, right_json, dimensions)
    _SQLITE_MATCHING_JSON_DOT_CACHE.set_many_values(((cache_key, result),))
    return result


def _sqlite_matching_json_dot_uncached(
    left_json: _CanonicalMatchingJson,
    right_json: _CanonicalMatchingJson,
    dimensions: int,
) -> SqliteUdfScalar:
    import numpy as np

    left = _sqlite_matching_json_vector_cached(left_json, dimensions)
    right = _sqlite_matching_json_vector_cached(right_json, dimensions)
    if isinstance(left, _InvalidMatchingVector) or isinstance(right, _InvalidMatchingVector):
        return SqliteUdfScalar(None)
    if not np.isfinite(left).all() or not np.isfinite(right).all():
        return SqliteUdfScalar(None)
    return SqliteUdfScalar(float(np.vecdot(left, right, dtype=np.float64)))


def _sqlite_matching_json_dot(
    left_json: SqliteUdfValue,
    right_json: SqliteUdfValue,
    dimensions: SqliteUdfValue,
) -> SqliteUdfScalar:
    """Score canonical JSON vectors with bounded immutable-pair reuse."""
    left_json = _sqlite_udf_python_value(left_json)
    right_json = _sqlite_udf_python_value(right_json)
    dimensions = _sqlite_udf_python_value(dimensions)
    if (
        not isinstance(left_json, str)
        or not isinstance(right_json, str)
        or not isinstance(dimensions, int)
        or dimensions <= 0
        or not left_json.startswith("[")
        or not left_json.endswith("]")
        or not right_json.startswith("[")
        or not right_json.endswith("]")
    ):
        return SqliteUdfScalar(None)

    return _udf_safe(
        lambda: _sqlite_matching_json_dot_cached(
            _CanonicalMatchingJson(left_json),
            _CanonicalMatchingJson(right_json),
            dimensions,
        ),
        fallback=SqliteUdfScalar(None),
        exceptions=(Exception,),
        udf_name=DiagnosticLabel("nera_matching_json_dot"),
    )


def _sqlite_matching_packed_valid(data: SqliteUdfValue, dimensions: SqliteUdfValue) -> int:
    """Validate canonical packed fp32 input without invoking a scorer."""
    import numpy as np

    data = _sqlite_udf_python_value(data)
    dimensions = _sqlite_udf_python_value(dimensions)
    if not isinstance(data, bytes) or not isinstance(dimensions, int) or dimensions <= 0:
        return 0
    if len(data) != 5 + 4 * dimensions or data[:5] != b"EMB\x01\x00":
        return 0
    values = np.frombuffer(data, dtype="<f4", offset=5, count=dimensions)
    return int(np.isfinite(values).all())


def _sqlite_hamming_distance(
    stored_code: SqliteUdfValue,
    query_code: SqliteUdfValue,
    dimensions: SqliteUdfValue,
) -> int | None:
    """SQLite UDF for SQL-side Hamming distance over packed projection bytes."""
    stored_value = _sqlite_udf_python_value(stored_code)
    query_value = _sqlite_udf_python_value(query_code)
    dimension_value = _sqlite_udf_python_value(dimensions)
    if not isinstance(stored_value, bytes | bytearray | memoryview):
        return None
    if not isinstance(query_value, bytes | bytearray | memoryview):
        return None
    if not isinstance(dimension_value, int | str):
        return None

    def _distance() -> int:
        dim = int(dimension_value)
        if dim <= 0:
            msg = "Hamming dimensions must be positive"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        stored = bytes(stored_value)
        query = bytes(query_value)
        byte_count = (dim + 7) // 8
        if len(stored) < byte_count or len(query) < byte_count:
            msg = (
                "Packed Hamming code shorter than configured dimensions: "
                f"stored={len(stored) * 8} query={len(query) * 8} dimensions={dim}"
            )
            raise ValueError(msg)
        total = 0
        full_bytes, remainder_bits = divmod(dim, 8)
        for left, right in zip(stored[:full_bytes], query[:full_bytes], strict=True):
            total += (left ^ right).bit_count()
        if remainder_bits:
            # Projection codes are packed most-significant-bit first (matching
            # numpy.packbits / pgvector bit text); mask away padding bits.
            mask = (0xFF << (8 - remainder_bits)) & 0xFF
            total += ((stored[full_bytes] ^ query[full_bytes]) & mask).bit_count()
        return total

    return _udf_safe(
        _distance,
        fallback=None,
        exceptions=(Exception,),
        udf_name=DiagnosticLabel("nera_hamming_distance"),
    )


def _sqlite_sha256_prefix_text(
    prefix: SqliteUdfValue,
    text: SqliteUdfValue,
) -> bytes | None:
    """SQLite SHA-256 UDF for ``prefix_bytes + utf8(text)`` payloads."""
    prefix = _sqlite_udf_python_value(prefix)
    text = _sqlite_udf_python_value(text)
    prefix_bytes: bytes
    if prefix is None:
        prefix_bytes = b""
    elif isinstance(prefix, bytes):
        prefix_bytes = prefix
    elif isinstance(prefix, str):
        prefix_bytes = prefix.encode("utf-8")
    elif isinstance(prefix, bytearray | memoryview):
        prefix_bytes = bytes(prefix)
    else:
        prefix_bytes = str(prefix).encode("utf-8")
    text_bytes: bytes
    if text is None:
        text_bytes = b""
    elif isinstance(text, str):
        text_bytes = text.encode("utf-8")
    elif isinstance(text, bytes):
        text_bytes = text
    elif isinstance(text, bytearray | memoryview):
        text_bytes = bytes(text)
    else:
        text_bytes = str(text).encode("utf-8")
    return hashlib.sha256(prefix_bytes + text_bytes).digest()


_SQLITE_SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE_BYTES = 32
_SQLITE_SHA256_DIGEST_HEX_LENGTH = _SQLITE_SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE_BYTES * 2
_SQLITE_SHA256_BIGINT_SLICE_MAX_START = _SQLITE_SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE_BYTES - 8
_SQLITE_SHA256_INT_SLICE_MAX_START = _SQLITE_SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE_BYTES - 4


def _sqlite_digest_bytes(digest: SqliteUdfValue) -> bytes | None:
    digest_value = _sqlite_udf_python_value(digest)
    if _sqlite_udf_scalar_is_binary(digest_value):
        digest_bytes = bytes(digest_value)
    elif _sqlite_udf_scalar_is_text(digest_value):
        if len(digest_value) != _SQLITE_SHA256_DIGEST_HEX_LENGTH or any(char not in hexdigits for char in digest_value):
            return None
        digest_bytes = bytes.fromhex(digest_value)
    else:
        return None
    return digest_bytes if len(digest_bytes) == _SQLITE_SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE_BYTES else None


def _sqlite_digest_slice_bigint(
    digest: SqliteUdfValue,
    start_byte: int | None,
) -> int | SerializedIntegerText | None:
    """Decode an 8-byte digest slice into a signed bigint."""
    if digest is None or start_byte is None:
        return None
    if start_byte < 0 or start_byte > _SQLITE_SHA256_BIGINT_SLICE_MAX_START:
        return None
    digest_bytes = _sqlite_digest_bytes(digest)
    if digest_bytes is None:
        return None
    value = int.from_bytes(digest_bytes[start_byte : start_byte + 8], "big", signed=True)
    return SerializedIntegerText(str(value)) if sys.platform == "emscripten" else value


def _sqlite_digest_slice_int(
    digest: SqliteUdfValue,
    start_byte: int | None,
) -> int | None:
    """Decode a 4-byte digest slice into a signed integer."""
    if digest is None or start_byte is None:
        return None
    if start_byte < 0 or start_byte > _SQLITE_SHA256_INT_SLICE_MAX_START:
        return None
    digest_bytes = _sqlite_digest_bytes(digest)
    if digest_bytes is None:
        return None
    return int.from_bytes(digest_bytes[start_byte : start_byte + 4], "big", signed=True)


def _sqlite_uuid_hash32(
    value: str | bytes | bytearray | memoryview | None,  # broad-type: accepted
) -> int | None:
    """Hash UUID bytes to a signed 32-bit integer, with text fallback."""
    if value is None:
        return None
    payload: bytes
    try:
        if isinstance(value, bytes | bytearray | memoryview):
            raw_bytes = bytes(value)
            payload = raw_bytes if len(raw_bytes) == 16 else uuid.UUID(raw_bytes.decode("utf-8")).bytes
        else:
            payload = uuid.UUID(str(value)).bytes
    except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
        if isinstance(value, bytes | bytearray | memoryview):
            payload = bytes(value)
        else:
            payload = str(value).encode("utf-8")
    return int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(payload).digest()[:4], "big", signed=True)


def _sqlite_signed_bigint_hex(value: int | str | None) -> RawSqlText | None:  # broad-type: accepted
    """Format a signed 64-bit integer as a lowercase 16-character hex string."""
    if value is None:
        return optional_branded_text(None, RawSqlText)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        try:
            value = int(value)
        except ValueError:
            return optional_branded_text(None, RawSqlText)
    if value < -(1 << 63) or value > (1 << 63) - 1:
        return optional_branded_text(None, RawSqlText)
    unsigned_value = value if value >= 0 else value + (1 << 64)
    return optional_branded_text(format(unsigned_value, "016x"), RawSqlText)


_SIGNED_BIGINT_HEX_LENGTH = 16


def _sqlite_hex_signed_bigint(
    value: str | bytes | bytearray | memoryview | None,  # broad-type: accepted
) -> int | None:
    """Decode a 16-character hex string into a signed 64-bit integer."""
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, bytes | bytearray | memoryview):
        try:
            value = bytes(value).decode("ascii")
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            return None
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        return None
    if len(value) != _SIGNED_BIGINT_HEX_LENGTH or any(char not in hexdigits for char in value):
        return None
    unsigned_value = int(value, 16)
    if unsigned_value >= (1 << 63):
        unsigned_value -= 1 << 64
    return unsigned_value


def _sqlite_utf8_text_or_null(
    value: str | bytes | bytearray | memoryview | None,  # broad-type: accepted
) -> RawSqlText | None:
    """Decode UTF-8 bytes to text, returning None for undecodable payloads."""
    if value is None:
        return optional_branded_text(None, RawSqlText)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return optional_branded_text(value, RawSqlText)
    payload = bytes(value) if isinstance(value, bytearray | memoryview) else value
    decoded = payload.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
    if decoded.encode("utf-8") != payload:
        return optional_branded_text(None, RawSqlText)
    return optional_branded_text(decoded, RawSqlText)


def _sqlite_py_str_bytes(
    value: str | bytes | bytearray | memoryview | None,  # broad-type: accepted
) -> RawSqlText | None:
    """Mirror Python ``str()`` for SQLite byte-like values."""
    if value is None:
        return optional_branded_text(None, RawSqlText)
    if isinstance(value, bytearray | memoryview):
        return optional_branded_text(str(bytes(value)), RawSqlText)
    return optional_branded_text(str(value), RawSqlText)


def _sqlite_unhex_compat(value: SqlParameterValue) -> bytes | None:
    """Provide SQLite's one-argument ``unhex`` semantics before version 3.45."""
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, bytes):
        try:
            encoded = value.decode("ascii")
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            return None
    elif isinstance(value, str):
        encoded = value
    else:
        return None
    if len(encoded) % 2 or any(char not in hexdigits for char in encoded):
        return None
    return bytes.fromhex(encoded)


def _build_sqlite_delete_many_returning_stmt(
    table_name: SqlTableName,
    ids: tuple[SysId, ...],
    returning_columns: tuple[SqlColumnName, ...] | None,
) -> SqlDelete:
    """Build a DELETE...RETURNING statement for multiple IDs (pure computation)."""
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlWhereClause
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlParam, SqlStar
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlIn
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.identifiers import SqlTableIdent

    if returning_columns is None:
        returning_clause = SqlReturningClause([SqlStar()])
    else:
        returning_items = [SqlColumnRef(column) for column in returning_columns]
        returning_clause = SqlReturningClause(returning_items)

    id_values: list[str] = [id_val.unwrap_to_str() for id_val in ids]
    id_exprs = [SqlParam(v) for v in id_values]
    where_expr = SqlIn(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")), id_exprs)
    where_clause = SqlWhereClause(where_expr)

    table_ident = SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(table_name))
    return SqlDelete(table_ident, where=where_clause, returning=returning_clause)


class SqliteDriverService:
    """SQLite driver lifecycle service boundary."""

    def __init__(self: SqliteDriverService, conn: _SqliteConnectionCore) -> None:
        self._conn = conn

    def ensure_connected_sync(self: SqliteDriverService) -> None:
        self._conn.ensure_connected_sync()

    async def ensure_connected_async(self: SqliteDriverService) -> None:
        await self._conn.ensure_connected_async()

    def is_connected(self: SqliteDriverService) -> bool:
        return bool(self._conn.is_connected())

    async def is_connected_async(self: SqliteDriverService) -> bool:
        return bool(await self._conn.is_connected_async())

    def _check_read_only_write_authorization(
        self: SqliteDriverService,
        sql_str: RawSqlText,
        write_authorization: SqliteReadOnlyWriteAuthorization,
    ) -> None:
        """Reject a persistent write before SQLite receives any batch statement."""
        _check_sqlite_read_only_write_authorization(
            read_only=self._conn._read_only,
            sql=sql_str,
            write_authorization=write_authorization,
        )

    def _prepare_driver_execution[ParamsItemT](
        self: SqliteDriverService,
        sql_str: RawSqlText,
        params: tuple[ParamsItemT, ...],
        *,
        write_authorization: SqliteReadOnlyWriteAuthorization,
    ) -> RawSqlText:
        """Apply the shared driver checks and transformations."""
        conn = self._conn
        # Typed planning is the only authority that can admit a connection-local write.
        # See docs/design/NER1541_GRAPH_WALK_EXECUTION_ARCHITECTURE.rst.
        self._check_read_only_write_authorization(RawSqlText(sql_str), write_authorization)

        # Latency simulation (tracks RTT for instrumentation)
        if conn._latency_simulator is not None:
            query_bytes = estimate_query_size(
                sql_str,
                params if isinstance(params, (tuple, dict)) else None,
            )
            conn._latency_simulator.simulate_query(query_bytes, result_bytes=0)
        # Some UPDATE grammar paths still hand SQLite a pre-prefixed SET clause.
        # Normalize the duplicated token here so sync and async execution share
        # the same compatibility behavior.
        if sql_str.lstrip().upper().startswith("UPDATE"):
            sql_str = RawSqlText(_DUPLICATE_UPDATE_SET_RE.sub("SET", sql_str, count=1))
        return sql_str

    def _track_sqlite_commit_or_rollback_rtt(self: Any) -> None:
        conn = self._conn
        if not conn._should_track_rtt_directly():
            return
        if conn._rtt_pipeline_depth > 0:
            conn._rtt_pipeline_operations += 1
            return
        track_commit_or_rollback()


class SqliteSchemaService[ConnT: _SqliteConnectionCore = _SqliteConnectionCore]:
    """SQLite schema/introspection service boundary."""

    def __init__(self, conn: ConnT) -> None:
        self._conn: ConnT = conn

    @pure_lazy
    def cached_schema_replay_columns(
        self: SqliteSchemaService,
        effects: Sequence[CachedDdlEffect],
    ) -> Mapping[SqlTableName, frozenset[SqlColumnName]]:
        """Project table columns encoded by cached SQLite CREATE TABLE effects."""
        effects = tuple(effects)
        columns_by_table: dict[SqlTableName, set[SqlColumnName]] = {}
        raw_effects = tuple((RawSqlText(effect.sql), tuple(effect.params)) for effect in effects)
        for sql_str, params in _sqlite_replay_analysis_effects(raw_effects):
            if params:
                continue
            for statement in _sqlite_split_top_level_semicolons(sql_str):
                created_table = _sqlite_create_table_columns(statement)
                if created_table is None:
                    continue
                table_name, column_names = created_table
                columns_by_table.setdefault(SqlTableName(table_name), set()).update(
                    SqlColumnName(column_name) for column_name in column_names
                )
        return {table_name: frozenset(column_names) for table_name, column_names in columns_by_table.items()}

    def list_tables(self: SqliteSchemaService) -> Sequence[SqlTableName]:
        """Physical table listing for schema transactions."""
        conn = self._conn
        table_names = conn._list_tables_under_authority()
        return [SqlTableName(_schema_name) for _schema_name in [str(table_name) for table_name in table_names]]

    async def list_tables_async(self: SqliteSchemaService) -> Sequence[SqlTableName]:
        """Async physical table listing for schema transactions."""
        conn = self._conn
        table_names = await conn._list_tables_under_authority_async()
        return [SqlTableName(_schema_name) for _schema_name in [str(table_name) for table_name in table_names]]

    def session_context_table_exists(
        self: SqliteSchemaService,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
    ) -> bool:
        """Read the SQLite session-context table fact through the schema service."""
        conn = self._conn
        exists = conn._table_exists_many_uncached((table_name,))[table_name]
        return bool(exists)

    def introspect_schema(
        self: SqliteSchemaService,
        *,
        include_tables: tuple[SqlTableName, ...] | None = None,
    ) -> IntrospectedSchema[SqlTableName]:
        conn = self._conn
        """Introspect the SQLite schema."""
        if conn._introspector is None:
            raise db_exc.InterfaceError("Not connected to database")
        return conn._introspector.introspect_schema(include_tables=include_tables)

    def introspect_table(self: Any, table_name: SqlTableName) -> IntrospectedTable:
        conn = self._conn
        if conn._introspector is None:
            raise db_exc.InterfaceError("Not connected to database")
        return cast("IntrospectedTable", conn._introspector.introspect_table(table_name))

    async def introspect_table_async(self: SqliteSchemaService, table_name: SqlTableName) -> IntrospectedTable:
        """Async schema-service table introspection boundary."""
        return self.introspect_table(table_name)

    async def trigger_exists_async(self: Any, trigger_name: SqlTriggerName) -> bool:
        return cast(bool, await self._conn._backend_trigger_exists_async(trigger_name))

    def get_schema_validator(self: Any) -> SqliteValidator:
        conn = self._conn
        """Return the SQLite schema validator."""
        return cast("SqliteValidator", conn._get_validator())

    async def get_table_info_async(self: SqliteSchemaService, table_name: SqlTableName) -> Sequence[TableInfoRow]:
        """Async column information for schema transactions."""
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_utility import SqlPragma

        conn = self._conn
        rows = conn._transform_direct_fetchall_result(
            await conn._execute_direct_internal_async(
                SqlPragma(SqlGrammarKind("table_xinfo"), SqlGrammarValue(str(table_name))),
                fetch_mode="all",
            ),
        )
        return TABLE_INFO_ROWS_ADAPTER.validate_python([dict(row) for row in rows])

    def get_table_info(self: SqliteSchemaService, table_name: SqlTableName) -> Sequence[TableInfoRow]:
        """Column information for schema transactions."""
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_utility import SqlPragma

        conn = self._conn
        rows = conn._transform_direct_fetchall_result(
            conn._execute_direct_internal(
                SqlPragma(SqlGrammarKind("table_xinfo"), SqlGrammarValue(str(table_name))),
                fetch_mode="all",
            ),
        )
        return TABLE_INFO_ROWS_ADAPTER.validate_python([dict(row) for row in rows])

    def get_table_indexes_many(
        self: Any,
        table_names: Sequence[SqlTableName],
    ) -> Mapping[SqlTableName, Sequence[SqlIndexName]]:
        """SQLite-optimized multi-table index snapshot."""
        table_names = tuple(table_names)
        names = tuple(dict.fromkeys(str(table_name) for table_name in table_names))
        if not names:
            return {}
        results: dict[SqlTableName, list[SqlIndexName]] = {SqlTableName(table_name): [] for table_name in names}
        for table_name in names:
            try:
                table = self.introspect_table(table_name)
            except Exception as exc:
                if type(exc).__name__ == "TableNotFoundError":
                    continue
                raise
            results[SqlTableName(table_name)] = [SqlIndexName(index.name) for index in table.indexes]
        return results

    def get_table_indexes(self: Any, table_name: SqlTableName) -> Sequence[SqlIndexName]:
        """Return index names for a single SQLite table."""
        return [SqlIndexName(index_name) for index_name in self.get_table_indexes_many((str(table_name),)).get(str(table_name), [])]

    async def get_table_indexes_async(
        self: SqliteSchemaService,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
    ) -> tuple[SqlIndexName, ...]:
        """Return index names through the async schema-service boundary."""
        table = await self.introspect_table_async(table_name)
        return tuple(SqlIndexName(index.name) for index in table.indexes)
